location plus elbow room ! to find that the reviews i had read on tripadvisor were not exaggerations was refreshing. on june 6th, when we (4 adults, 3 children - ages 3, 5 12) arrived at 49th 3rd, we all were more than pleasantly surprised, with the location and the apartments. my grandson 's immediate reaction was: this is great!. i was relieved. the hospitality house truly was a find i never would have trusted without tripadvisor's recommendation. both units were clean and spacious, the a/c made the heat and humidity bearable and the well-stocked refrigerator made late-night snacks and breakfast convenient and economical. it really was as advertised: an excellent value, perfect for families with children and just like actually living in nyc. the staff was courteous and helpful and even helped with getting discounted tickets. we look forward to staying there for our next visit to nyc - with or without children.the only negatives are the elevators (slow small) and the hallways from which you enter the units: dark and worn. but once the door was opened, all doubts disappeared. thank you very much. we enjoyed it so much, we were sorry to leave.

best place i've ever stayed i stayed here on my way back to london after a 4 month trip around the world. was extremely impressed with the apartment suite - is the best place i've ever stayed. i would highly recommend staying here with a group of friends as the rooms are massive with huge king size beds and there is a futon couch in the living room also. really felt like a home away from home. the kitchen was great as i was on my own and didn't want to spend money eating out, and it saved money having breakfast provided (fresh fruit, milk, cereal, english muffins). had tv in both living room and bedroom with so many channels i now understand why americans love tv so much! only complaint would be that the heating is steam (radiator) heating and is a bit noisy when it comes on in the middle of the night. my room was extremely hot when i checked in (-2 degrees celcius outside - about 30 inside!) and i couldn't adjust the temperature. managed to crack a window (on 7th floor) and let some air in and mentioned it to the front desk. staff were great - let me store my bags for the day when checking out as had about 5 hours to kill before leaving for airport.was good value for money as was travelling on kiwi dollar and got a great last minute deal.highly, highly recommend this hotel - i can't wait to go back and stay there with my friends.

good place in manhattan stayed at the hospitality house best western, 145 e 49th st manhattan in july this year(2005)location good, rooms good, we had two bedroom and pullout sofa, 5 of us went, mum.dad, 22 year old son, 2 daughters age 18 and 16.everything we needed was there, in easy walking distance to sights such as times sq etc, rooms and hotel clean, restaurants next door, also next to the waldorf hotel.staff more than helpful, would happily stay again, great for 1 st time visitors.

great for groups/families! just returned after a six-night stay at the bw hospitality house. the suite was clean and very spacious - perfect for the five of us. a large living/dining room, one large and one medium-sized bedroom, one reasonably-sized bathroom (tub; full towel closet), and a medium-sized and well-stocked kitchen (fruits, fruit juice, milk, cereal, english muffins, coffee/tea; refrigerator, oven/stove, microwave, toaster, coffee-maker, dishwasher). laundry machines in the basement. tvs in every room, vcr in two; free high-speed internet (they were nice enough to provide us with an ethernet cable as well).the staff were helpful, courteous and friendly (isaac in particular). the midtown-manhattan location was convenient in addition to giving us a nice taste of life among the skyscrapers in the big apple. it's right near the 51st st. subway station (metro 6). not much noise at all (perhaps because we were on the 7th floor).overall, we had no complaints at all, and i'd highly recommend this for groups/families.

it was great!!! we just returned from a nine night stay at the best western hospitality house in ny, ny. it was great! the best thing was the staff. they were wonderful. very kind, courteous and helpful. it felt like we were leaving our family behind when we left. issac is the bomb! like having our very own tour guide/personal assistant. also, great rooms. very clean, quiet and comfortable. we have no complaints and plan to stay here again when we return to ny. also, hotel is close to everything! thanks again!

glad we stayed! five ladies from wisconsin stayed at the hospitality house from may 24 thru the 29th. five nights. we had no trouble finding it, the entrance is small and not fancy. we had a two bedroom/one bath, full kitchen, living, dining room combined. it was more than enough room. one bedroom had a king bed, the second a queen and the living room area had a full pull out bed in the sofa. each bedroom had a tv as well as the main room. a few times we could have used another bathroom but we just took turns and finished with makeup, hair etc in the bedrooms. it was nice having the fruit, cereal, muffins, juice and milk every morning. the front desk was helpful. we were mostly there in the late evening as we did alot of the touristy things all day long. we could easily have had another adult with us.the cost per night was $380.36, this included all fees and taxes. we each paid for one night. we all thought where it was located was great. we would hightly recommend it for a larger group wanting to stay together. its in a nice area, restaurants right next door and shopping just up the street.

great for small group! took my teenage daughter, a friend her teenage son, and another adult friend (party of 5) for a quick getaway weekend the first weekend in may, 2005. we made our plans at the last minute and getting a 2 bedroom at the hospitality house seemed like a better deal than two room somewhere else. we arrived around noon on saturday and our apartment was already ready. desk attendant was very friendly. it was very clean, modestly furnished, but the perfect set up for a group of friends travelling together. one room had a queen bed, the other a twin with a trundle. the living room had a futon couch bed. the unit came stocked with a try of fresh fruit, and very small containers of milk and juice, a few single serve boxes of cereal, and some english muffins. we ate the fruit but didn't go for the rest of the stuff. kitchen was a full kitchen. we didn't really make use of the facility, but enjoyed hanging out in the living/dining room area till the small hours of the morning. upon checking out the desk attendant was again very helpful and stored our bags for the day. he even gave us a bag of ice for the road for my daughter who is still recovering from a broken leg. my only complaint was that it was a little further over to the east side than we prefer to stay -- but it was quite walkable and in a decent area.

like having your own apt in new york city recently stayed here with my family for the 3rd time and it always feels comfortable, just like having your own nyc apt. excellent location just behind the waldorf astoria, on the m50 bus line, 1 blk to the subway, walking distance to grand central, rockefeller ctr, most midtown sights. our 1 br apt had a living rm, bedroom, kitchen bath, hardwood floors, cable tv, free high-spd internet access, fruit-juice-milk-cereal-english muffins-coffee/tea supplied in your kitchen daily. quite a number and variety of restaurants within a few blocks of the hotel. only downsides are the typical nyc traffic noises and our bathroom had a slightly tricky toilet. we enjoy staying here enough that it is the first place we consider whenever we come to new york.

if you need space for your visit to nyc this is your hotel! i stayed with my family at the hospitality house from march 26th til the 31st of this year. it is a converted appartment complex. we stayed in 7b. it is a 2 bedroom. the master bedroom was a 19x14 foot room with a king bed , 2 closets and a tv. the other bedroom was a 14x12 foot room with a normal double, a closet and a tv. the main room was large enough to leave the fold out sleeper sofa open and to still have a table with 6 chairs around it with plenty of extra room. the kitchen was a long thin one but had a fridge, full size stove, range, and microwave. there was a dishwasher too. the hotel will stock the fridge with milk, oj, butter, jelly, english muffins, and kellog cereals.the bathroom had a tub/shower combo.all in all it was a great place for a family of 5 to stay! beside us was a room that had 4 women. they loved their room too. each floor except the first has 4 rooms of which it appeared 2 are 2 bedroom and 2 are 1 bedroom. the 9th floor was listed as a penthouse and i never ventured up for a look.no pool. no exercise room. no restaraunt. this is just hotel with rooms for guests. the staff was pleasant and helpful.beside the hotel is the san martin restaurant. a fine establishment for spanish and italian. a block east on 49th is chin chin's. flat out the best chinese food i have ever eaten. at third and 51st is azure. it is a little store/deli. it is open 24 hours and has a buffet as well as sandwiches and some staples for the fridge. the bagels and the chocolate cake from their were quite delicious. there is a food emporium at 51st and second for more extensive grocery needs.it was a great hotel that i have no reservations suggesting

larger than some nyc apartments! this place is huge--probably larger than many nyc apts! i stayed by myself via a good hotwire deal for 2 nights on a weekend at $413 total, inc. tax, etc.; it's usually about 300- a night. full kitchen (fridge, microwave, toaster; pots/pans, a real stove, teakettle, coffee maker, sugar, boxed cereal, fruit, milk, english muffins, coffee, dining room table, good size bathroom, etc.). 2 closets, 2 full length mirrors, lots of storage space. good size bathroom, nice shower, full size dining room table, roll-out comfy couch, 2 tvs, with the big one in the living room. big bedroom w/smallish tv. desk, with internet connection. you'll save tons of money on food, and it's a convenient location near murray hill.while the space was immaculate, with newish furniture and newly painted, there are some caveats. if you're looking for a 4 star boutiquey hotel, this is not for you: it's slightly grubby. the ancient radiators make it impossible to control the heat--i put bowls of water around the suite to prevent static.there is no natural light-- the window shades are down and impossible to raise, possibly to block the view of the dark airshaft and pigeon poop. some of the windows didn't lock--although it'd be pretty impossible for someone to break in since i was on the 4th floor and there are no balconies, as a woman staying alone, it creeped me out. there was no dish washing liquid, no kleenex, but there was plenty of toilet paper, towels, and nice bathroom amenities. check out is too early: 11:30. it's supremely quiet, very cozy. the front desk folks were awesome, very helpful, very nice. highly recommended if you need space, want to party, need to do work, or like to save money on food.

great place to stay pre-cruise our family of 7 stayed here the night before our cruise. it was wonderful. the hotel put us all in one large room that overlooked the cruise ship pier. when we got up in the morning we could see our ship! right across the road was a huge shopping center. when we arrived at the hotel our room wasnt ready they kept our luggage and we went across to the shopping center and had lunch.this hotel was a great location, with awesome customer service.

us, but i only speak english and wasn't able to get the idea across to him in miami's native tounge. so we took the cart and hauled it up ourselves. to his credit, the bellman smiled a lot and seemed friendly enough.no comissarythey don't have any of the usual razor, shampoo, soap, aspirin.... stuff that most hotels have. if you've left a anything at home, you'll need to go out to a drug store (closest was 4 blocks down).the roomthe halls were nice but the room smelled and had significant signs of water damage and peeling wallpaper. the bathroom door had been painted so many times that it couldn't be closed. the entryway to the room is a tight hallway that barely fits you with a suitcase and can't fit the luggage cart, so you have to unload from the hallway and drag things in.the churchour room was on the side that was separated from a church by a small road . at 7am, the church loudspeakers started chiming out christmas music right into our room. that went on for 30 minutes of clanging and gonging. get a room on another side of the building if you like to sleep in.internet, or lack thereofi had some things i needed to do just before leaving, and tried to use the their advertised free wireless internet. it wasn't even recognizable in my room at all (5th floor, north side). i called down and they said i should go to the business services room on the second floor. it was packed with all the other people who couldn't get in from their rooms.i went to the lobby, where i'd seen someone using a laptop. i could find the network but it was up and down enough to rival the waves at the beach. after fighting for 20 minutes to connect at all, i couldn't stay connected long enough to do much of anything. i finally went back to the business services room and found a spot. i managed to download the cell-phone dialer software i needed to tie my computer to my cell phone and use it's internet connection to connect with my office and get my work done.don't count on the net there.checkoutthe room was already paid, so it's a leave-the-card-on-the-dresser-and-go checkout, which is nice. we had a car, so we loaded up and were out. there was what seemed to be a taxi-waiting-line in the hotel lobby that extended all the way back to the dining room (30+ people w/bags). i was glad i didn't need a ride.conclusionit serves as a need to crash somewhere better than my car, but the next time i'm in miami for a cruise or any reason other than a stay at a resort on the beach trip, i plan on staying at a (hopefully nicer) outlying hotel and drive the 10-20 minutes into the downtown area if i need to hop the ship.

just ok, but decent location upon arrival the power was out, so the computers and elevators were down. didn't get to check in until past 4pm, but she did give me free parking, which was normally 20$ a day in their back lot.the hotel is in pretty decent shape. i didn't try the food or the bar because right across the street is bayside and there are plenty of restaurants and bars there. this is not really a hotel for business as much as it is one for people getting ready for a cruise, as there is a harbor also across the street. everyone at the hotel was nice and the service was acceptable. although i would probably pick a different hotel next time, there is nothing significantly wrong with this one. note that the parking lot behind the building is small and costs money, so if it's crowded you will end up parking on the median on biscayne, and that's 20$ a day metered.

great pre-cruise stay the holiday inn port of miami was great choice as a pre-cruise hotel. the view i had from my room afforded me the opportunity to observe the cruise ships at the port. i also had a great view of the bayside marketplace. the room was very spacious and i had a very comfortable bed. the restroom was very clean and had everything i needed to get ready for my cruise. this hotel is a great value for someone who is either going to the port for a cruise or staying in miami for a vacation.

great views of cruise ship, good breakfast we stayed at the holiday inn port of miami for one night before taking a cruise on november 13. check in was a breeze - we got a room on the top floor with a port view. the room itself was more than adequate - comfy bed, lots of room and seating options (a chair and ottoman, a table with 2 chairs and a rolling desk chair). we had dinner across the street at bayside at hard rock cafe. it was wonderful to be able to cross the street and be somewhere nice. we awoke to the view of our cruise ship docked at the port - adding to the excitement of our trip!we ordered breakfast room service prior to going to bed for the night. we called the restaurant directly - do not use the hang card, there are not many options on there. it was delivered the exact moment we requested it and everything arrived hot and fresh.this hotel met our expectations. no, it's not fancy, but it was great for a short term stay!

good hotel before cruise we stayed at this hotel 2 nights before our cruise. we arrived late (after 11pm) and didn't have any problems checking in. our room was nice with a view of the bay. i thought the beds were comfortable and i didn't have any problems with noise. the hotel is right across the street from bayside market place so there are plenty of places to eat and you can do some shopping. we ate in the hotel restaurant for breakfast both days, it was a nice meal but i felt it was overpriced. overall i thought the hotel was nice, clean and in a great location. i would stay here again.

couldn't have asked for more! after reading many reviews of this property i wasn't expecting much, but i was pleasantly surprised. we arrived at 9:45 am and asked if we could leave our bags there until check in, they gave us a room right away.. the location and view was amazing, right across the street from the bayside market place and close to the beaches. i loved everythings about it. thank you holiday inn, we loved miami and your hotel.

disappointed with this hotel we stayed in this hotel for 2 nights in october '08 prior to our cruise. the lobby area was nice and bright but as soon as we got into the elevators we found there was a terrible musky smell.the rooms were dated and tired looking (i suppose much like ourselves when we arrived, having travelled a long distance from ireland!)breakfast in the dining room was very nice and the wait staff were friendly.my biggest gripe about this hotel is that on checking out on the sunday morning we waited at least 15 minutes for an elevator and even then when we eventually all crowded into one, luggage and all, it kept going up and down to the different floors opening the doors to let people on who couldn't because they were full.looking back it was quite funny because we kept seeing the same people waiting to get on at each floor and they were wondering why we were still there! now there is a notice on the elevator stating that they do get quite busy at check out times.we couldn't use the stairs even if we wanted to because this only brings you to an emergency exit. the hotel is obviously aware of the problem given the notice they have posted inside the elevator but yet seem to do nothing about it.you cannot bring your luggage down the night before you check out and get them to store it for you as there is a notice up about this also. therefore everyone is trying to cram into the elevator, luggage and all, on the morning of departure with two elevators at your disposal. i definitely would not recommend this hotel in view of the total chaos on check out morning.

port of miami great for pre cruise this hotel is in an old building but was clean in lobby and room. pool is undergoing renovation. you can walk to the bayside shopping area which has restaurants/bars and a food court. there are also souvenir type places and shops such as guess. you cannot walk to the the ship terminal as the bay separates the hotel/shopping area from the port. it was a $12.00 cab ride (two people) from hotel to ship terminal. breakfast buffet at hotel was typical and cost $12.95. there is macy's etc. 4 blocks from hotel but we did not check it out. there is a mcdonalds within walking distance of hotel. neighborhood around hotel is seedy.

pleasantly suprised at holiday inn stayed at the holiday inn pre-cruise for two days, based on some of the reviews here i was a little worried, i was pleasantly suprised the holiday inn was clean and my room was comfortable. the location is ideal, right across the street is bayside marketplace, they have music , numerous stores and restaurantsit's also a short taxi to the port.only one issue.. they were re-modeling the pool area during my stay so the pool was closed (kids were disappointed) and parking was a pain because the contractor re-modeling the pool was also using the lot for parking which meant less parking spots for guests.

okay, but some problems we booked this hotel almost 1 year in advance. we had stayed here 2 years before and had a great experience. this time was a bit different. the hotel is getting a bit run down. we had requested port view rooms and only gave us two rooms with port view. the other two rooms faced the mcdonalds in the back! the carpet is getting worn. the tile in the bathtub was stained. i am usually a big fan of this hotel because of location location location! but i probably won't stay again. the restaurant was around $12 per person for breakfast. so we walked to mcdonalds around the corner instead. if you consider this hotel, i wouldn't stay more than one night.the positives: directly across the street from bayside marketplace and close to port of miami. if you have port view, you can see your ship in the morning. perfect location for cruisers. easy to get a taxi in the morning.the negatives: the hotel is getting older. many people paid less for the much nicer intercontinental a few doors down. the staff wasn't too friendly or accomodating. there is plenty of noise from the street below and the music at bayside marketplace. housekeeping was lacking. one of our rooms had a couch sofa bed, behind the couch was plaster (or something white and crumbly) from the walls all over the floor. it was disgusting.

nice bang for your buck we checked in and were wonderfully surprised with the friendly service. jennifer was very professional, she answered all of our questions. our room was on the 8th floor facing the port, great view of our cruise ship. when i booked this hotel i requested a room on a higher floor just for the view. the pool area was small but very comfortable. we used the business center, its on the second floor, it was very clean. i also used the laundry area on the third floor, the in room flyer claims that its $1.50 per load. its not, it was $1.50 to wash and $1.50 to dry, plus a $1.50 for detergent. the beds were very nice and comfortable. the shower and nice pressure. we couldn't have asked for a better location. we also ate breakfast in the dining room. the breakfast was very good. we would definately stay here again!!

great hotel near cruise port! we stayed at this hotel one night before going on a cruise. i had used our holiday inn priority point's to book two suites. for an older hotel i was pleasantly surprised at how nice the room's were. we were given corner suites with a great view of the port and the marketplace. the suites had a good size living area with a kitchenette, a huge bedroom with a very comfy bed. the bathroom's were rather small, but had all the amenities a person could need. an in-room safe and a tv in the living area and bedroom. the pool area was rather small, but looked really nice.the only complaint i had was the room service for breakfast. it was not worth the money.maybe the breakfast buffet was better in the dining room. the great thing about this hotel is the location. all you have to do is walk out the front door, across the street to the marketplace. lot's to see and do here. we ate at the hard rock cafe. there were several eating establishment's there. wish we would have ate at one of the local restaurant's though. i think the food and service would have been better. they had local band's playing when it got dark and you could wander through the many vendor's with a nice cold daquiri if you wanted. a fun place to hang out the night before our cruise. i would like to point out a couple thing's about our trip that might help other visitor's to this area. we flew into fort lauderdale airport instead of miami. this was way cheaper. i had contacted larry's limo ( which has their own website,give them at least a couple day's notice) and they transported four of us from fort lauderdale to the holiday inn for $120 which included gratuity. i think taxi's were charging about the same and we traveled in style. we had a taxi take us to the carnival cruise terminal the next morning for around $15. we used larry's limo for our return trip back to the airport and it was slightly higher because they have to pay a port charge to pick you up at the cruise port terminal. he didn't charge you any extra for waiting for you to get off the boat. a great deal in my opinion. there were plenty of taxi's and van's outside the terminal if you wanted to catch a ride when you got off the boat though. i think anyone who is going on a cruise should spend at least a couple extra day's in miami. there is so much to see and do here. wish we would have stayed longer.hope i helped give a little insight into what there is to see and do in this area. happy travel's!
quiet stay good quality and cleanliness, suitable for families w/children and couples.it is not far from sobe.breakfast not too completehotel parking was full and we moved to a street parking.

not the hotel for you? the hotel is well located close to the shopping and restaurant area which was across the road. the check in was efficient and the small pool area was good to keep cool. the room and bathroom were clean and were of a good standard for the class of hotel.however i cannot recommend this hotel as it has very thin walls and this means that a good nightéˆ¥??? sleep is impossible due to the amount of noise. we were continually awakened by noise from through the walls and also from above and below. if a good nights sleep is important éˆ¥?well this is not the hotel for you.

very unpleasant.. our room on the 6th floor had a nice view of the ocean. but while we were there a big group of 150 teen tourists arrived from brazil and had absolutely no manners, the worse thing about that the staff did not do anything about their rude behavior. if you want to stay there do not go to the restaurant, you will not be happy with the food. the restaurant is only good for the breakfast buffet. there were also a few good things about the hotel. it was close to a beautiful beach and had a nice outdoor pool.

ok for 1 nigth we were for just 1 night, for shopping between flights. the staff was very kind. the check in time standard of hotel is at 3 pm, but we arrive at 11 am asking for leaving the baggage there while we went shopping and the have happily surprise us with the room already available!! the room is good, spacious and mostly clean. the bathroom a little old or without charm, but ok. the bad thing: the air condition was extremely high (not just in the room, also in lobby, elevator, all over!!), we turn it off but it wasn't enough.. another contra: they don't have a parking, so you must walk.. i recommend the one is in the bayside (across the street), not cheap but safer than others, especially at night.

nice hotel, nice staff we arrived at the hotel around 12:00 on sat. june 14th. but the rooms (3) weren't ready yet. we went across to bayside which was nice. we had lunch and did some shopping for our cruise the next day. around 2:30 we went back over to the hotel and the rooms were ready. all the rooms (4th floor) faced the port which was nice. we could see the ships that were in that saturday but the best of all was that when the next morning came we could see our ship. freedom of the seas. that night we all had dinner in the hotel. the prices weren't really that bad but alittle slow. not much to do around the area at night. some people on previous reviews talked about noise from bayside and street noise. we never had any problems with this. the hotel is showing some wear. the wallpaper in our bathroom was not in good shape with peeling and other small issues. as long as the bed has clean sheets (and trust me they get checked all the way down to the bottom), no nasty things on the floor or elsewhere, a working tv and not smelly i'm happy. listen we were taking my parents on their first cruise on sunday morning. i would not take them or myself to a nasty hotel. that should say it all. it's a fine hotel for pre-cruising. would i stay here for a week, no. a night, yes. it's close to the port and that is the whole point. a shuttle service (kmg) can be contacted for you through the bellman desk. we did this and it worked great. they picked us (7 of us, and alot of luggage) up on sunday morning at exactly 10:00 am. it was $55.00 which was not bad for all of us.
review of the holiday inn port of miami view of the port

great property! i stayed at this property from may 13 - may 16, 2008 for a conference that was taking place at miami dade college. this hotel was perfect. it had free internet access in the room and was within walking distance to miami dade college, bayside marketplace, american airlines arena, and downtown miami.the front desk staff was friendly, knowledgeable, quick, and efficient. we had breakfast one morning at the restaurant. the food and service were both great. the room was comfortable and clean. the only negative thing about this hotel is the parking. the parking is extremely limited. i would stay at this hotel again if the need arises. it was a pleasant experience.

good location for pre-cruise i stayed in the holiday inn port of miami in may '08 with 4 other people. we took a shared ride shuttle from ft. lauderdale airport, which cost us $18 pp. the room had 2 full size beds with 1 pull out queen sofa. there was plenty of room for the 5 of us for 1 night's stay. my only complaints would be that the room was a little stale smelling, but it was horrible.the location of the hotel was great for us. it is located directly across the street from the bayside market which is a big outdoor mall, with places to just hang and listen to live music. there wasn't anything else within walking distance, other than miami heat stadium.the hotel was pretty crowded, but we didn't have any trouble checking out the morning of our cruise. there were a few cabs lined up outside the hotel and it was only a 5 minute ride (about $6) to the port. i would definitely stay there again if i were cruising out of miami.

holiday inn bayside we booked this hotel for 1 nt. pre-cruise for april 3 2008 and were very pleased with the hotel.we arrived at the hotel at approx. 11:30 am which was 3 hrs. prior to their published check in time. we had booked it 3 mo. in advance and requested a room with a bay view but were told the rooms with a view were not avail.so we were given a room on floor 5 with no view.but we were allowed to go to our room at that time which was a plus to us as we wre tired from our flight.the room was small but very clean and we were happy with this hotel and if we stay in the miami area in the future we will gladly stay here again.we got a coupon for $5.00 off the breakfast buffet because of being priority club members and really enjoyed the breakfast.walked outside next morning to grab a cab to the pier at 11:am and were at the ship 10 mins.later

perfect pre-cruise hotel! we chose this hotel due to it's proximity to the port of miami for the night before the first cruise for our daughter and her children. i had requested rooms on a high floor facing the port and we were given rooms on the 10th floor next to each other which was perfect. the rooms were spacious, very clean and had the to die for view i wanted for this particular occasion. the front desk was very accommodating and check-in was quick and painless.the pool area was nice and the girls enjoyed it in the evening. it was possible to walk along biscayne blvd. about three blocks to the right and purchase a bottle of wine for the cruise and anything we had forgotten to pack at the walgreen's there.

good hotel and staff very helpfull we arrived at this hotel over 9 hours late as we had big flight delays leaving auckland new zealand.our arrival time was expected to 10pm in the evening but we did not arrive until 9am the following morning. the staff where extermly helpful and synpathetic to our sirtuatiuon. they allowed us access to our room so we could shower and and freshen up before our cruise left and a late cheeck out of 1am.we had breakfast in the hotel resturant and although it was costly if was execellent.this is a great hotel to stay pre cruise and the views from the hotel of the port are great.

not worth the price good location for a pre-cruise hotel. i used hotel points to book this stay. i'm glad i didn't pay what they were asking. the hotel is older, so the room could have used some updating. the sink fixtures were loose, the wallpaper looked like it needed to be redone, and the general condition of the room added to the look of age.the bayside area across the street came alive at night, so there's plenty to keep you busy. there are many restaurants, including hard rock, and many shops. our room did not face the bayside, so we did not have any noise issues. but the front desk did indicate that when bands play, that side of the hotel does get noisy.the hotel bar is small and so is the outdoor pool. the restaurant looked okay, though i didn't eat there.taxi to the hotel was $25-30.taxi to the pier was $15-20.i'm likely to look for a different hotel in this area the next time.

the staff and location was perfect! it was our first trip away from canada so we were a little scared and new at the whole traveling bit. needless to say our luggage somehow lost us on the way and we showed up at the hotel around 1am with nothing. we let the front desk know about our luggage and we were told it would be all taken care of should our luggage show up. the hotel staff offered us toothbrushes, toothpaste and other amenities to tide us over until morning. the hotel is right across the street from bayside market - perfect location!! we had a ton of fun eating, shopping and eating some more. when our luggage showed up the hotel tucked it away nicely for us and waited for us to get back to the hotel. check out was quick!cons: the view wasn't the best, we looked onto a parking lot...but hey, we were going on a cruise in a couple of days so we didn't care. the only issue we had with the room was the sound of a clock on the street - some grandfather sounding thing...bing bonging at 5am...not so great when we didn't get to sleep until at least 230am.rather far to malls - paid $40 to get to dolphin mall
good place to stay precruise! it was such a cloudy day!

loved it great location the holiday inn at the port in downtown miami awsome we stayed at the holiday inn with a group of 8couples for on night before our cruise.i was a little nervous after staying in south beach at the marriot for 525.00 a night.this hotel is very clean and the location is perfect.right across the street from the marketplace great , shopping and resteraunts very close to the port were the cruise ships leave. would stay there for pre cruising again over the crazy prices in south beach.

street noise unbearable! my family stayed here for one night before leaving on a cruise. the hotel was packed. our room was ok, but nasty black mold on the shower curtain. we faced the port and shopping area, and the entire night we were kept awake by honking horns, sirens, etc. we were on the 9th floor. noise finally stopped around 4 am. we were exhausted for our first day on the cruise. they had a decent buffet only breakfast, and the staff was helpful.

location, location, location we stayed here prior to taking our cruise. right opposite bayside market place and the aa arena.it is less than 10 mins by cab to the cruise port approx $16.miami int airport to hotel is approx 15 mins late night $23.check in was fast and friendly. good lobby area for waiting for anyone with plenty of seating.room was a good size with a safe and large closet. bathroom was clean but small.we were at the front of the building on the 6th floor. great view but the noise in the early hours of sunday woke us up. especially the shouting at 6am-7am. if wanting a good nights sleep then ask for rear of hotel room and forget the view.if you are cruising then take this advice. get your bags down stairs before 09.30. after that then be prepared to wait, sometimes up to 30-35 mins. they only have 2 elevators and come 10am, everybody is looking for them.you can leave them with the concierge and return for them before leaving for the port.
great pre-cruise pict of hotel lit up from bayside marketplace
don't stay here high priced, rooms very much in need of refurbishing, no internet (as advertised). one plus, the shower worked and thats all.

loved the port of miami a friend and i stayed at the holiday inn port of miami from feb. 24 to feb.29. we came in from a cruise to stay at the hotel, and it is quite near the pier. the hotel was clean, and the staff were all friendly and helpful. the pool area was small, but most of the time we were the only ones outside at the pool. the resturant was ok for breakfast and dinner, but closed at lunch time. the food was pricey, but then it is miami. the hotel is across the streel from the port of miami. this is a shopping and resturant outside mall. besides eating and shopping, one can charter a boat to see the harbor and/or famous homes.

good location for pre-cruise - but eat at bayside this is an older holiday inn in the port of miami. the location is great - a five minute taxi to the cruise ships and across the road from bayside which has lots of shops and bars with lively music and a nice atmosphere. one morning we sat at a cafe watching the pelicans and the dolphins swimming in the harbour.we had a room with a fabulous view across the bay. the room was clean with comfortable beds. slightly damp from the miami humidity - no heating so you need to switch off the air con to secure any warmth at all on chilly winter nights staff are great and very helpful, especially jairo the bell captain who goes out of his way to assist - and will book exactly the tours you want.the evening meal we had was not very good but bayside across the road has loads of choice for food.would recommend this as a short stay for cruises - great location.

fair hotel in a great location the hotel is perfect for anyone going on a cruise. we stayed after our cruise. you can see the port of miami from the hotel. bayside is across the street with great entertainment and great food options.front desk not very friendly. the hotel is not new, but did its purpose for us.

great location holiday inn port of miami is very central for both the city and the waterfront . the metromover is two minutes away and is free! the staff are excellent and the rooms facing the bay have wonderful views. there is a nice outdoor pool with loungers. a good choice when visiting miami.

below average hotel i'm writing this review as i sit in the hotel room so i don't forget anything. i stayed here once before a few years ago precruise. i wasn't impressed then but i hoped it would be a bit better this time around. we get the stay free through reward miles. if i had to pay i wouldn't stay here.the walls are paper-thin. i can hear the conversation going on in the room next door. i've lost count how many times i've heard doors slamming. it was freezing here the other night. tried turning on the heat only to find out the hotel doesn't have a heating system. froze under blankets all night. they never bothered to make up the room at all today, nor did they do any of the rooms of the other people in our party. we had to go down to the front desk to ask for more towels and toilet paper. when people are arriving and departing for the ships the wait for the elevators and check in/check out can be very long.their staff is friendly enough and the bed is comfy, and contrary to one of the other posts i read there is free wifi in the room but that's about as good as it gets.

not great... no problem reserving or checking in, staff was nice. after paying $188.00 i assumed it would be a fairly nice room, i was quite disappointed. the room smelt like mold/mildew, the beds were old and uncomfortable. the location is great but, because of that it was very loud early in the morning with cars and trucks.i would stay there again for 1/2 the price but i donéˆ¥??› think that will happen.cheers

good place to stay before a cruise we stayed at this hotel before boarding our ship for a cruise. the hotel is good value for money. the location of the hotel is very convenient and you can see the beautiful port of miami just from your room. in order to do that make sure you tell that you want an ocean view room when you arrive. those rooms are also larger.i would not recommend to have breakfast at the hotel. in front of the hotel there are several places were you can have a good breakfast for half the price. there is also a hooters, where you can order nice king crabs at reasonable price.the service at the hotel was friendly and in overall we had a good impression. we will definitely come back.
reasonablly priced and in a good location pre-cruise view from our hotel room - looking at the port

a little outdated, but great location ok, i have stayed here 6 nights during the past year. the hotel is a little dated and maybe needs to be modernized, but you simply cannot beat the location if you have business downtown or are taking a cruise. the port of miami is directly across the street and the view of the cruise ships is fantastic.rooms are about $200 per night, plus taxes and parking.not a bargain, but try some of the many surrounding hotels and compare the price.no wifi but they do have a bridge which allows in room internet access. small, 2 computer business center.hotel food in reasonably priced and very good.concierge is a wealth of information.front desk customer service can be irregular, depending on the staff on duty. few restaurants in the vicinity except across the street in the bayside marketplace...and many of those restaurants are very good (latin cafe, hooters, etc).

great location we stayed here because we were going on a cruise the next day. location was excellent for this. the market across the street was fun and easily accessible from our room. the area was a bit run down, but other than that a pleasant stay.

not bad... not a bad hotel for the price. its hard to find a reasonably priced hotel in miami. the rooms were clean and well equipped, but like most holiday inns, its needs a good renovation. staff were helpful and looked after any concerns. the hotel is in a great location right across from a large outdoor mall/market with great stores and restaurants. the miami heat play at the american airlines arena about two blocks away. you are also about 5 minutes (about $10) cab ride from the cruiseport. if you are looking for a good fitness room...forget it. computers in the business area are very slow and outdated. overall, not bad for what i paid.

good for pre-cruise my husband and i stayed at the holiday inn at the port, pre cruise, on jan. 1. we arrived around 1:00 p.m and when i requested a port view, she said we were upgraded to a suite. nice. we had a separate bedrom ,living room and small kitchen area with micro, frig, sink etc. it ws nice to have the extra room but since it was just a one night stay, not necessary. it was clean and very quiet. considering they were full, amazingly so. we were given a free buffet breakfast too, which was average. filling. being right across from bayside was nice, as we spent the afternoon and early eveing watching all the activities. there is a liquor store nearby so we were able to get a few bottles of wine for the cruise. (we cruised on oceania which allows you to carry on whatever you want. ) the front desk was helpful and the trip to the port was only ten dollars. a decent hotel pre cruise. nothing real fancy but location is what sells it. we'd stay there again for the convenience.

great pre cruise hotel this is a great hotel to stay at prior to a cruise. the location was very good, across the street from the bayside market place. the rooms are small but clean and serve their purpose. parking is limited and at an extra cost per day. hertz rental car is just around the corner from this hotel and offers a free shuttle to the port of miami. very good shuttle service pre cruise but very slow when debarking(others in our group booked hertz and had a hard time get ting a shuttle post cruise). it cost us $15.00 to get a taxi from the port to the thrifty car rental in south beach and took us only 30mins from the time we left our cruise room to the time we arrived at the car dealer. did not eat at the holiday inn restaurant but it was always busy. lots of restaurants in the area including a mcdonalds just out the back door of the hotel. would stay here again if we were to book another cruise out of miami!

pleasant and affordable we stayed in this hotel for three nights in december. it was pleasant and affordable, with decent parking. the best feature is that it is right across the street from the bayside marina mall. this gave us an easy place to go for food, hanging out, etc...

great pre-cruise hotel my husband i stayed at the holiday inn for 1 night prior to our cruise. the hotel is located right across from the bayside marketplace has a wonderful view of the port. we were given a 9th floor room with a lovely view of the port. it was cool to see our ship from our window in the morning! we arrived earlier than the posted check in time, but luckily our room was ready we were allowed to check in. the front desk staff was very friendly helpful. our room was clean comfortable. we were right across from the elevator but i didn't hear anything like i was afraid i would. with the bayside marketplace across the way, there was plenty to do within walking distance. the hotel has a nice pool dining room and we were given a card for a discount on breakfast the next day. we could not get on our ship until 1:30 so we had a few hours between check out leaving for port. the hotel stored our luggage for us so we could kill time without hauling all our stuff with us! overall our stay was very pleasant and we would stay here again before cruising.

good hotel , great location we had a one night pre-cruise stay at this hotel. its location is its best asset. you are across the street from bayside shopping and eating/entertainment. the hotel is clean and adequate for a short stay. it was a little noisy (we had a front facing room) but it was quiet after about 10.30pm. the staff were willing and helpful. we will certainly use this hotel again on our next pre-cruise stay!

local entertainment stayed at this holiday inn pre cruise with my wife and 2 children for the second time in two years. this hotel is located across from bayside as others have posted and makes it easy to get a meal and do some walking around the shops. when staying at this hotel you should be made aware that if there is any type of entertainment at bayside or the venue next to bayside and you have a room facing the port....it will be extremely noisy until about 2:00 in the am. since staying here the first time i inquired about any events happening when making this booking and was advised that none were scheduled. upon check in i asked again if any events would be happening during our stay and again told that nothing was scheduled. low and behold there was an event with extremely loud music which started at 8:00 and lasted until past 2:00 am. contacting management i found out that in fact the hotel did know of this event, but somehow had failed to notify their employees?????? management did compensate our bill for the inconvience which was appreciated, but it made for a very long night. listed below is personnal insight.1) this hotel is located in downtown (which is dirty) and is approx $20.00 cab ride to port2) no grocery store within the area3) liquor store 2 blks from hotel (expensive)4) elevator's are small, book a room on top floor to eliminate long waits 5) after talking with cabbie's found out that south beach is about 20 minutes away but if you stay on a weekend and drive or take a cab to south beach it could take over an hour due to traffic6) good breakfast bar7) port facing rooms have a great view of ships (freedom of the seas)(especially if you are awake when it arrives in the early am)
location, location, location! king room with queen sleeper sofa 1

nice hotel we stayed at the holiday inn port of miami one night before our cruise. the hotel is very clean and the staff were friendly and helpful. there is free internet access.. the beds were quite comfy. the smallish pool area was also clean and a pleasant place to sit and enjoy drinks. drinks were not available until 5:00 pm. breakfast was available in the hotel restaurant, the buffet was $10.95 per person. there is also a mcdonald's a block away in back of the hotel. the only complaint i had was that the coffee at the hotel was terrible! we were 3 women going on a cruise so we got a room with 2 double beds and an extra cot. the cot was $10.00. our room was very large and easily accommodated the cot. the best thing about this hotel is the location. it is right across the street from bayside marketplace. a nice spot along the bay with many restaurants and shops. there was live music playing on the sunday night we were there. it was a nice way to spend an evening before our cruise. i would recommend this hotel to family and friends and would stay here again.
great location for night before a cruise front of hotel (in the rain!)

great location-but everything else is just ok i am a platinum card holder with priority clubs. i called a day in advance telling them that i would be arriving early, which is a perk with club membership. when i arrived early a room was not available. ok, so i walked over to the bayside marketplace for a couple of hours and had lunch and shopped, while waiting for the other friends i was meeing to arrive. when i walked back to the holiday inn i tried not to notice the man sleeping on the sidewalk by the corner of the hotel. the room was clean, but the hotel is obviously old and in need of renovations. the pool is small, and outdoor but walled in with no view other than the inside of the restaurant. the only priority card perk you will get here is $5.00 off in the restaurant/per room. (alcohol not included) check the intercontinental just down the road if you want a nicer place for pre or post cruise. they view from our room was very nice, overlooking bayside and the cruise ships at the port. breakfast in the hotel restaurant was good.

great place to stay we recently stayed at the hi pom with 8/9/07 pre-cruise and this hotel more than met our needs. i booked 4 rooms for the 14 people in my party, we had 1 king 3 double rooms all with sleeper sofas, and each of the double rooms were spacious enough to accomodate up to 4 people and the king room up to 3. we arrived much earlier than the posted check-in times and they were more than happy to give us our room, the only thing was all rooms couldn't be on the same floor, which wasn't a problem for our group. my room was located on the 9th floor (901) and we had an excellent view of bayside marketplace the ships in port!!! the room was clean and odor free, we did run into a small problem with our door not locking and all it took was a call down to the desk and within 15 minutes someone was there to fix it.i will definately be staying at this hotel again.

great hotel for pre-cruise my family stayed here for one night before going out on our cruise on july 25,2007. i would highly recommend this hotel as the price isn't to bad and the hotel was nice and clean! i travel alot and am very particular about my rooms. i had no complaints what so ever!! excellent location and there is a very nice area with shopping and lots of places to eat right across the street!! lots of nightlife with music outside!! nice place to unwind after airports all day!! they have sleeper sofa's in some of the rooms which i had a hard time finding at other hotels. if you ask for a late checkout they will give it to you! a cab is easily accessed for your trip to the port!!

great for night before cruise my husband and i stayed here on saturday, june 30th, 2007 for one night before our cruise the next day. this is the perfect hotel to stay at the night before your cruise leaves. the hotel is right next to the port. a short cab ride over to the cruise terminals the next day (royal caribbean was our cruise) only cost like $10. the cab ridefrom the airport to the hotel is approx $30. the bayfront shopping market across the street from the hotel is great. we ate at lombardi's seafood for dinner in the bayfront market place and it was wonderful. i highly recommend the restaurant. there is lots of shopping in this market place and at night, it comes alive with entertainment, music and people. they have a hard rock cafe, a bumba gump shrimp and other nice little bars to visit and the bayside of the market. this hotel is clean and nice. ask for a room up high, you will be able to see the cruise ships in port, which is really cool. my husband and i had a king size bed room. it was up to standards of holiday inn. nothing special but nice clean. the hotel restaurant served an okay buffet breakfast. the hotel will check your luggage into a secure room if you have to check out and wait until its time to go to the boat. we used this service and that worked out really well. we checked out, left our bags at the hotel and went across the street in the morning for a little last minute shopping before the cruise. in short, i recommend this hotel very much if you are going on a cruise that departs from the miami port!!!!

great hotel for our pre cruise stay we arrived on saturday and stayed at the holiday inn port of miami. the hotel was great for our pre cruise stay , although it would be good for any stay. it was very clean and nicely decorated. the staff was very friendly. they have a restaurant with a good breakfast buffet and our sonéˆ¥??? was free. it is just across the street from bayside marketplace and only 5 minutes from the port. the bayside marketplace has lots of restaurants, cafe's and shops. it was nice to be able to just walk across the street for our evening entertainment. there is a concierge at the hotel who was helpful too.

great location!!! by far, the best thing about this hotel is its location! holiday inn port of miami downtown is the closest hotel to bayside market and to the port of miami. the hotel itself was what you would expect from a typical holiday inn/hampton inn/comfort inn, etc. nothing in the hotel blow me away, but i definitely can't give any negative criticism. the check-in process was great, and the room was nicely layed out large. my room was on the 10th floor and looked out on the bayside market (amazing view of biscayne bay and the causeways). i would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone and would return there myself.

great pre-cruise hotel! we stayed at this hotel last year at the end of september before a cruise, but i've just never gotten around to writing a review. so long time coming, here it is:i booked this hotel through their web site, and put in a request for a room on a higher floor with a bayside view. since i was just paying for a regular room, i wasn't sure if that would be honored. but when we arrived i was pleased to find out that they did honor that request and we had a great view of bayside marketplace and the port of miami. (very important when you're taking a cruise and want to wake up in the morning and see your ship there waiting for you.) this isn't a fancy hotel, but it was great for what i wanted. we were staying in miami for two nights before leaving on our cruise. my son and i felt safe in this hotel and walking across the street to bayside. (we even ventured down the block and around the corner to the people mover so we could take the metro line to the local museum. a little less safe feeling once we ventured away from the hotel bayside, but still was a nice little trip.)the rooms were nice, not too worn, but we couldn't get our windows open. (maybe they're afraid of jumpers??) be aware that if you are a light sleeper, you may want to bring earplugs because the doors automatically slam shut when you walk out of them and the banging can be heard from inside your hotel room. all around, i'd say it's a good place to stay before your cruise.

very happy!! i picked this hotel because at the time it was the only one that could accomodate 5 individuals. i read the reviews posted here and crossed my fingers.we arrived at 3:30 and the hotel was bustling but the staff handled it quite well. i requested a room on a higher floor and only had to wait 10 minutes before it was ready. the desk clerk was courteous and very helpful.the room was neat and clean. we did not use the pull out couch as the person slept on the couch but stated she was comfortable.loved the fact this hotel is across the street from the bayside. it was very easy to walk across the street to eat and shop. we were here during the heat's final playoff but never felt the area was crowded nor loudthe view from our room was spectacular. we woke up the next morning to see not one but two cruise ships (one had our name on it). when checking out we found the lobby was chaotic but the concierge was cool, calm, and comptent. he arranged car service for our ride to the pier. i give this hotel two thumps up

don't go on a saturday night! we chose this hotel because of the reviews wanting something convenient prior to our cruise. the room hotel is fine. it was nice to walk across the street to visit the shops at the bayshore marina. however, on saturday nights there is a constant blaring noise from the kids on the street with the music from their car steros. it continued until 1 am! the windows in our room were rattling! the hotel staff said it was a concert night - but talking to the locals, they said it happens each weekend. we were a group of 4 couples one couple had a room not facing biscayne blvd. their room was a lot quieter. we recommend that you request a room away from biscayne blvd.

best location, best downtown hotel...period! we have stayed at this property 7 times in the last year....you simply can't beat the proximity to the cruise port, american airlines arena and bayside marketplace. clean rooms, and we love the bayside view rooms. we won't stay anywhere else!

decent downtown hotel i stayed (by myself) at the holiday inn located at 350 biscayne boulevard, near the port and downtown miami for two nights; march 28-29, 2007; while attending a conference.the room was pretty decent, with a very large closet, comfortable single king bed, the usual small bathroom; but with my smoke free request honored. i had made reservations on-line and checked in fairly quickly. the concierge was friendly and helpful when i asked about walking to a recommended restuarant called garcia's; for seafood. he confirmed my choice but advised taking a cab, and he was correct. this is a very casual, locally patronized seafood place on the river, and was excellent. you should get a small order of stone crabs to go with the dinner in season. the hotel is across the street from the bayside marina, which is moderately hokey, but i had a pretty good italian dinner at lombardi's the next night.miami is a construction mess and difficult to get around. our conference was at the hyatt regency downtown, which was within walking distance.i thought the hotel breakfast was pretty weak for the price, and walked over to el cafe restaurant in the marina the next day. it was much better, although it does not open until 8:00 a.m., and the hotel restuarant opens at 6:30.the total bill (including all taxes but not breakfast) for two nights was $338.00. supershuttle to and from the airport is $16.00 pp + tip; and the cab websites said that the cab fare, per vehicle, is about $40.00; so for a couple it is about a wash.

we really injoyed our stay we stayed the night before our cruise. we requested a view of the port and was rewarded with a wonderful view. the market place across from the hotel was very nice to go out for supper. the only negetive thing we can about the hotel was the restuarant. we had breakfast in the morning, my husband and i shared a breakfast. the waitress just abuot threw a fit, it must of affected her tip that they automacticly put on the bill.

great view, but don't bring your car. booking the hotel was very easy. the good things about the hotel are it's close proximity to bayside, the american airlines arena, and bicentennial park for the ultra festival. both were in very easy walking distance. if you are lucky to get a hotel room high enough and facing the street and the bay the view is wonderful. the worst thing about the hotel is not enough parking! had i known that there were only about 30 places to park and that we would be charged $12 a day to park there, i would not have rented a car. when the when the lot is full the security staff and front desk are absolutely no help and couldn't care less what you do. you are supposed to park in a larger lot next door, and pay the lot people directly. you do need to let the staff know that you are parked there so you can be reimbursed for that night. however, if there is a special event going on in that area (in our case, a miami heat game) the parking fee for the lot next door (which is normally $12) shoots up to $40!!! there are a few parking ramps in close proximity, and meters out in front of the hotel, but you may not park there overnight. the staff is very aloof as well.

great value i always read reviews before booking any trips and have learned that you can take some of the reviews with a grain of salt..that being said, i have to say my husband and i are picky. i pre-booked this hotel a year ago and it was non refundable, so i was a little concerned after reading some of the reviews. we don't care if the room is 5 star but we can't tolerate bad customer service which was a major complaint in several reviews...we found the staff to be extremely friendly and as accommadating as anyone could be..the hotel was clean, the room was huge. we requested a high bay facing view and thats what we got. we had no problem getting elevators and the breakfast was a very nice buffet which was kept stocked and hot....bayside across the street has several wonderful restaurants. this was a great way to start our cruise vacation and i would most definitely return..the room was a little musty, but hey, you are in south florida..ps today i received a nice email from the holiday inn thanking me for staying there....if you have any questions, email me at cbchmbrln@ aol.com.

only average husband and i stayed one night pre-cruise in jan. i booked nearly 9 months in advance and asked for high floor with view and got 3rd floor, no view. can't hurt to ask.the hotel is in need of some serious updating and the front desk staff was less that helpful , including when we asked about a post office or stamps. sent us on a wild goose chase 5 blocks away. the room was okay for 1 night with the exception being that the couple in the room next door were having an escalating fight that started about 10:30. we finally called the front desk when it sounded like it might get physical, and they sent someone up and the argument stopped until the next morning about 6:30 am! walls are very thin. the couple on the other side were entertaining in regular voices but we still could hear their conversations.the service was very slow in the bar. bartender was distracted by the room service phone she apparently was answering that evening. we did not eat in restaurant.bayside market is directly across the street and would recommend it for eating, drinking, shopping and people watching. we stopped a several outdoor bar/grills and enjoyed watching the ships come and go. walgreens is several blocks down for anything you forgot. next time we will spend the extra and stay at one of the nicer hotels in the same area.

average 3 star with excellent location stayed one night before a cruise. an average 3 star hotel. a little dated, not great customer service and average rooms. bathroom was clean, bedroom carpet worn but not filthy. served just fine for one night stay. i would not want to stay here more than a night or two.location for pre-cruise is excellent. acoss the street from market - can find cheap dinner if you go upstairs to the food court. there is a walgreens drugstore about 4 blocks from the hotel. don't walk alone and go before dark. neighborhood is iffy.

don't recommend this hotel to anyone we stayed at this hotel after our cruise, the staff were not friendly, half of them didn't know english, most were spanish speaking. the room we had was horrible, we had asked for a queen or king, we ended up with 2 double beds which were so uncomfortable. the halls smelled of water damage, the walls in our room had water damage on them, with bubbles in the paint. we stayed there 2 nights because we had paid for it, after the first night, our room had not been cleaned yet and it was 4:00 in the afternoon. we don't recommend this hotel to anyone.

problems with staff we stayed here for three nights for our trip to the orange bowl. the property could use some maintenance and the attitude of the staff could definitely use some improvement. two out of the three nights there was no parking available for us. the night we returned from the football game, the guard who was locking up the hotel parking lot actually told us to go away! we told him we were hotel guests and had paid the $12.00 parking fee and he still told us to leave! we were left to find alternative parking after midnight in what can only be called a dodgy part of miami. i would not recommend this hotel based on location, facilities and staff.

close to cruise line nice hotel let down by rude and agressive staff my party of 9 arrived tired and hungry after a long journey from orlando we were not allowed to book in til 4.00pm, staff not interested that i had a young baby i needed to see to.head waiter was a rude aggresive misogynist , who clearly had ideas about his own importance. shouted at us across a packed resturant and abused us in spanish to one of his collegues, stupid man as i understood every word he said, when i complained to the manager i was offered free breakfast, however he did not apoligise, he continued to give me filthy looks and posture around the resturant . was so incensed by his behaviour escpecially to my elderly aunt that i wrote a written complaint before i left. but have not heard anything.hotel is well located for criuse ships, and although could do with some updating was.fine for one night. however i took my sons to the pool whilst we were waiting to book in, and after a while it filled up with black insecta that looked like beetles or roaches. took my sons out of the pool and complained nothing was done for a few hours and they merley scooped them out and said it wold be fine.i would ot return until they gave there staff accourse in customer service as the hotel on the whole is fine.

absolutely the best hotel in miami !!!!! loved it as i write you , i have just arrived home from the holiday inn, port of miami. it was the most comfortable, the best location. my husband , my 2 kids and i were in town for the wwe wrestiling, and just stayed overnight. the staff was wonderful, the parking was a little cramped but hey at least you know your not parking in an empty lot. the room was so clean, didn't smell, and the bed, usually i can't sleep because the bed is just horrible. but i was pleasantly surprised and the great nights sleep i had. we splurged and got the 1 king bed and sleeper sofa suite, and it was soooo worth it. we are already planning a weekend trip. this was the perfect location, i went shopping at bayside right across the street, great shops, great food, and their is a really nice starbucks their. again, in the end, perfect is the only word i can use to describe the staff, the hotel, and location..... i loved it...

loved the holiday inn this hotel was fabulous we stayed for a 1 night stay before a cruise....the staff was helpful in every way any questions asked we got an answer for it. the hotel was the right temperature it was nice and cozy and our room was the best we couldnt of asked for such and incredible stay.its in the ideal location its right across the street from bayside market place wonderful shops and a huge food court also prices were really good we had breakfast over at one of the food courts it was a big breakfast that 2 of us had to share to eat it.the hotel was right across the street caddy corner from the miami heat arena matter of fact they had a game that night we were there.there is alot to do over at bayside there are millionaire cruises and all that in the bay right there its a nice spot to go sit and eat a little dinner or lunch or have coffee or a drink.we would highly reccomend this place for a one night stay or even several days stay it was wonderful they also have a restaraunt and have a small bar also on the premises....nice pool also right outside the dinning area.we could not say enough of how happy we were with our stay there.
good hotel - just watch calls nice hotel, but don't use the in room phone to call international, the rates are huge! buy a phone card in bayside and call from a pay phone.

exceeds expectations we stayed at this hotel for one night before a cruise. the rooms were spacious, clean and comfortable. our room was on a high floor and overlooked the port and gave a good view of the cruise ships.breakfast was buffet style and plentiful. if you join holiday inn rewards scheme before making your booking you'll receive a discount on the hotel food.check out was at 11am which made the lifts very busy and we witnessed some queues. however, we checked out at 9 and stored our luggage at the hotel which has hassle free.the shopping centre opposite the hotel is great for a one night stay. shops, bars and eating places. would stay at this hotel again without doubt.

convenient in staying pre-post cruise we booked this hotel by calling holiday inn because their website was not allowing us to book. to our surprise when we arrived at the hotel, they had booked 2 rooms instead of one and since the rate was non-refundable they didn't want to reimburse the second room. after waiting 15 minutes while the staff member spoke with the manager, they did credit our account...however they did not apologize and made it seem like it was our fault and they were doing us a favour. otherwise the hotel is very convenient if you wish to stay a day pre or post a cruise. bayside marketplace is across the street...shopping, restaurants, entertainment and boat tours are found there. we were told by locals to stay at bayside and not go to downtown miami after 6pm as it is dangerous. the taxi to the port is a flat rate of $10. the taxi from the airport around $35.the rooms were clean, beds comfortable, bathrooms brand new. but walls were paper thin and everything could be heard from our neighbours.

convenient location reviews of this hotel seem somewhat mixed but we were very pleased with it. we arrived at 7.30.pm after a transatlantic flight but without our luggage which decided to spend an extra day at heathrow. the lady on check in was very kind and gave us a large bag of toiletries saying we could keep any we didn't use. check in was quick and efficient and my requst for a higher floor room overlooking bayside was provided. we stayed here 4 nights prior to a cruise and whilst miami isn't really a city break destination this is very good for that purpose being opposite the shops and restaurants of bayside and a very short stroll around the corner to the metromover which takes you for free all around miami including about 4 stops away right to macys door literally! we didn't eat at the hotel other than breakfast which was fine. the service, cleanliness, comfort of the beds and condition of the hotel were good also. we hired a car and parked in the secure staffed area to the rear (which has direct access to the hotel via the swimming pool area). overall, whilst not having any gimmicks or flash facilities this proved to be a pleasant and relaxing start to our holiday and as such is recommended for someone wishing to be in the downtown area - though not, of course, near miami beach.

hotel staff is the worst! check in at 3:00??? we had to wait until after 5:00. i just wanted to get to a room. we booked 9 months in advance and no consideration was given to our room request. you get what they assign to you and like it. there is no help in the hotel, the lobby was full of irate guests, rooms are assigned in alphabetical order in the morning of check in. my last name begins with t so i know that at any holiday inn, i am not likely to get my room request because i will always be at the bottom of the list. it makes no difference how far in advance i book it or what i request. i will get what they give me. i can book a room anywhere for less money and get boiler room accommodations.priority club membership means nothing, requests mean nothing, speaking to the manager means nothing, and check in time means nothing. i will never again book any kind of holiday inn hotel.jan

great location! the start of a 10 day break in florida and we really couldn't have booked a better starting point. reception staff were friendly and speeded us through so that we were in our room within 10 minutes - great view straight across bayside marketplace and bayfront park.room was clean and considering the location much larger than we were expecting - one king bed with the remaining space taken up by sofa, table, chairs etc where another king bed could have gone!restaurant is ok... dinner menu is quite limited and one or two strange combinations but the food was good (we really didn't fancy venturing out on the first night after a 9 hour flight). breakfast is typical holiday inn, either served as a buffet (weekends i think) and regular hi breakfast menu the rest of the time.all in all an enjoyable place to stay in downtown ideally placed for shopping and people watching at bayside - and don't forget the boat tours of millionaire's row available directly opposite. the hotel is also only minutes from the cruise terminals of the port of miami, and around 20 minutes from the airport (plenty of roadworks and building going on while we were there), and just a short distance to the new carnival center for performing arts.

nice hotel and nice location! we stayed here for 2 nights pre cruise, and it was wonderful!everyone was very nice to us, it was a clean room which is very important to us more than anything else.my husband and i had never been to miami, so we were hoping from reading all the reviews that we picked a good hotel and this hotel met all our requirements.we also liked that we were right across the street from bayside and we were able to go to the outside mall, since we didn't have any experience in miami we were not sure of our surroundings and was not sure if it was safe to go out at night, all we had to do was go out of the hotel and walk straight and we were able to eat and go to the mall.i would recommend this hotel to anyone, we really had a nice stay!

great hotel! we stayed here one night pre-cruise on april 8, 2006. we checked in around 9pm on a saturday night and was given a 10th floor room overlooking the port and the bayside marketplace which is right across the street. i signed up for the holiday inn rewards club when i made the reservation through the ichotelsgroup website so upon check-in i was given a card for $5.00 off any meal purchased in the restaurant. our room was excellant - looked like they could have fit 2 queen beds in it but we only had 1 king bed - sheets were clean and linens were clean, so no complaints at all about the room. checkout on sunday morning was a madhouse -- if you have lots of luggage i would suggest asking for a room on the top floor - we didnt have that much luggage but as the elevator made stops at each floor and the doors opened, we saw the frustrated looks on people's faces from floors 9-2 that seemed to me like they had been waiting for a free elevator for a looooong time. note: there are only 2 elevators...2 very small elevators.breakfast in their restaurant was okay - you could choose to have the breakfast buffet or order off the menu. the buffet was alright - my fiance had the skillet breakfast from the menu and he found it very tasty.there is a walgreens about four blocks away from the hotel that we walked to easily. i would definitely stay in this hotel again!
much better than expected the tea room at vizcaya

brill hotel for pre-cruise!! we stayed here for just one night before a cruise and it was top value! it is a perfect location as you have the bayside marketplace just across the road and the marina etc. we ate out of the hotel at the bayside marketplace, there is a lot of choice of shops, bars, restaurants and a real nice place to go out. the cruise port is approx a 5min drive away in a taxi. the hotel itself was very clean and nice. i would definately stay there again so would reccomend to anyone!
great cruise hotel view of the port

great for a cruise hotel if you are going on a cruise and plan to arrive in miami the day before your cruise this hotel is an excellent choice. if you are going to stay more than one or two nights choose another hotel.the positives to this hotel is that it is incredibly close to the cruise terminal and is right across the street from bayside market which is a fantastic place to spend a day. we found the room to be very clean and the king sized bed was very comfortable. the downsides are that other than bayside market there is nothing else around to visit and the downtown area is not all that nice to walk around. the doors in the rooms have automated closing devices and the doors slam shut which is very loud. all in all not a great hotel but its location is just too good to pass on.

it was just ok my mom and i stayed here before a cruise in jan. 06. maybe we were just there at a bad time. one of only two elevators was working, which was difficult when everyone was trying to get out of their rooms and down to the first floor at the same time. had we not been in a hurry that morning, it wouldn't have been that big of a deal. we ended up walking our luggage down six flights of stairs. the breakfast (and service at breakfast)was terrible and expensive. either they don't have heat or the heat didn't work. i know that usually you don't need heat in miami, but that night it would have been nice. again, i'm sure we were just there at a bad time. it was in a nice location for us since we didn't have a car. it's right across from the marketplace with shops and restaurants so that was great!
