budget hotel - deceived by tripadvisor ratings this hotel was run down. the service was mediocre. the beds were advertised as new comfortable beds. they were not...we could not sleep on our squeeky, sloping beds. most of the dishes at the continental breakfast were dirty. elevator area was very dirty, the walls were soiled. concierge is available during day, bellmen take over in the evening. bellman could not provide any information, even approximate time/distance info. to ronald reagan library 40 minutes away. eye level wall vent in bathroom had an inch of accumulated dust/dirt/debris in it.i would not return to this hotel.

great ! have just spent 3 nights here on a stop over to australia . this hotel is great ! large rooms with very comfotable beds , the hotel has put a great effort into it's sleep programe , including sleep packs in the rooms and even cd's to help aid sleep and relaxation , which they are more than happy for you to take with you . make sure you join the priority programe before you visit as it includes a free breakfast which was a great money saver , it's also served in the members lounge which is a bit quieter on a morning .room service was great , and not too bad value for money ( gorgeous pizzas !) i agree with the previous poster , we also walked to rodeo drive and felt perfectly safe , i can recomend eating there as well , we found a pavement cafe and got lunch for a very resonable price , it was worth the money alone just to people watch . the hotel can arrange your transfer to the airport , which is the same price as a taxi , but you get to go in a limo which is much more comfortable . the staff were great , but they did sometimes struggle to understand a yorshire accent ! i would definatly stay here again.

a but shabby and not chic we stayed here for one night in december and i would have to say i would not stay here again. we did get a good rate from lastminute, so for the price i can't complain too much. the lobby is nice enough but the wallpaper in the hallways is peeling. there were dishes and plates all along the floor in the hallway. the rooms were okay, nothing special. the hotel is located in an area that's off the beaten path. there are restaurants in the hotel and down the road but i just didn't feel comfortable walking there at night with just my young son. the staff was all nice enough, no problem there. we stayed at loews beverly hills(around the corner) a few weeks before and it was more expensive but much nicer.

very comfortable stay after a long flight the crowne plaza was a welcome relief, beautiful lobby, helpful staff, a huge room with nice city views and the most comfortable bed i have ever slept on. we got a priority club upgrade, which included a nice breakfast and a sleep pack.please ignore people who say you can't walk anywhere. we walked for about 25 minutes without problems to rodeo drive, even though it was after 6pm and dark, had a fab browse around saks, barneys and some of the boutique shops that were still open and then stuffed ourselves silly at a mexican restaurant about five minutes' walk from the hotel.the next morning we hopped in a limousine arranged by the hotel for a three hour tour of hollywood hills, the chinese theatre, a few famous peoples' houses and so on. the same limo then took us to the airport for our flight back to london. doing this saved us quite a lot of money and was much more convenient.is it the lap of luxury? no. was it a comfortable stay, most definitely.

somewhere between very good this is the second time i've been here on business. i like the fact that they have free wifi internet. and what everyone has said about the staff? i double that. extremely courteous. i only had occasion to eat one meal (room service) and it was excellent. i was on the club level. the room was fine in terms of size. the connecting door is a disadvantage, ie: the tour of italians returned at two in the morning, hammered, and sat next door and laughed for an hour. very loud. for me, the location was great. my client is right up pico about five minutes. i'd recommend this for people who have never been to so cal and are here on tourism. of which there seem to be quite a few here.

very nice staff my daughter was having surgery the day i checked into the hotel and we had decided to stay overnight here to make things easier for her and me....the staff was extremely accomodating and very understanding..the refridge that i asked for was brought up immediately and everyone, from the valet to the front desk to housekeeping were very polite and nice..the shower did not work properly, however...it got cold right away and i thought the valet parking was a little steep at $18 (self park was $14) for such an inexpensive hotel..we paid $115 (aaa rate)..but i would recommend it here..the location to rodeo dr. was a hop, skip, away from this hotel..a great bargain and it was nice and quiet too..i ordered food from their restaurant and the ceaser chicken salad had tons of chicken in it, for a change so that was a pleasant surprise also..the amenities were very nice also and we got to keep a pretty silk type bag containing a mini lavender scent sheet spray, ear plugs and a black out eye mask, which was really cool..i have stayed in much more expensive hotels and never received this kind of amenity.

great hotel having read reviews about moderately priced hotels in la i was worried about reports of unsafe neighbourhoods, unfriendly staff and dirty rooms (one reported dried blood on the bedhead). i chose the crowne plaza beverly hills because of generally positive tripadvisor reviews, its location and access to good public transport and i was not disappointed. i can thoroughly recommend this hotel. the staff were friendly, the rooms very clean and the beds were so comfortable i had trouble getting my daughter up in the mornings! we joined the hotel chain's priority club and received a complimentary breakfast each morning which was more than adequate and saved us dollars. the bathrooms were a little small and needed updating but they were fine. there was easy access to the city bus system with the big blue bus-stop to santa monica beach just around the corner and the metro to downtown outside the front door. we were in walking distance to rodeo drive. we had no trouble getting around using the public transport system and enjoyed our stay in la and at the crowne plaza.

roll out the red carpet! i can say i truly enjoyed the hotel. upon checkin there is a beautiful lobby, and vallet service is efficient and friendly (only a few more dollars per night!) i would recommend doing the whole vallet thing because the parking garage is a bit of a pain. we probably used the vallet service 3 or more times per day of course coming in and out to see all the different area attractions. the rooms are just average (used to be a holiday inn) although the beds are luxury! first good night sleep i'd had in awhile! no fan in the bathroom, no mini-fridge or wetbar, no balcony, although there are beautiful views of the beverly hills downtown area. i wouldn't recommend walking to rodeo drive. you'll need a car in l.a. there's no complimentary breakfast (you have to be a priority member.) the business center came to a convenience although there is a a charge to use it. the pool was too cold in october i don't think it's heated but we got drinks from the bar and enjoyed the whirlpool jacuzzi! this is a good place to stay for the cost i think we paid $100 per night. i would recommend it more for business than pleasure.

totally disappointed! i've booked a room because of its name : crowne plaza, but what i found was a terrible hotel. the room was dirty and smelly. i asked in the front desk for another room but they did not have one at that moment. on my 3rd day, the bathtub starts to flood. i asked again for another room and what i got was another dirty and smelly room, stained towels, smelly pillows, used band-aid in the floor...on the check out i have filled the guest survey but never had an answer for my complains...so...i would not stay here if someone paid me to!

friendly hotel! i stayed at the beverly hills crowne plaza during october 2005 for 2 nights. as a priority club member (membership is free!), guestrooms are on the top two floors and breakfast is provided free of charge on the lobby level. if you're a fan of big hotel buffet breakfasts then the priority club breakfast is not for you! it consists of cereals, a fruit platter, toast, a few types of pastries (croissants, apricot danish, cherry danish), fruit juice and coffee. i stayed on the 11th floor and the views of beverly hills were very nice and expansive. rooms on the left side of the hotel will give you views of downtown. the hotel pictures do not do the rooms justice- they are plush rooms with the most comfortable beds and very warm furnishings, plus the welcome pack is very nice! the location in beverly hills is excellent, an easy five minute walk to major restaurants and clothing shops with rodeo drive around the corner. being los angeles, nothing is going to be close without a car anyway so being in a nice safe neighbourhood with eateries in close walking distance is very comforting! there are buses on the main strip just left of the hotel going to santa monica and downtown.

very comfortable stayed here for 2 nights from 22nd oct to 24th oct.staff where very friendly and helpful.restuarant, although not a great selection of choice overall food was of high standard.location is very good, within walking distance of restautants.overall very comfortable and pleasant stay and would most definately come back here again.

satisfactory place to stay beautiful lobby, scary garage that is detached from the hotel. rooms are average size with nice beds. only high speed internet access with no other options or bridges. locations is shady, but near other hotels. rate is cheap.
great location after a 14 hour flight from australia, the crown plaza was a welcome relief.great location and brilliant staff. rooms were roomy and bright. brilliant view too.would stay there again.

crowne plaza generally good we had a short stay at the crowne plaza and found it to be a pleasant hotel and good value for money. it had comfortable beds, plenty of towels and all the usual amenities. the cd player was a bonus. the in-room coffee was awful. the only thing we missed was a refrigerator in the room.the location is excellent. you can walk to a variety of restaurants, shops, and a supermarket, though all the distances are rather long. a bus to downtown via the restaurant area stops outside and various other bus lines are not too far away. there is even a bus from beverly hills to the airport, but we did not use it. presumably if you were on a tight budget you could (buses $1.25).the staff were friendly and efficient, with one exception: we tried to book a tour, but instead of telling us that it was not available, the concierge first tried to get us to do it by limo, and then rather aggressively started to sign us up for a different tour. also, another concierge was very reluctant to get us a taxi and wanted us to take the hotel's car ($40). we insisted on a taxi, and it turned out to be cheaper ($28).

great location this hotel is in a great location for rodeo drive. lovely clean rooms, excellent pool area and freindly staff.it is also on 2 major bus routes that link you with downtown los angeles, the la subway and santa monica. to get to downtown la/subway the bus stops right outside the front door. to get to santa monica go around the corner to catch the big blue bus on pico blvd. the best thing is it is 75 cents to go anywhere on these buses. buy a daily travel card for $3 and you can use any bus or subway all day. this was the only hotel we saw in such a good location for public transport. if you do not fancy public transport there is a taxi rank right outside the door.

3 and a half our of 5 i would actually give this hotel a rating 3 and a half if i could.overall the hotel is good - slightly above average, but nothing spectacular - good value for money though.the lobby could do with a redecoration but the rooms are grand - clean, modern, bright and spacious.the staff and friendly and eager to please - we organised a tour to disneyland through them and had no problems.we didn't want to drive in la, so the location is out of the way from most tourist destination (apart from beverly hills obviously). but it was our choice not to drive, so i wouldn't hold this against the hotel. if you hired a car and were willing to put up with driving in la you'd have no problems. hotel is near bus routes to santa monica/venice so this was good (although you always get weird looks when you ask how to go anywhere in la by public transport - it's just assumed you're looking for driving directions!)on the otherhand the location was good in terms of being nice and quiet at night and away from the madness of hollywood etc. also there are lots of good resturants near by, within 15 mins walking distance, and not that expensive for beverly hills.definitely sign up for the priority club as this is what gets you the free breakfast - well worth it!

fanatstic luxury hotel loved this hotel. felt like a 5* when we arrived. great staff - parked cars, carried bags, efficient check in, etc. the hotel was nicely decorated and had a great bar, fitness equipment, pool and spa. although they were small they were in good condition. thr bedroom was fantastic, really large with all modern facilties. great freebies too. breakfast was basic but nice and was included in the price. we had great views of the area from our room, especially at night when the city was all lit up. i stayed here for a few nights but would have liked to have stayed longer. i would definitely recommend the hotel and would stay there agian myself. i thought the location was fine but you would need to drive there really - but don't you need to drive everywhere in la?

great location, nice hotel we stayed at the crowne plaza from august 27 to 31.location was great, just 15 minutes walk from rodeo drive and 5-10 minutes to nice bards and restaurants. not at all a bad location as a person mentioned.we requested a room on high floor with nice view and got a room on 10 floor, great view to downtown. other side of the hotel (pool side) would give view to beverly hills homes, but we loved downtown side.make sure you get a room on high floow, otherwise you have vierw to next building.only thing we missed is an inroom safe. thius should be standard.beds are great, you also get a relaxation cd you can use in the rooms cd player and a nice linen spray.bathrooms are averaged, they need some modernization.service was good, staff always very helpful. if you are priority club member (free membership, make sure you sign in before you arrive) you get free continental breakfast in lobby. sleection is limited but ok. tried buffet breakfast once, also fair price but if you have breakfast in the area its better.there is a supermarket next block, you can also get everything there.pool area is nice, during weekend they sometimes run out of towels and deckchairs, during weekdays its ok.if we go to los angeles again, we devinitively will stay there again.

nice hotel, bad location hotel:- 1st class , great service- typical crowne plaza decor- very clean- pool a little small, no characterlocation:- not good! - remote area, you must walk to everything! even rodeo drive is 15mins walk, not as close as it seems

excellent value in beverly hills i visit la 2 or 3 times each year. the crowne plaza isn't our first choice hotel, mainly because it is more of a business hotel and we prefer a destination hotel which this one clearly isn't.however, when we do stay here we are always pleased with the property, cleanliness, service and value for money.for out of town visitors wondering just how close this hotel is to beverly hills, you will not be dissappointed. beverly drive runs parallel to rodeo drive and if you walk about a half mile, you will be in the main shopping and restaurant area of beverly hills.the parking is plentiful (although the headroom is a little low for extra large suvs with roof racks).the club floor breakfasts are great if you can get an upgrade and the staff are discrete and the free wifi is handy.some of the rooms have a not too exciting view but if you ask, the front desk will likely give you a high floor facing in the right direction if they can.the hotel is on the 'crew hotels' list for a bunch of major airlines so there are often flight crew wandering around in the lobby. the pool is fine but is in the front of the hotel adjacent to the registration parking area. this isn't really a problem but adds to the feeling that this is a business hotel where they have installed a pool so they can say they have one.anyway, if you are looking for a good value hotel in beverly hills where you don't want to stand on ceremony or star spot, then the crowne plaza is for you.

fantastic stay at the crowne plaza we stayed at the crown plaza beverly hills from july 20 - 23 and had a wonderful time. from the moment we set foot in the door to the time we left, all the staff were friendly and the facilities were excellent.just as a tip to all future guests - make sure you sign up for the priority club (free to join). this entitles you to free breakfast each morning and there are dedicated floors within the hotel which are especially for priority club guests which have better views comfier beds!the location of the crown plaza is around a 25minute walk to rodeo drive and approximately $30-$35 taxi ride to chinatown and downtown hollywood and approximately $25- $30 to universal studios. this means that if you do not have your own transport, getting around could be difficult. we were very impressed when one day, we wanted to go to universal studios and were contemplating taking the bus/train, one of the hotel staff members who had just finished work for the day offered to drop us off to universal studio's on his way home as he lived in the area. overall, the level of customer service we received from all staff members at the crown plaza was excellent and i would definately recommend others to stay here also.

this was our oasis we stayed at this hotel from 06/27 until 06/30 and found it perfect.la is a very lively city with lots of traffic and it was nice to get back to this hotel after each hectic day.the staff is very courteous,the rooms wer clean,the bed comfortable,and the neighborhood very quiet and at walking distanceto rodeo drive.if we go back tola,we will definitely go back to this wnderful hotel.we felt at home at this hotel.

ok but expected more... my husband and i stayed at the hotel for two nights in may 2005. the service was really very good all around. the bellhops and concierge were exceptionally helpful in arranging sight-seeing tours for us. the location is very convenient as others have said. but we were disappointed in our room. for the the crown plaza brand and price we were paying (which was not as inexpensive as some of the rates ié?“ve seen on this review board) we expected more. the carpet was worn out looking, the furniture and decor were holiday inn basic, the bathroom looked like it really needed an overhaul, the shower curtain was dingy and poorly hung, the towels didné?“t look very clean and were rough and worn out, and our air conditioning unit had seen better days. i think the hotel rooms should be renovated to maintain integrity with its brand. and it wouldné?“t hurt to increase the temperature on the laundry setting and use some fabric softener.i may stay there again, but not if i can get a room around the corner at the avalon.

great accommodation we found this place to be perfectly adequate. it wasn't luxury of the highest scale, but it was very nice. we arrived late and the staff were very helpful in getting us settled. the rooms were very clean and i would have no objections in recommending this place.

amazing service what a pleasant surprise to obtain a wonderful rate in beverly hills but most importantly discovering a staff who just couldn't do enough for you. the front desk, the maids, wait staff, concierge, etc., all went out of their way to accomodate any of our needs or requests. this type of attitude of wanting to please really made our stay there a nice experience. i would definitely stay there again. they just did so many little things that added to our first visit to the los angeles area. it was located on s. beverly bl which was also convenient walking distance to grocery store, drug store along with some restaurants and shopping. tours also picked up there.

nice hotel, great location this is a nice hotel, just south of beverly hills proper. built in 1974, it shows its age, with small bathrooms and limited space in and around the bedrooms. with a nice sitting area, bar / lounge and a prefunctory restaurant, it's a perfect location for a good nights sleep and over 40 restaurants within an easy walk. the staff is attentive and alert. demi in the bar area always keeps people laughing, and carmen at the front desk is a dreamboat with a winsome smile. norberto, the bellman is prompt and knows the locations in los angeles, to find the best foods and nightlife. the concierge is rarely stumped by the most obscure questions, and seems overqualified for this property. he can make it happen ! management is always there to see to your requests, and the area is quiet at night, and the views are spectacular. request an even numbered room, at least above 6 floors, and you'll enjoy a sunrise view of the los angeles skyline, all the way to chavez ravine. if you prefer a lower floor, opt for a west view( odd numbers ), of century city and beverly hills to your north. sleep advantage program has lavendar sprays and sleep cd's in every room. you'll get a good nights sleep, at a great price, close to everything.

crowne plaza not regal! hotel was ok. not great. room with 2 double beds is cramped.bed next to the bathroom; just enough room for the door to close. not private; could hear bathroom noise. bathroom not spotless! water did not drain while taking shower; toilet ran and made noise all night. front desk staff indifferent. breakfast buffet was good and breakfast staff very good.overall disappointed.

good visit at crowne plaza the hotel is located about 1-1.5 miles from rodeo drive in a quiet neighbor hood. there is not much to do around the hotel at night. this is a safe area. you can walk to rodeo drive but given the amount of parking in that area, i would probably drive next time.i was not sure what to expect from a crowne plaza so i was pleasantly surprised when i found a good clean lobby and a very clean room.the staff was very friendly and helpful. the continental breakfast was part of the package and gave us a good start in the morning.the shower was ok, as i was competing with someone else for hot water as my shower was hot and cold.there can be some traffic on busy pico street. we were on the 11th floor and slept the nights without problem.overall, it is a good hotel. i would recommend this to others especially families who want a good nights sleep after a long day of sight seeing.

adequate place to stay/watch your credit card though a friend and i stayed at this hotel in early april 2005.....i expected more from the crowne plaza brand.....i think this hotel used to be a holiday inn....then changed into a crowne plaza.......the room was an adequate size.....bathroom adequate....etc....no frills.....the location is great though.....a reltively short walk to rodeo dr, etc......i would definately recommend renting a car.....the beaches are a close drive.....but i think your own car just makes things easier......make sure you join the priority club, for that you get a free continental breakfast (that is actually good)...$10 parking.....and a room on a higher floor......which is cool, to get the whole la effect......everything was just peachy, until on our second day i went to the atm....had no money in my account.....called the bank.....they told me crowne plaza had put a $1,092 authorization on my account....hello!....panic!.....(should have only been a $546 hold) after an hour on the phone (while @ universal studios) it got partially taken care of......the management seemed concerned.....but didn't express it very well...to me, the panic stricken tourists in his 2nd day on a week long vacation and no money $$$$$$.....all in all, i think i'll give them a second chance on my next stay.....make sure you ask for the internet rate of $98.46.....great rate for the area..

great hotel, room, service and location we stayed here for 3 nights and had become a priority club member before we arrived (free to join). room was upgraded and complimentry breakfast in priority club lounge. great location if you have a car as very central and reasonable priced parking at the hotel. would go back again and recommend to others. wireless internet also available free of charge.

pure bliss stayed here march/april 2005 w/ our 3 children....this hotel is extremely clean, friendly and had the most comfortable sleeping arrangements i have ever experienced in a hotel. we have stayed many places including ritz carlton's in other cities. crown plaza was top notch! we had a 2 room suite on the 12th floor...paid 200/night...had fridge, micro...and rooms were incredibly quiet! this hotel has what they call a sleep advantage program. upon arrival you find an entire relaxation kit on your bed complete with cd (a nice player in room), lavender spray, eye mask, and ear plugs....we never used ear plugs of course as rooms were soo quiet! each room had own temp control unit and worked very effeciently....room service food was outstanding and on time. breakfast buffet was an ample spread and had a european flair with fresh deli meats on it and yogurt with real fruit in it was always available--a hit with the kids. the pool could have been warmer, but the kids did not care and we really weren't there to swim anyhow...the hot tub was perfect though! as far as walking distance to attractions, i would not stay here if you don't want to walk. we drove everywhere--rented an expedition thru budget for $230 for whole wk! the hotel has a rental car business in it but very expensive. ($79/day for a sequoia) overall, this was the most comfortable hotel i have ever been in. maid service was impeccable and i am going to miss those pillow top beds....(my own at home isn't the same!) oh-one more thing--the hotel has a convenient little pantry right in the lobby... gifts, snacks, medications, pool toys...most items were pricey of course being in the hotel, but ohhh how convenient when we needed a beach ball for pool fast! and we only paid $2 for it! definately reccomend this place to business travelers as well as families alike!

excellent wonderful hotel. clean. neat. upon check-in....we received a call....as to whether everything was acceptable. it was. for the location and the room....it was an excellent value. my two daughters stayed there and they were pleased as well. we did not eat in the restaurants because our schedule called for us to be out of the hotel. john the concierge was very helpful and kind. down-to-earth sort of fellow. parking was easy. i will be pleased to stay there again upon my next visit. it will making going back to beverly hills uncomplicated and pleasant.

loved this hotel stayed here in february and had a room with a great view. their web site says rodeo drive is .2 miles but someone misplaced the period as it is at least 2 miles. we walked both ways as we are walkers but even we found it a little much. lots of restaurants just around the corner from the hotel with a choice of fast, thai, deli, pizza or fine dining we paid $67 on priceline and felt we had a super deal.

excellent hotel easy parking. excellent front desk and check-in. nice quiet room. great location. many restaurants within walking distance. easy driving to all parts of los angeles. i will be staying at this hotel as often as possible.

everything was perfect!! our family and another family stayed here in feb 2005. i can't say enough about this hotel. i chose it based on location and reviews from this site and was a little nervous because i booked not only my family but another family also. we were all soooo happy here. we signed up as priority club members and received not only the discounted parking but also the free breakfast which was wonderful. my kids loved it. the beds were really comfortable and the room was nice and spacious. location was good and pretty central for our touristy things we did. i would definitely return here. the hotel staff was also so nice and the concierge was able to book both our families warner brothers tours from the hotel after i was told by warner brothers they were sold out! great hotel!

wonderful time! spent 3 evenings (w, th, f) at this hotel was more than impressed.the concierge was giving us tips advice before we even got a chance to check in. front staff-very friendly professional. were given n/s 2 doubles on the 10th floor with an exceptional view of both downtown the snow-capped mountains hollywood sign. we asked for a king they were booked for the evening but happily suggested we switch rooms the next night. we were so settled satified with the 2 doubles, we didn't even try to get the king.we were greeted in the room by soft jazz playing on the cd player comfy white down comforters pillows that were wonderfully soft. there was even a small bag with an eye mask, lavendar linen spray ear plugs- although we didn't use any of those.the bathroom was a bit cramped, but since there were only 2 of us, it wasn't a problem.didn't use the workout room, jacuzzi or pool (both heated outdoor), but they seemed nice easy to find.were already a priority club member which let us in the free breakfast lounge.everyone, from the maids to the hotel repairmen we occasionally rode the elevator with were very friendly treated us like true guests. it felt more like a bed and breafast.we had one dinner at the hotel's restaurant (marty's bistro) and were blown away by the portion sizes the quality of food -steak shrimp scampi. we had excellent service there would highly recommend it.the walk to rodeo was 15 minutes quite a hike for us since we already had blisters from walking in anaheim. so we took a cab back it was a flat $5, not bad. excellent bev hills restaurant: bossa nova is worth the $10 roundtrip cab fare!we rented a car on site from midway for one day ($40 for a pt cruiser) didn't have to pay for parking at all. not sure how that happened. it was worth it to drive down to hollywood take in those sites as well as the nbc studios in burbank. otherwise we loved the fact that 2 different bus co's were a 2 minute walk from the hotel. $1.50 roundtrip to santa monica or anywhere in between. and the other mta line would go everywhere else connect you to subways.can't beat the price or location on this one!

great hotel and location the crown plaza was great. a good location and an outstanding room. (join the priority club for free and you will receive a concierge level room) the room was newly renovated and flawless. the location is great, a short walk from rodeo driveand wilshire. there are many inexpensive restaurants within walking distance on beverly and pico. i would definitely stay here again!

not bad for the price. just returned 3 days ago. the hotel was farther than expected from rodeo drive. don't expect to walk there. the breakfast was outstanding.. great breakfast buffet. lunch and room service not so good. rooms were ok but needed a facelift (paint, cpt. cleaning) view from window was terrible. ... looked like the getto. staff was friendly. could hear the person next door like they were in same room. we got a great deal for the room so was worth it but would not pay regular rate.

poor location, but nice large bedrooms and very comfortable beds stayed at the crowne plaza in december 2004. didn't realise location would be a long walk from anywhere and made the mistake of trying to walk to hollywood - bad idea !! once we learnt about the local buses it made travelling easier, but la doesn't have an extensive underground network. hotel itself was good, but food was not great and would recommend eating out of the hotel. rooms were very nice, but the whole stay was spoiled by a fire alarm which went off at 5a.m. one morning. no staff - no help - no advice. one night porter on reception who was more interested in taking money from people checking out and not bothered about the 200 people standing in the lobby. don't take any of the hotel tours - for example universal studios was advertised for $70 each transport return and didn't include admission. after a $2 bus ride to hollywood and then a $2 underground ride to universal - alot cheaper doing it yourself - but do take the money off vouchers from the leaflets in the hotel lobby. universal la is nowhere near as good as the orlando one which we visited last year. also did a tour of the stars home and again did it for half the hotel's price by buying the ticket on hollywood boulevard where the tours depart from. if you want to do hollywood and all the sights choose a hotel there and you will also get to see the nearly nightly premieres !.

quiet haven we didn't mind sitting in the lobby playing cards till our room was ready, because we had arrived an hour before check-in. we were very pleased with the quality of the bed and linens, the cleanliness of the room, and the space. loved seeing the sunrise reflected on the glass buildings across the street, as well as the lovely sunsets from the 9th floor. we applied for a priority club membership as soon as we had made our reservations so as to take advantage of the free breakfast and reduced price in parking. well worth it. the breakfast was ample and in a lovely setting. the staff was of mixed quality. the bellman was very knowledgeable and helpful. the concierge was fine. for the location we felt we found a great value. the price was advertised on a travelzoo newsletter, which was what directed us to investigate. the deal was only for the weekend. we called the hotel directly to see what they would charge for the next night, a monday. they matched the weekend price so we booked directly with the hotel. we would stay there again and are considering their tournament of roses package for next new year's.

great hotel and a great holiday experience we stayed 3 night in september 2004 and had a great time. we were more than pleasantly surprised when we arrived - the lobby was lovely, the staff delightful and very welcoming, and our room (a double double) was surprisingly spacious, comfortable and very clean. we ate breakfast in the restaurant and the service was pretty good most of the time. we had dinner there once and enjoyed a very lovely meal and found the service great. overall a terrific hotel, great value for money, and we would stay again and highly recommend it to others!

average at best this is an old hotel with just enough renovations to get by in the beverly hills hotel market. i am a priorty club platinum member and stay at crownes all over the country/world and this is one of the worst i have stayed in. it is equivalent to a old holiday inn at best. i stayed in an executive suite it was not very nice. very loud wall air conditioners. parking is expensive as well.

don't judge a book by its cover.. we stayed at the crowne plaza our first night in los angeles, with high expectations because of what we had seen on the internet and reviews on trip advisor...though the lobby was beautiful, the staff and especially the hotel room itself were average. the bathroom was tiny to say the least and not very clean and the beds were very hard. be prepared to pay for the buffet breakfast. we recommend exploring other hotels - the crowne plaza is definately not value for money.

can't speak to highly of all the staff i stayed at the crown plaza with my 2 grown up daghters for 5 nights 3rd - 8th november. the staff were more than helpful. really made us feel welcome. we had 2 rooms with connecting doors. both rooms were very spacious, spottlesly clean and were kept that way by the staff. great selection for the buffet continental breakfast including a variety of fruit juices, fresh fruit, yoghurt, pastries, bagels etc. as our flight wasn't untill 9pm we were given a late check out (at no extra cost) of 6pm when our cab was collecting us. brilliant safe location. big blue bus to santa monica every 15 minutes, 75cents, 2 minutes walk from hotel on pico blvd. takes about 20 to 30 minutes. within easy walking distance of rodeo drive. we found the taxis very reasonable. hotel to melrose ave $7. you have to remember the price is for the cab not per person.we used 'airport express limousines' for tansfers to and from the hotel and also for a tour of the star homes. rony the owner was very helpful and dess our driver was just lovely and we thoroughly enjoyed his company.all in all we had a fantastic time and would certainly stay at the crown plaza beverly hills again again again.

much better than adequate clean high rise hotel on the edge of beverly hills. within walking distance of nothing, but very close to beverly hills and west hollywood. clean, spacious rooms (mine was very noisy and i could see why earplugs were supplied). parking garage beside the hotel for $14/night ($10 with priority gold). club level is average, and priority club breakfast just a buffet with danish, etc. for $100 per night, this hotel is marvelous.

3 star hotel with added extras excellent 3 star hotel. location close to beverly hills attractions. staff helpful and very nice. rooms had the amenities of a 4 - 5 star hotel with little extras of lavander aromatherapy bed linen spray, eye mask, relaxation cd to help you sleep, ear plugs, down duvets, 300 count linens. the room was soundproofed. we were next to the elevator, but did not hear a sound. the room was small due to being an older hotel, but still enough room to spread out. the lobby and pool area keep this a 3 star hotel. check in and check out fast. arrived early and were given a room. got a good deal through priceline. would stay here again.

great place, great value ! stayed at the crown plaza for 5 nights at the beginning of this month at the start of two weeks touring. booked direct on the intercontinental website paying $99 dollars a night - came to a little more in the end with taxes etc, however, this was brilliant value compared to most uk hotels ! as a tip, its worth joining this hotel groups priority club as you get a complimentary conti br'fast, plus rooms on certain floors. i'm not sure if these are better rooms, however, they were certainly large and well equiped. i liked the location, it felt safe (for la), had its own adequate parking and was quiet. within the car park is a car rental firm - midway - worth considering if this is your first night away as i had an hours wait at the airport for my rental car. definately would stay again when in la.

disappointed after driving down from san francisco to la in early january 2004, we were expecting everything! the crowne plaza however was disappointing. the room was nice but cramped for two people. the bed next to the bathroom just managed to allow the door to open but you could hear everything going on in the bathroom so not very private. the water wouldn't drain whilst taking a shower so we stood in shampoo, soap and conditioner until stepping out. we called maintenance up who fixed it but the problem still occurred. honestly, we couldn't be bothered calling again. the use of the internet downstairs in the lobby was good. the nightlife on the strip on a thursday night was non existent and very disappointing. venice beach fared better the following day.

fab time at the crowne plaza my husband and i were due to spend nights 4 at this hotel in september, after spending 4 nights in anaheim at disneyland. upon our arrival we were greeted with a nightmare.....we were told that there was no reservation in our name and that the hotel was fully booked for the first night of our stay (i couldnt believe it considering it had been booked with our tour operator for nearly a year). tony rebello, the rooms division manager was brillant, he went of his way to help us out. we were taken to another hotel for the first night with no cost to us and then brought back to the crowne plaza in time for our early morning tour. our room was lovely and all the staff were extremely friendly. the hotel was spotless. location was fine. we will be returning to this hotel in 2006 (we would love to return in 2005 but the credit card needs time to recover)with the rest of our family. highly recommended!!!!!

great start to our holiday we stayed at the crowne plaza for 4 nights during a week trip to la.the room was booked directly through the hotels website, the best price around. one bit of advice i can say, that we found, during booking the room i ticked the box joining the crowne plaza priority points. it is free and you collect points for staying towards other free nights. we didnt really need this, but me being me i like free things. anyway we didnt find out until we arrived that ticking that box gave you access to priority bonuses. the hotels top floor is reserved for executive rooms, but the floor below is reserved for priority members. also our room rate did not include breakfast, but again being a priority member gave you access to a special members lounge 24hrs, which served a free buffet breakfast in the mornings.we tried breakfast in the hotels resturant one morning and it was a little basic and expensive.the rooms were large and well kept and the only downside was that the aircon was a little noisy. staff were friendly and very helpful, and maids very very efficiant. outside is a taxi rank and bus stop which gets you anywhere you want.we didnt rent a car during our stay. taxi from the airport was $30 and the buses got us around for the other 4 days no problem.the hotel is good for most things in north la, we got a taxi to universal studios ($35) but took us through some very nice areas and showed us part of hollywood that tours didnt go to.if you want to see all of la, and universal and disney, then i would recommend what we did, stay a few nights in north la and a few in south la (anahiem).would definately return to the crowne plaza if staying in la again.

great place! we had a great experience here! we got a great rate using priceline and were very pleased with our stay. we used our priority club card and got discounted parking and free continental breakfast. the lobby was very nice, fast elevators, and nice rooms. the bathrooms are nothing special but that is fine with us. the service was friendly and very accomodating. highly recommended!!

nice hotel, great location we cannot fault the hotel as they were very helpful and accommodating - our flight from hawaii to la was cancelled therefore we missed our evening arrival at the hotel. we were only booked in for one night en route to las vegas and were set to be charged anyway for room rate if we did not show. we contacted them beforehand to explain and they kept our room for us to arrive at 8am following morning instead of the expected 8pm previous evening - they extended our check-out time, so we could grab breakfast, couple hours sleep and showers and enjoy the rest of the day in la before evening flight to vegas. concierge were helpful/efficient and the desk chatty making us feel welcome. the overall feel of the place was welcoming, nice relaxed bar area and our room on club floor was nice, very clean and spacious. we were on our honeymoon, so they had given us a better room than rate paid. location great for walking rodeo drive etc. shame we did not have longer - rushed visit!

decent balance of cost/location/quality the location is great. the rooms are motel like, but sport great views of the city, especially at sunset and dawn. don't expect great service, though it is not the worst. comfortable, respectable, a good value in la.

nice place we were in la in july 2004. the hotel is great. the location is perfect and the price is very fair. the hotel is super clean and the rooms are very nice. the hotel is big and the services are there 24 hours a day. if you are visiting beverly hills stay at this hotel. it is safe and very nice.

nice hotel! a nice beverly style hotel, mike the conceriage very helpful at sorting taxis and a day trip.the hotel is a bit in the middle of nowhere if you want to walk anywhere. get a taxi, although the surrounds do feel safe.restaurant is ok, room service offers a better choice!nice hotel.

conveniently located we stayed here 3 nights between 27 and 30 june 2004. our room was spacious and located on the upper floors (i have the inter-continental priority card) and we got free continental breakfast and discounted garage.the position is convenient if you have a car (but who doesn't in los angeles???).i will definitely book future reservations with the crowne plaza.

great value and great staff! very nice hotel, very friendly staff, great value for money $99 per night! minutes walk from the glitz and glamour of rodeo drive other bevely hills attractions, 5 mins drive from the strip! what more can you ask for?

if you are looking for upscale, don't look here even though i was upgraded to a nice sized one bedroom suite, (i was staying free on my priority club points) this hotel that touts itself as a luxury hotel and believe me, this hotel is not luxurious. they have renovated recently, so the public areas seem pleasant at first glance. however, when you take a closer look, the public areas are very dirty and not well maintained. there was gum stuck to the wall in the lobby all 3 days i was there, filthy glass entrance doors, trash on the elevator floors, dirty carpet, etc. the room seemed pretty clean except for the hair all over the bathroom floor. gross.the room itself had some nice touches, but overall felt like an older holiday inn trying to disguise itself as something nicer. service was indifferent, except for the great concierge was helpful.also not very luxurious was having to go out the front lobby doors to get to the pool, which is located next to the street. the club lounge was your basic hotel room with a cheap continental breakfast. convenient, but nothing special. valet was understaffed (just the one bellman on staff) one evening i had to get the car myself from the garage because he was too busy.crowne plaze also announced it's new luxurious beds. the bed was nice because it was brand new, but actually very firm and not high quality.location is ok if you have a car, but not too much around walking distance. this hotel is fine for basic, no frills accomodations if you get a good, low rate. i wish i hadn't used my points here tho, kind of a waste. i would have stayed at a nicer holiday-inn express.

great location, average room stayed at the hotel for one night. the location was great, close to beverly hills and hollywood. the front desk staff was helpful and friendly. however the rooms are nothing special. very average, plain and on the small side. the bathroom was clean, but nothing fancy in there, tub and shower were plastic, no tile work in there. good hotel, for one night, wouldn't want to stay there longer..
fuming mad--lousy service staff was friendly, but not very bright. my wakeup call did not happen, so i missed a key meeting--ruined the whole trip.

they were a life saver ~ very helpful and accommodating my daughter, 3 year old granddaughter and i stayed at the crowne plaza from april 7 to april 16. my husband had open heart surgery at cedars sinai and the hotel was very helpful in making us feel comfortable, knowing the stressful situation. the staff is fabulous. the only thing i would recommend is that perhaps they get a couple more computers for the guests to use. i will definitely book future reservations with the crowne plaza. thank you all. you made a difficult situation so much better.

excellent time we had a great time at the crowne plaza! debbie,ismal and john were very nice and funny! we got a great internet rate and were close to rodeo dr.join the priority club and the breakfast is only $5.00 for the buffet, or free at the club room on the 12th floor.we never opened a door,they were opened for us. it was a fun time.

it was great everything was great with this hotel right from check in. the front desk staff was friendly and willing to explain anything to you. i needed a wake up call every morning and when i called each night they were very accommodating. the rooms were a good size and very clean. the air conditioning was a little noisy at times, but it definitely kept the room cool! the concierge was very helpful and had a wealth of information to share about the surrounding area. he booked a tour for us and gave us suggestions for how to spend the day. all in all, this hotel was great. i wouldn't think twice about staying here again.

excellent hotel excellent hotel for the price of $99 a night. hotel lobby was very nice and staff were very friendly. room was big and very nicely furnished. we did not look at the pool or hot tub so i cant comment on those. parking was only $9 a night, which for the area was excellent. its a $5 cab ride to the centre of rodeo drive. if you want to go to rodeo drive for shopping this is the place to stay. its about a third of the price of the other hotels in the area.

ickkkkkk we stayed here because it had a reasonably priced 1-br suite, and our baby could be put down in his crib while my husband and i stayed up in the main area. that part was great, but overall the place was mediocre. drab furnishings, not very clean, blase staff. the breakfast was good and convenient, but the high speed internet did not work (and apparently had not for quite some time). my husband was there on business, so this was a real detriment. i would not choose this hotel again if i had a choice.

crowne plaza beverly hills just returned from san francisco and la trip with 2 teens. we had a wonderful time in both cities. you are near beverly hills and not really a walking area. the cab ride to the hotel was 45.00. there is a car rental on site. we got a great deal and a nice car at a discount rate being mid-week and slow, says the rental car agent. the front desk was nice and the bell hops were great, friendly, helpful and nice. i have a priority club membership through my work and you can get discount rate on parking and free continental breakfast, same as any other. they tell you that you can eat cont. breakfast in the lobby restaruant. i would not recommend that, the employees were rude. they expect you to buy breakfast and tip them. so, we learned and only did that once. you can drive to hollywood and santa monica easily and we drove up to malibu, which was a beautiful drive. the hotel needs much work. the beds, linen were terrible. the pool and hot tub were green and not kept well. while in the garage elevator, we saw an outdated inspection that said holiday inn select. no wonder it needs work if that was what this hotel previously was run by. it appears they are working on this. the walls are very thin and we had to report some drunken neighbors for keeping us awake 2 nights in a row. for the 4 days we were there, we felt safe with driving. i use the crowne plaza's with work almost exclusively and am used to better, but it appears they are trying to upgrade. for the expedia price, its fair.

okay we recently spent 4 nights at the crowne plaza in beverly hills. the entrance and lobby are nicely done and well maintained, but the rooms are a little tired. not bad for the price, but don't expect too much. the heated pool was even too cold for my kids and the hot tub had a green color to it and about 6 inches of foam on top. we stayed clear. the parking lot was reasonable for the area at $12 per day with in- and out- privileges.we tried the breakfast buffet one morning - it was a little pricy - about $13 for an adult and $6 for children. it was the typical buffet that you could find for probably half that price.i was surprised that there was not much to do in the immediate area for a family, except look at some shops on beverly and rodeo drives. you need to drive or take a cab to get anywhere - at that takes a long time.

great find! pleasant, clean, affordable and convenient in la the secret to the affordability of the crowne plaza beverly hills is it's location. it's set in a lovely neighborhood that's just a few minutes drive to some of the hottest spots in town--rodeo drive, hollywood boulevard, museums, etc. but if you go for a walk around the hotel itself, you're not going to find flashy, upscale dining, shopping and hot nightlife. you can get kosher pizza and tacos, buy a nice bottle of wine and have a decent meal, but it's a pleasant city neighborhood (i.e. people actually live and work there), not a tourist zone. we loved it for that--after a day of being tourists, it was nice to retreat somewhere that felt homey. and the hotel itself was very nice, with personable service, clean and pleasant rooms, convenient parking and decent room service. only disappointment was the pool, which is right at street level next to the driveway. if you want to be dazzled, look elsewhere. if you want a relaxing hotel (not motel) experience that's nicer than your average chain, allows you a pleasant base from which to tour la, and doesn't cost a fortune, then i highly recommend the crowne plaza.

good hotel for the price stayed here january 04 for two nights.its definetly good value if you book via their internet page. the rooms are a bit faded but comfortable (good beds) and everything works.some slight negatives: * the elevators are slowwwww, but thats not a big problem. * the swipe locks on the doors are a bit flaky * the location is probably the weakest point, i.e. its right on the edge of beverly hills but i guees for the price cannot complain. some tips: * sign up for the crowne plaze priority club on their web site (its free) before you go and give your priority club number when booking, then you may get access to the club floor (we did) where you get free breakfast (juice/cereal/bread/bagles) * for us at least the 21 day advance purchase rate turned out not to be i.e it was only billed on arrival which was great. * if you want a taxi (which you probably will) take the beverly hills blue cabs waiting outside (they arethe most reasonable but still not cheap) * there is more to see/do on hollywood blvd as a tourist, if going again i would try to find a hotel nearer to there, you can always take a quick tour and see beverly hills in half a day.

good service we stayed at the crowne plaza for 5 nights in november 2003. its location close to rodeo drive meant that there are plenty of dining options, and all within walking distance. hotel is also close to a ralphs supermarket and has a bus stop around the corner - good for travelling to santa monica. the rooms are of fair quality - the airconditioner was noisy and the rooms quite dark, but apart from that they are adequate. good cable tv !!the service of the conceirges' and desk staff was excellent - they went out of their way to assist us in anyway possible.

luxury hotel but only for sound sleepers (poor sound-proofing) hotel is full of contradictions as far as having some excellent features such as top-notch furnishings and very helpful and knowledgeable concierge, yet having some serious downsides - including just about the worst sound-proofing this frequent traveler has ever encountered. doorways opening and closing, the hotel elevator (at some distance from my room), and adjacent room's guest making his selection from his closet (you could hear hangers sliding across the bar) were all plainly audible. at first i thought the hallway revelry was due to some particularly unruly guests, and then realized that poor soundproofing was at the heart of the problem as merely closing a door somewhere down the hall sounded like slamming. another strange contradiction - the bedding is obviously very high-end, but relatively hard (i.e. it's a futon) so it's great for those who think firm beds are better and a tough go if you like soft beds. a major plus - the location could not be better. within easy walking distance of outstanding shopping and dining, it is ideal for those who like to be able to enjoy city amenities on foot rather than always having to drive. if you are a very sound sleeper i'd say this hotel is a great choice, but if you favor a quiet rest i would recommend against it.

good location and excellent service. not perfect, however... i booked the sofitel for a one-night stay on a mid-week business trip to los angeles. the hotel is nicely situated directly across from the beverly center, one of la's best shopping malls. good food and sightseeing options are right outside the door, which is rare for la.the hotel is modern and hip with very well kept grounds and an impressive entry area. the rooms are also modern in appearance with flat panel tvs and sharp, clean decor.i found the service to be superior, from the reception to the valet parking attendants. no issues at check-in. check-out or anywhere in between.consistent with earlier reviews, the room i was given was very small for the states. if i was with my wife, we would have been cramped. but, for one, the size was fine. i also found the room to be otherwise spotless and comfortable, with a good view of the busy la street scene below. the bed was comfortable and i slept well.so, in all, i would recommend the sofitel for travelers to la or those on business. it is well located and can be a good value, especially if you shop around on discount internet websites.

acceptable the sofitel is probably hit or miss, and for me, it was a miss.the hotel looks nice and it is furnished in a way you would expect from a 4-star place. the service was very friendly, and we had a decent time overall. however, we had a few problems--each minor, but collectively annoying--during our stay:1) we arrived to find stains on our sheets and no soap in the bathroom. and because we had arrived late, we had to change the sheets ourselves.2) the walls between us and our neighbors were surprisingly thin. at one point we could hear the local newscast on the tv next door as if it were showing in our room.3) this was the kicker--it happened to rain on our last night there, and all the water off the roof drained right onto a metal windowsill outside our window. needless to say, we slept very poorly, even after housekeeping gave us some earplugs. if it rains, do not stay on the 4th floor.interestingly, when i complained to the front desk, she said many of the guests had made similar complaints, and that the hotel management was pushing for a renovation. i won't be staying again until they do.

needs work this is the third sofitel property my husband and i stayed at; the other two were in europe. we were fairly happy with the previous bookings and so we decided to try sofitel los angeles. details were awry at this hoteléˆ¥??µath mirror placed too far to be useful, dust on the furniture, a toilet that splashed when flushed, one robe provided instead of two, knocking on the door and waking us early in the morning to deliver the newspaper, instead of just leaving it so we may sleep undisturbed.with the exception of the person who woke us up with the newspaper, the staff was generally nice and helpfuléˆ¥??•hough more training would not hurt.we probably would not recommend this sofitel property.
spacious rooms and good central location bedroom with juliet balcony

can i please move to la.... i love california....be it on business or pleasure it's so much more pleasurable doing anything when it's sunny.anyway, this hotel....fantastic.about 25 mins from the airport, check in was smooth and really pleased with the bedroom. comfy bed, fantastic bathroom and everything that i needed (except somebody to actually come to my room to iron my shirts!!)the breakfast was ample, location was good for us and right opposite a shopping mall to buy the kids presents!the staff were really courteous and made you feel welcome.the only downside is the bar in the evening....i'm about 20 years (and a few stone) too heavy to feel part of the beautiful crowd!! great for people watchingstay there....you won't be disappointed

oustanding service, great product, totally renovated, superb location stayed at the sofitel los angeles in october. the staff was outstanding. all were extremely attentive, courteous and friendly. i was totally impressed, such service i usually only expect from four seasons or peninsula brands. the restaurants are great, all new. the room is very spacious and comfortable. loved the sofitel my bed. location is great, just on la cienaga and beverly, by the bevery center mall. unfortunately did not see the pool on the roof, hear it is great though. would stay again immediately.

nice looking hotel but... this is a beautiful looking hotel but there certainly are problems.the rooms are small. real small. typical for europe but definitely below expectations for north america. i've even been in several ny hotels with bigger rooms.having said that, they have done a beautiful job renovating the rooms.noise. oh my lord. we faced beverly blvd. we might as well have slept on beverly blvd. the noise from the street and the vibrant hotel bar was certainly too loud. and i'm deaf in 1 ear. i usually never have a problem with outside noise.the hotel staff were very pleasant. the hotel is very clean. the renovations are nice and modern.overall, it's ok but i doubt i would stay there again.

fantastic hotel - can't fault it well, we got this for $156 on hotwire - what a bargain. had a deluxe room and it certainly was deluxe. the bed was the most comfortable i have ever slept in, with the lightest down duvet you can imagine. the bathroom was absolutely fantastic, with a window so you could see the tv, plus volume controls so you could hear it! the shower was wonderful - complete with seat. complimentary toiletries of great quality. bathrobes, slippers and complimentary water.so good that we booked for second night - this time $149, but only for standard room. however, hotel staff wonderful and quite happy to upgrade us free of charge.lovely breakfast - not too pricey. three free computers and a printer - so rarely needed to wait to use.excellent location. can't fault anything! hope to return someday.

a touch of luxury at a great price i recently stayed at the sofitel in los angeles and was very happy with the entire stay. they were running a special (2 nights for the price of 3) which put a hotel like this in my price range (approx $250 a night). i was impressed that the gentlemen that met me at the front door actually walked me to the reception area, got me checked in, got me acclimated to the hotel it's ameneties and escorted me to the elevator. i also appreciated his asking if i needed assistance to the room (which i didn't). i didn't really deal much w/ the rest of the staff, with the exception of valet, and they were always prompt courteous in retrieving my car. the daily fee is a bit steep ($30), but we were in beverly hills. the room was very comfortable and stylish. my room faced the beverly center on beverly blvd, so there was a a little traffic noise, but being from a city, i didn't find it too distracting. very comfortable bed and a really nice, large bathroom. the shower is one of those rain showers - i am not a fan, but that is just personal taste. the towels were fantastic, fluffy and plentiful. the location is great if you are a shopper. right across from the beverly center and close to robertson blvd, 3rd street and the grove. this will be one of the first places i look at when booking my next trip to la and if the price is right, i will definitely stay here again.

super cool sofitel la .. this is one of the coolest sofitels i have stayed in around the world.has been completely renovated - so is super funky .. but without loosing any comfort or service.fantastic staff, amazing service, from the moment we arrived - very efficient valet service, amazing reception all very black with candles everywhere, really cool restaurant and bar .. rooms have a real european paris feeling, but still really cool, lovely big beds ours overlooking the holywood sign.amazing spa and gym - the spa is fabulous. really lovely outdoor pool area.the thing that made this hotel was the staff .. everyone is so friendly and the bar was definately a highlight.would highly recommend to anyone who wants a luxury central hotel.

perfect location for comfort and getting around i recently stayed here after reading the reviews on this site. i have to say i wasn't disappointed! the location was great!! as we were not driving we wanted a good base and we couldn't have asked for more. we walked to rodeo drive and even hollywood (although this is a bit of a walk). we could also walk down past the beverly centre to the next main avenue and get buses to all location, we managed to go to santa monica and downtown by bus for example. when we first arrived we were given a room facing the beverly centre however after reading the reviews here we quickly asked for a view of the hills and were given one immediately which was fantastic, could even see the hollywood sign.would definitely recommend this hotel, great base. sunset strip was only a short taxi fare for evening entertainment. we got about a good bit by foot and public transport (although this does need improvement) and i would certainly stay here again!!oh.. and the bed was the most comfortable i have ever slept in!
nice hotel, good central location bedroom

fantastic hotel - one of the nicest i got a great rate from hotwire from this hotel and was extremely pleasantly surprised. the hotel is owned by a french company (sofitel) so the entire hotel had an european feel. the gym was one of the nicest hotel gyms that i have seen as it had brand new equipment, free evian water and nice eucalyptus towels. the pool was very small and was salt water but it was nice enough. not much of a pool scene but the other benefits of the hotel outweighed this small problem. the rooms were a little on the small side but nice. the restaurant was fantastic and the bar was very lively. we did manage to see a celebrity sighting going in to the bar. all in all, this is a great hotel and would return in a second.

great hotel if your room is facing the right way. my boyfriend and i stayed in this hotel on saturday night. we checked in at 3pm and found the room very comfortable. we stayed in the room until 7pm when we went out for a party. when we got back there was a huge private party in the hotel bar/restaurant. it took us awhile to drive up to the hotel door as paparazzi and limo's were blocking our way for a bit. when we finally got to our room on the 8th floor, it was like we were at the party. the noise was unbelievable and was going to be that loud until 1:30 we were told. the hotel staff were fairly helpful and changed our room, however the first room they switched us to had the same problem, since we were still facing the street. i think the noise was bouncing off the shopping center's walls across the street... finally, they switched us again to a room facing the hills, and we couldn't hear a thing and had a peaceful night. i would say the staff did alright - they were friendly and accommodating, but should have guessed we needed a room on the opposite side of the street the first time round. i would recommend asking for a room on the 'hill' side if you are staying at the hotel on a weekend.

excellent service and rooms outstanding property!great service, fantastic staff. the drive way is staffed by about 10 people waiting to welcome you back and assist with bags which was great. everytime they gave us a personal greeting back to the hotelthe rooms are very clean, large, and the beds are heavily. in room movies are up to date and not too expensiveroom was cleaned to the highest standard.pool is small but nice, gym is well equiped. one down side -they have 2 computers with free internet but do not extend this out to free wireless- when you are paying so much for a room free wi fi should be standard!other than that its excellent.

good stay at sofitel we spent three days before a cruise at this hotel and three days after the cruise at the hotel.the first three days were spent in a rear double room with views of the hollywood hills and the second spell was in a front double room with views of the beverly centre. the second room was noticibly larger.we did not notice any real traffic noise from ther front room.the service and quality was excellent on both stays and up to the usual sofitel standard.the location is good for a large city like los angeles and most things are only a short cab ride away.would not hesitate to reccommend this hotel.

a great l.a. experience i just got back from the sofitel where i had a girlfriend weekend getaway. it was a great experience. we stayed in a suite and were on the penthouse floor. the only complaint was the sound of sirens that occasionally went by enroute to cedars sinai hospital which was a block away from the hotel. the staff were all very courteous with the exception of one concierge who seemed to be a gal with a poor attitude and work ethic. the other concierge staff were amazing getting us a reservation at madeo restaurant with only a couple hours notice. the dining at the hotel was pretty decent food and the breakfast fare was quite reasonably priced as well. the room was very clean and always replenished with complimentary evian bottles of water. the pool was a great little spot with tv's in some of the cabanas and music playing. room service would also come and bring you drinks and food if requested at the pool. the location of the hotel was fabulous. it is directly across the street from a pretty standard mall. it was within walking distance to some really fine dining - madeo, the jar, the ivy. it is very close to walk to the farmer's market, cbs studios and the grove outdoor shopping center (great spot). it is a short 3 block walk to robertson boulevard which has some fabulous shopping. melrose avenue is a hike but we walked to it (disappointing as it is really rundown and the type of shopping where you have to really be in the mood to find what you are looking for).we didn't really frequent the stone rose lounge except for a pre-dinner drink but it seemed to have a really great vibe.my friend and i have decided that we will definitely be back to l.a. for our girl's weekend and enjoyed it better than our last vegas trip at the bellagio. we will definitely be back to the sofitel on our next trip.

great location, stylish hotel my husband and i stayed at this hotel for 5 nights in august (without the kids) our dbl room was very stylish and spacious but we decided to treat ourselves to a suite. for the views alone it was well worth it. the hotel is directly accross the street from the beverly centre, great for shopping. we did not hire a car and found it very easy to get around la, taxis are not expensive.

pay attention to the details hotel has very modern and comfortable decor. the valet parking is a little steep at $30/day, which they don't seem to disclose anywhere on their site. there's plenty of street parking available. most of the rooms are average size, but request the larger rooms at the end of the hallway on each floor. the hotel offers very few rooms with double bedding, so don't expect to change bedding unless you've pre-reserved the room. each room is equipped with a flat screen, fluffy down blanket and the basic necessities. a complimentary mini bottle of evian is replenshished daily. internet access is available through t-mobile hotspots for a daily fee of $10.all hotel staff is very courteous and attentive especially concierge and bellman. we showed up for our dinner reservation that the concierge helped us with and apparently they booked it for the wrong day. so just make sure you re-confirm everything with concierge. make sure you check your folio upon check out. i pre-paid for the room, but was billed the full room charges again upon check out.located in a great area, with lots of good eats around. extremely easy access to beverly center, melrose and robertson for all those shoppers.

sofitel won me over!! we stayed here for two nights and absolutely loved it. first time at a sofitel. the room was immaculate very modern the beds divine. the concierge was so helpful with every little thing we asked.the beverly hills mall with bloomies and macys right across the street, cvs, marshalls old navy and starbucks also across the street. within walking distance of robertson. we did not eat at simons but heard it was excellent. great neighbourhood in the area for walking. will definitely stay at sofitel next chance i get.

just returned just returned after a 6 day trip .chose this hotel as i have stayed in a few of the sofitels , and found them great .this was ... well ok. clean hotel , small rooms , helpful reception staff , but concierge made 3 mistakes in requests we made , and one was pretty major , and spoilt our last nite.and location is not great .apart from a shopping mall across from hotel , theres nothing else within walking distance.probably would not stay again .

great hotel! i stayed at the sofitel for 2 nights and it was one of the best hotel of my month long stay in the usa. stunning modern lobby (although the several doormen 'welcoming' you back to the hotel each time you enter is a little annoying!). there are 3 computers to the side of the reception desk offering free internet access. i didnt dine at the restaurant as looked a little expensive but it looked extremely nice and the adjoining bar loks very funky! i recommend a restaurant called the grand lux cafe just down the road from the hotel - delicious burgers!the room was stunning with really comfortable beds and large bathroom. the only down side was the size of the pool and surrounding area - very small although the space is put to great use with lots of plants and a few lovely secluded seating booths with tvs in. you are not aware of the busy road below. the rooms have fluffy bathrobes and slippers which are handy for the walk down to the pool.another down side was the concierge who was rather snotty and not very friendly. the staff at reception however were very friendly.i would definitely stay here again!

central location and great service my family and i booked two rooms at the sofitel this september and reading a few of the somewhat negative reviews below, i wonder if we are talking about the same hotel. first of all, the hotel staff was gracious enough to give us adjacent rooms and not just rooms on the same floor. the rooms were very spacious, spotless clean, and equipped with all the amenities you could ask for. the bathroom was equally spacious and the supplies replenished without the need to ask. the service from the reception desk and the concierge are exceptional. to give you a few examples: my husband had paid for a laptop at one of the stores but did not have the time to go pick it up; they did it for us and had it delivered to our room. i had seen a video camera that i liked at the same shop but did not remember the exact model. the concierge took the time to search the website of the store i was talking about, scanned all the models until i recognized the one i had liked, and sent out and got it for me. it was again delivered to the room on the same day. this came at a price, but with the short period of time we had at la, every second counted. at one point, when we came down late one morning, and my elderly mother discovered that the coffee stand at the lobby was shut down, the front desk manager took the time to prepare her a cup in person and bring it over to her while we were waiting for a tour pick up.everytime we entered the hotel, the staff greeted us with a smile, asking if we were having a good time and if there was anything they could do to make our stay more enjoyable. also, we had stayed at the renaissance for a couple of days before that, and while the location was exceptional and the view of the hills and the hollywood sign an unexpected bonus, the staff there was snobbish and extremely unfriendly. the staff courteous, friendly and efficient attitude at the sofitel was like a breeze of fresh air.the location was also superb with lots of restaurants, shopping areas, and sights within walking distance. i had such agood time there, that i was really sorry we had only booked a couple of nights and had to leave to san diego. on a next visit to la, this is where i will stay and this is the hotel i will be recommending to friends. it is a shame that the renaissance staff is such a turn off - the hotel's location next to the hollywood highland and the view of the hills would have been a great sell.
average average hotel. a lot of noise from the street.small pool side.friendly stuff. great for bussiness purposeb

better than expected after seeing some of the reviews, i immediately requested a room facing the hollywood hills. the room was beautiful (6th floor), and you could see the hollywood sign. we had a superior room, which i didn't feel was very small- then again, we're from nyc and used to apartments. it was very comfortable and quiet, with a great bathroom. the hotel staff was friendly and helpful. we actually didn't valet, and found street parking, which was a little stressful, but saved us $100. be very careful of the street signs. we were moving the car at 8am each morning, which was fine, still being on east coast time. the pool area was nice, but smaller than the pictures. overall, a very nice stay.

noisy hotel, lack of service my husband and i stayed at this hotel for two nights. the room we booked was a king superior with some hills view. the room we were gives was a king room on the 8th floor but directly on beverly boulevard, with a view of the shopping center. we got into the elevators and noticed they were not very clean, this continued throughout our stay, as did trash that was not picked up the entire stay. hallway carpets were dirty and stained. the room was small but clean, but very noisy. we could hear the traffic on beverly and the people in the room next to us, especially when you were in the bathroom. we had to keep the bathroom door closed at night to keep the noise out. the bed was the worst i have ever slept in. it was lumpy and uneven from the mattress cover, there was no headboard only a 4 gap between the bed and the wall where they had placed electrical strips. the down comforter was so heavy and hot you couldn't sleep under it, and there was no top sheet on the bed, so it was cover or nothing. noisy a/c too.next morning i asked the receiption to please have housekeeping remove the comforter and put a top sheet and blanket on the bed. this was at 9:00 am. i asked again at 1:00 pm and 5:00 pm. finally after my third call housekeeping brought me a sheet and blanket.this to me is no 4 star hotel.
gorgeous hotel. wonderful stay. the room as you see it walking in. note the french doors.
