rooms very nice, lobby a little tired i was shiftted to this hotel when the hotel next door was overbooked, so i was a little worried. the staff were very nice at check-in, but the lobby was a little tired, even though it's been recently renovated. the door behind the front desk was open to reveal some sort of utility room with broom/mops etc. clearly visible, and the carpet was held together with green duct tape where the seam had split. so i was very relieved to get to my room which has not been worn out since renovation. very nice bed, linens, etc and very clean carpet. smallish bathroom, but fine. road noise from the street, even though i'm on the top floor. but a good night's sleep nonetheless

perfect base we stayed at this hotel for four nights and thought it was the perfect base for seeing hollywood. it is near to the walk of fame (five minute walk away) and a short five minute drive to the hollywood sign. (if following your satnav don't settle for where it leaves you at the hollywood sign, meander up the hills and keep looking and you can get much much nearer. there is a spot where you can park and take great pictures. the beaches are great too, venice and santa monica. we hired bikes on both and had great fun. venice beach wasn't what i expected though. it is full of beggers and odd people for want of a better word but don't let this put you off, it is beautiful down there. back to the hotel. the staff are very friendly and are always there to help. it is clean and the rooms are large in size. the pool is a good size and the jacuzzi is great. it is red hot. we went down to the pool five or six times and it must have been quiet because we had it all to ourselves which was good.

great base and friendly staff we stayed at this hotel for 4 nights at the beginning of october. the exterior of the hotel and lobby are all quite nice and the staff were very friendly and helpful. the hall corridors were a bit shabby but the bedroom was clean and quite large. the pool area is quite small and unfortunately was only sunny in the mornings - by the time we had finished our sightseeing for the day there was no sun at all. we thought the hotel was in a good location for what we wanted - its only a 5 minute walk to the hollywood highland centre and the walk of fame etc. there is a liquor store, subway and starbucks across the street. the hotel is only up the road from the hollywood bowl which does make the area very busy when there is an event on. we didn't test the hotels restaurant or bar area so can't comment on those.

facelift hotel...but the beauty is only skin-deep the hollywood heights hotel is a lot the people of hollywood. it looks great on the outside...but still has some problems on the inside.this is a former holiday inn. the public areas have had a significant facelift. the lobby is small, but nicely designed. the restaurant and lounge are equally nice. the pool is comfortable, although the hottub was cold.but a hotel is only as good as the comfort of the rooms...and these rooms are rough at best. the beds are small and the pillows are lumpy. the air conditioner in our room had two settings cold and hot. if we turned it on at night, we froze all night. if we turned it off, we were hot.nevertheless, for the price we paid, i thought it was an ok place. you can beat the location, and the staff were helpful. parking is a relative bargain at $20/night.the restaurant and lounge, however are not bargains. they wanted $5 for a small togo cup of drip coffee...instead i went to the starbucks just across the street.

not a 3 star hotel this is not a 3 star hotel. its feels and looks like a glorified best western with minor perks. so its really a 2.5. i believe it used to be a holiday inn thats been revamped and holiday inns are not 3 star hotels. it feels like a gimmick staying here the moment i layed my eyes on it to when i went towards my room through best westernish hallways and into my room with paperthin walls and a couple of overprice aquafina bottles near my bed. no wifi access and internet was slow.oh about the aquafina. im the frugal type of person who would sneak food into theatres, never buy food at theme parks, much less eat/drink anything placed in hotel rooms that are outrageously overpriced. and what do you know, i got charged 2.50 incidental for a bottle of water which i never even touched. the hotel told me housekeeping said i drank a bottle which i thought was very shady and expected from these type of la housekeepers if you know what i mean. i continued to dispute it and they credited back my 2.50 saying in the future that is 2.5 for a bottle of aquafina. oh thanks, like i didnt know. i would have disputed it my cc if it came to that because i dont give in to such scams. my advice is be careful of these housekeepers since the hotel doesnt have lockboxes and get cleared of incidentals before you check out.oh, if you go into the opened 24 hours a day so called exercise room, they have an arrowhead spring water dispenser that is free to use..........
very good hotel everything that we wanted and more, staff were very attentive and room was clean and well presented. good location too. thanks

basic hotel, not as expected, no transfers i booked this hotel when it was the holiday inn, booked this one because of its location and free transfer to universal studios.found out by accident that the hotel had changed its name a week before our stay, only because i had gone online to check directions. had to contact the hotel to see if my booking was still valid.when we turned up, the lobby is quite impressive, modern decor, but this doesn't extend to the accommodation floors, when the doors of the lifts open, you see they haven't upgraded all of the hotel.the rooms are basic, only a rail for your clothes, no doors to make the rail a wardrobe. we had a room at the front of the hotel and the road noise was very loud.we put the air conditioning on to heat, and the burning dust set the smoke alarm off!the swimming pool is nice, but the terraces don't get sun all day, a lot of shade caused by the surrounding trees, so we had to keep bed hopping to follow the sun, but went in early afternoon when the whole terrace was shaded.the free transfer to universal studios didn't carry over from holiday inn to hollywood heights, so we had to make out own way to universal, took the tube, was only one stop away.didn't feel safe walking the streets to the hotel at night, didn't like the whole hollywood area at all, after having been in new york, san francisco, anaheim and san diego before arriving in la, what was supposed to be a bit of glamour for the end of a really special holiday was a real let down.staff made me feel uneasy, especially the concierge who was so keen to sell us tickets, asked 20 questions every morning as to what we were planning for our day.would not stay here again.

wonderful find! booked this while it was the holiday inn walk of fame-am a little hinky about holiday inns, but this was closest to what we wanted to see. was pleasantly surprised. room was immaculate, only issue was a window that did not close properly-we fixed that ourselves. the beds were comfy, and the linens wonderful. water pressure was great, only knock was that the resturant was very pricey for what you got, but that's the case all over la. there is a starbucks close by, so that worked for us. the hotel charges $20 per day for valet parking. the kodak theatre and walk of fame, as well as grauman's are all a short walk away. i would stay here again.

great location, noisy room we had to book into this hotel at 1:00am in the early hours of the morning when we were let down by our booking at another hotel. the check in procedure was very efficient and the hotel appeared to look shabby in places but trendy and clean in others. the biggest let down was the noise from the road below. the room on the fifth floor over looked north highland avenue and was fitted with single glazed widowéˆ¥??? which appeared to have small gaps in them. admittedly it was a saturday night \ sunday morning and the roads were still busy but after a six hour flight all we wanted to do was sleep which we didnéˆ¥??› manage all night. reception seemed surprised by our comments the following morning so perhaps there are only a few rooms that suffer with this problem? be aware though.it was enough for us not to extend our stay for the duration of the trip in l.a.

centrally located for sight-seeing hollywood, studios, undergoing rennovations from holiday inn to a new name owner. floor hallways muggy pending carpet changes but room comfort fine but again pending carpets upgrades. fantastic bed comfort/linens. otherwise, best location for sightseeing by foot to the hollywood ave for walk of fame, chinese theater, etc, a great draw for evening entertainment especially with teens. also within walking distance of hollywood bowl outdoor concerts. and centrally located for driving to studio tours, beverly hills, farmers market, mullholland dr (great birds-eye view of la). concierge very friendly helpful welcoming you home every night. breakfast meal not included as previously under holiday inn, but ihop other restaurants nearby by car. otherwise nice stay, glad we got the pool side room per previous suggested comments for quieter stay.

superb staff and lovely hotel we just returned from 10 days in california and this hotel was one of the hightlights of our trip. the staff was so nice and so attentive that we are still talking about them. it is in a great location just a couple of blocks from the walk of fame and all the usual hollywood attractions. the pool was beatuful and the hot tub was awesome!! we ended up leaving items there and came back later in the week, the staff was so excited to help us and return our belongings. i would definately stay here again.the surrounding neighborhood is rather run down but it is old hollywood and that should be expected. we went down to the walk late and night and felt very safe.the pictures provided represent the hotel when it was a standard holiday inn. we booked through the holiday inn website and were surprised by the decor. the hotel is designed around the 40's and 50's movie genre with lots of art deco flair. the rooms were spotless and every need attended. if i had to come up with a complaint it was the lack of a business center with free printer. you can print boarding passes for free but we had a list of california sights that we needed to program our gps and it would have cost $5.99 to sign on the computer and print those.

centrally located, but a crowded, depressing neighborhood. centrally located, yes. but the trade off is ridiculous congestion. stay here only if you want to spend an hour traveling six blocks up highland ave. on a saturday night when the hollywood bowl is getting out and the crazies are just getting started on hollywood blvd. and sunset. stay here only if you think you absolutely must see the overcrowded, run-down sites in the 'hood or some made up red carpet occasion. (the day-time emmys had traffic backed up when we were there.) the area is extremely depressing overall. the hotel itself if fine -- if you get a deal. we ended up here for under $100 from a hotwire offer. forewarned by the previous reviews, i asked for and got a very quiet room on the top floor, end of hall, pool side. no problems with noise at all. rooms are very motelish but clean. didn't use the pool but it looked fine. elevator slooowww and dirty. staff very nice from the check in to housekeeping and the parking lot attendant. be warned: parking is $20 a day and it is outside so you car is like a furnace on a hot day. also, going north on highland you can rarely turn left into the lot. you have to go up a block, turn right into a turn around and come back down the hill. don't miss musso and frank restaurant in the hood -- sit at the counter and enjoy the old-timey atmosphere.

great location! we visited the holiday inn walk of fame in february, we were there for oscar weekend and although the weather wasn't very good, the service made up for it. the staff were all very attentive and friendly. there was a power outage on oscar sunday, however, the staff did what they could to accomodate all the guests.clean, spacious rooms, friendly staff, amazing location - a short walk to the kodak theatre and all other hollywood attractions.

very good location free cable internet. breakfast is expensive. 20$ for the outdoor valet parking per day. wonderful location, near highways and 5 minutes walking from walk of fame. safe area. the concierge is perfect; the 4 hour la tour is very good and the shopping mall he recommended were great.

great location the hotel was in a great location for the walk of fame, chinese theatre, hollywood bowl universal studios. we were there 2 nights, the staff were very friendly helpful. the restaurant was good, we ate breakfast (included in room price) dinner there. the free shuttle to universal was very handy. would stay there if i was ever in hollywood again.

friendly and helpful staff myself and my husband stayed there for 6 nights .our room overlooked the pool but the view was hazy as the windows were very dirty.the rooms were very noisy at night with a lot of teenagers banging doors, it was so bad on the last night that i was tempted to call reception,but stuck it out as i knew i wouldnt get anywhere with complaining. water was off for one day of which we were advised of but we were not told that an army of plumbers would be coming into our room.as i was sick on the day and in bed they gained entry with my husbands consent. i soon told them to leave,within ten minutes they were knocking again to gain entry,what a cheek.after another hour reception rang to see what time they could gain entry,itold her i had already complained to reception about it she was head receptionist and didnt know anything about it.a breakdown in communication somewhere,i had asked for a concession on my bill. when paying the bill i had to ask agai they took50 dollors off. the night before we left tried to print out 2 boarding passes but no ink in printer the man at reception tried to helpbut we still had to go to the airport with no boarding passes.this is slack ,its not the best hotel ive stayed inn. the position is good but thats all ,staff are friendly but its too expensive 179 dollors and tax extra per night we came from vegas and got a lot nicer hotel for one third the price, think before you book.a lot of noise from the roomsteresa, ireland

self park valet, and cold shoulder at the desk i decided to roll the dice on this trip. trying to save a few $'s didn't pay off here. i had to find a place to stay in la , and my budget was tighter than usual, so i booked the 3 star, instead of the 4 star. i've learned over the years that the star ratings are one of the most inaccurate bellwethers in existence... this is a perfect case in point. the only parking option is valet which is really a self park, with no bag help(human or cart) up to the obstacle course entry way. this will cost you $20 a day. if you book online, but not through them, you get the pleasure of being told that despite your prepaid reservation, there are no normal rooms to be had. the wheelchair accessible room will have to suffice, because you've prepaid.then you see the room's condition, view, and noise level. to put it nicely, the room had a nice looking bed, surrounded by dirt trashed furnishings. take the bed away and you've got a room with half working lights, broken fixtures and a window that looks out onto a giant ashtray. to top it off, there is no shortage of reminders that despite the view of the butts, this is a smoke free hotel! skip it unless you pay less than $50 and don't have a car with you.

great hollywood location - won't bust your wallet i don't have a car and live here in la. from the red line metro stop at hollywood highland it's a brief couple of minutes walk up highland. a nice indoor hotel with on-site pool and restaurant. almost next door up highland is the hollywood bowl and down highland is the heart of hollywood (hollywood highland complex including the kodak theatre), chinese theatre, jimmy kimmel studio, el capitan theatre, the historic roosevelt hotel, the knitting factory, etc... a few blocks further is the cinerama dome, pantages, egyptian, musso frank's grill and much much more. this is my favorite place to stay when i am in this area. (there is also a best western right next door and a comfort suits directly across the street). if i had the money the roosevelt or the radisson, part of the hllywd/hghlnd complex would be great, but i'm here to see or attend an event, not relish on the hotel. while there is some constant noise on highland ave it never has distracted me. on-site pool and restaurant, however there is a myriad of eating options from fast to fine all over within a couple minutes walk.

disappointed i have just returned home from staying 2 nights at the hotel and sadly i was very disappointed.the hotel itself was clean and in good condition and staff very helpful, for access to the walk of fame - excellent.the problem - noise.we stayed on the 5th night and if you don't need your sleep then stay here but if you do - don't!!!!it is right on a main road and very noisey all night will passing traffic. i don't think i got to sleep either night at all and by the time so was extremely exhausted by the time i left.we stayed here on our way back to england from hawaii but if i knew we were going to be next to a main road i would not have booked it.

convenient for local transport on a 3 day stopover in la. hotel was chosen for convenience to bus and metro stations as we had no transport. hotel was clean and satisfactory, restaurant good, reasonably priced.

great hotel; top value we stayed at this hotel towards the end of a three week round-the world holiday and couldn't have been more satisfied. the hotel was very welcoming when we arrived and we were able to get straight into our room which made an early arrival following an overnight flight from new zealand easier. the room was 'traditional holiday inn' - basic but tidy, but the bed was huge and comfortable and offered 5 grades of pillow!we had a pool-side room which was a bonus, and imagine our surprise when we looked out of the window and could see the hollywood hillside houses just under mullholland drive including the famous high tower (featured in several famous movies) - indeed this view encouraged us to walk up into the hills as our first trip, rather than down to hollywood boulevard. try it - the views are absolutely wonderful, and it turned out that the hollywood bowl is only about 15 minutes away, through the maze of steps and alleys.as mentioned elsewhere, hollywood boulevard is only a couple of blocks away, and walking is perfectly safe at any time. the staff were all friendly and helpful, and the hotel breakfasts were good and satisfying......and the internet was free! top marks from us.

perfect stay and location i have gotten away from staying at holiday inns because it is hit or miss on the quality of the hotels. i took a risk staying here but i was not disappointed at all. the location was fantastic, parking was cheap, rooms clean, beds comfy, service perfect, breakfast was wonderful.fantastic stay and i would def return here when i go back to hollywood.

loved hotel...ordinary tours !!!!!!!!!!! this hotel is in a wonderful location, clean, tidy and has fantastic bed linen and pillows. we were able to check in really early in the morning after our flight. this saved us sitting around all day until a late check in time.ask for a room on the pool side of the property, on a high level as noise on road side is out of control !!!!!!!!!room service was great, except watch the prices they are all plus tax so a little misleading, but generally food here is sooooooooo cheap and great. who said that you cannot eat healthy food in la, we have eaten really well for good prices !!!!!!!this is a great located hotel, can walk everywhere !!!!!!!!although.........alex on the concierge desk was fantasic, but some of the tours we did were ordinary.the hollywood sight seeing tour which the hotel recommends is okay but very dsiorganised, they cut our tour short for no real reason except the company's disorganisation.we then did a organised haunted hollywood tour .....ordinary !!!!!!!!! it didnt seem to be a real tour and we basically got ripped off !!!!!!!!!!!!! note to young players. must go to the panini cafe on santa monica blvd, have the chicken kabab.......to die for !!!!!!!!la is great.......shopping is great and this hotel was great !!!!!!!

great location my son and i stayed one night and made a last minute reservation. many competing properties were sold out, or cost $300-$500 per night. we were pleasantly surprised with the location (just a couple blocks off hollywood blvd), the service and cleanliness. would certainly stay there again.

fantastic location first up, the location of this hotel is fantastic! it's takes about 10min to get to the hollywood walk of fame, chinese theatre and the hollywood and highland shopping centre. a nice bonus is the free shuttle service to universal studios!the staff were lovely and the concierge alex was very helpful! he would be your go-to-guy for ideas on where to go for shopping and just general questions about the area. we also have to mention natasha who works in the bar éˆ¥?always friendly and nice to chat to!the rooms were quite spacious and clean éˆ¥?the bed was also quite comfortable (king). one of the good things in the hotel is the free internet!! the only down side of the hotel has been mentioned a few times in other reviews éˆ¥?the paper thin walls. we were lucky enough to not have any late night parties happening next to us, but every bang, knock and conversation can be heard.one thing though éˆ¥?donéˆ¥??› take the hoteléˆ¥??? recommendation of éˆ¥?¦¯heiréˆ¥?tour guide guy éˆ¥?even though he took us to most places in one day, we found him hard to understand and struggled to stay awake.nice place to stay and would recommend this hotel to any budget conscious traveller.

good location but some problems let me start by saying the hotel is in a fantastic location. 5 minute walk to the hollywood bowl, stars hand prints etc. the rooms were clean and had large comfortable beds and pillows. we had a room facing the street and the traffic noise outside didn't bother us at all - with the window shut you could barely hear it.we could however hear our neighbours having an extremely loud party at 3am. i've never come across a hotel room before with such paper thin walls. it sounded like the party was happening in my room. i could have easily joined into their conversations. called down to the front desk though and they fixed the problem promptly.the in room complimentary internet worked on the first night and that was it. the maintenace man tried several times to fix it unsuccessfully. the do have free internet in the foyer too.the power went off one night for about 4 hours but not the hotels fault as the whole area was out. lastly our toilet backed up one night and was disgusting. took about half an hour for someone to come and fix it.to be honest, the hotel really is in a good position. we did have some problems with our room but at least the room was clean. i think maybe we were unfortunate with the things that happened to us. there is a small supermarket, liquor shop, chinese restaurant, subway and cleaners located over the road which was very handy. the staff were helpful and i would consider staying here again.

loved the service what a great location! only a short walk to the hollywood walk of fame. the staff were fantastic. the concierge staff were amazing, nothing was too much trouble. i cannot recommend this place highly enough!

we would stay here again. we booked a double on priceline day of for $100 plus taxes for a double. generally everything surpassed our expectations: the staff was really friendly, they gave us the type of room we requested, and there wasn't nearly as much street noise as expected for a saturday night. the only complaint is it is always unfortunate when one has to pay for parking. here it is $20 a pop. other than that, we have no complaints and recommend this hotel. the location is great!

a great option for the bowl, and for just hanging out in the city came in from our of town to stay here one evening for a business meeting which was early the next morning. hotel located just down the street from the hollywood bowl. the decor was nice, with some style. our room was on the street-side but was actually not so noisy into the room with the weekend traffic. in fact room was fairly sound proof, bathroom size was good for two of us, the bed was about the best part, contemporary in hotel styling, very comfortable, with brushed cotton sheets and duvet (white) and a lot of pillows! room had a sitting area as well, with desk, which was great for a feeling of having some work space, including a dressing mirror which was great for my practicing (am a musician; my business meeting was an audition). i did take a cue from another reviewer and signed up for the holiday inn priority club, which gave me a $6 discount on the daily parking ($14, from $20) and the couple of free bottles of water in the room. the coffee maker is more of a pot, rather than individual serving dispenser, so we were able to make hot tea for two easily. did not take advantage of the drink coupon at the bar. loved also having the free internet access, something i don't even get at a higher end la hotel in the downtown area. hotel had a billing problem, some kind of misconnect with hotwire on the charge, but by later in the week that was straightened out. would certainly stay here again, for any la get away time, especially if you are out and about sightseeing or concert going.

great location the hotel is in a perfect location, about a 2 minute walk from hollywood blvd - shopping, restaurants, walk of fame, chinese mann theatre, kodak theatre and all the la tour companies. the hotel offers a free shuttle bus to and from universal studios which is handy.the room was great. the bathroom a bit small but fine. we got 2 free bottles of water a day which was excellent.

good location, friendly staff we are priority club members so we often stay at holiday inns. the place is a great location, walk down the hill to the grauman theater and the mall down the hill was even open on xmas day with lots of nice restaurants and shops. the staff was very very friendly. we had problems with the television and the engineer was there in about 5 minutes to fix it. the room was a little small for three of us (just two double beds and nothing else except a room with just a king size bed and we had our daughter with us). they made sure we got a book of discount coupons that saved us money in the mall and other places and were full of advice. it is good value for the location. it was a very pleasant experience.

good location, clean and great service the hotel is located right next door to the renaissance. it is just a few minutes walk to hollywood blvd and the kodak theatre and chinese theatre, and a 10 minute drive to universal studios. considering the hotel was on a major road, the bedroom was very quiet. in other words the location is great. the hotel had a clean lobby, lounge areas, and bedroom. this was pleasing to see. guest services were pleasant, in particular there was one older male with a strong american (brooklyn?/ movie character style accent) who was extremely bubbly and helpful. it was nice to see him caring about the guests and trying hard to assist them. there was three of us in this party and although this is not a grand hotel, we would certainly recommend it as a middle of the range (affordabilty) stay.

noisy and smelly, other than that - ok tired and not really clean hotel.rooms looking up to the highland are really noisy, i changed the room for the pool-looking one after the first night.smells from the kitchen are permiating all hallways and getting inside rooms as well (at least on the first, fourth and sixth floors).sound insulation overall is lousy - tv's and mobile phones from the adjoining rooms are heard.staff is polite and helpful.

pretty good hotel. pretty good hotel. rooms are average. location is great if you have a car and want to go to beverly hills, universal studios and hollywood. i would recommend everyone in signing up to be a priority club member because you get a complimentary drink (beer/wine), newspaper, 2 large bottles of aquafina water and discounted parking ($12 instead of $20). pretty good deal considering priority club is free.

excellent location and nice hotel this hotel was very good and i was pleasantly suprised.the room was spacious, clean and had all the necessities. it also was only a short walk to everything in hollywood and to the redline train. the front desk was friendly and the desk staff even signed us up for the holiday inn frequent traveller plan which allowed us to get free water, late check out and a free drink at their bar.i only wish they would have told us about the list they have of places that you can access with bus or train and the details on how to get to each place. (ask for it if you are staying there without a car!) it was a great find - unfortunately, we didn't find it until we were leaving.

does exactly what it says on the tin.... i stayed her for six nights in october and felt i got value for money.i arrived late at night and was unsure if there would be anyone at the desk when i arrived. the night porters were there and checked me in quickly and easily no fuss which was great.the purpose of my visit was to see genesis at the hollywood bowl. the hotel was literally a 5 min walk from the bowl and also the walk of fame so location wise it scored 10 out of 10 for me. the hotel overlooks a busy street but i had a room at the back that overlooked the pool. so i was never disturbed by noise even with the window open.my room was large with a large bathroom. it was very clean and spacious. the hotel was clean and staff friendly. complimentary water was left each day, as was a newspaper. facilities included a pool and spa ( both very clean) and a small gym.i had read some rather unsavoury reviews on this site and must admit i wasn't sure what to expect but i was very pleasantly surprised. the staff were eager to help and assisted on many occasions with directions and the like. lots of maps and bus timetables pre printed at the front desk for visitors, which i found very helpful the shuttle bus to universal came in handy too. also they locked away passports and valuables at the desk for us.a note about the area:there are a few bums near the church on the corner and i had read this in the reviews and it worried me. they are there everyday but were no problem at all. they don't beg theyéˆ¥??™e just there- although i can see that if youéˆ¥??™e on your own its a little unnerving. unfortunately itéˆ¥??? a city and you see a lot of this. don't let it put you off your stay though - the pricey renaissance hotel is on the same corner as the bums thus proving it doesn't matter how much you shell out for a hotel they will still be there!overall i had a great stay and would recommend this hotel.

no complaints from me i haven't been to hollywood since the late 70's, so when i took my 16yo daughter there i was pleasently surprised.we took the city shuttle bus from lax to union station and then the subway to hollywood/highland. holiday inn is a short walk up highland. this cost about $10 total and it took about 45 minutes from the airport.the location was perfect for our trip - very close to hollywood blvd and its attractions yet quite quietthey have a secluded pool/jacuzzi, small pub and resturant. there is a small mall across the street - starbucks, subway, grocery and pizza.the staff is friendly and helpful - they suggested a city tour .it was a small van and we were the only 2- it was personable and a lot of fun. cost for 3 hour _ $90.- beverly hills,melrose, rodeo,etcthey have a free van to universal studios - it is very near 10-15 minutes.we took public transit everywhere else even the beach. walk about 10 minutes south to santa monica blvd and you can catch the bus to santa monica and venice beach.we also took the bus called fairfax on hollywood blvd to melrose and shopped at all the clothing boutiques. this is a short trip and a shoppers paradise.we enjoyed our stay at the holiday inn and recommend it.

good location shame hollywood is such a dump the hotel is fine and is a short walk to the hollywood highland or the hollywood bowl. the lobby is very small and looks newly refitted. the rooms are clean and modern we were on the top floor in a room overlooking the pool so we had a good view of the hills and had no noise problems. the resturant serves a good buffet breakfast for around $12 which is well worth it. there is a subway starbucks store over the road which is very handy.

great location this is a great hotel if you want to walk into hollywood, its only a 10 minute walk to the walk of fame. we checked in after a 13 hour flight and the staff were great, they had a room available and we went straight to our room, when we opened the door, there were 2 single beds, not the ideal situation for my wife and i, we booked a double room and were told by the front desk staff they in the us this means 2 single beds?? but after a bit of a discussion the manager found us a king size room, all beit a disabled room, but that was fine, the room was very clean and spacious. the concierge was very helpful, nothing seemed to be a problem and our requests were met with a smile and a result. food was also very good, i recommend the breakfast buffet which was around us$13 and they had plenty of everything. overall this was a very good hotel for the price and location we wanted, i would recommend it to anyone who wants to be close to the action. another bonus is that they have a free shuttle to universal studios in the morning, just book the day before and you get picked up late afternoon.

better than i expected. we are platinum members with holiday inn. i actually redeemed points to stay here. i don't think it was worth 50,000 points for 2 nights, but that's my problem.we did have to move rooms. the first one had a horrid smell of smoke, even though the hotel is all non-smoking. it kills me how people just totally disregard that. anyway, they were very quick to move us to room 701. very quiet location and no smell of smoke!there is an odd smell in the lobby. it smells like grease or something from a nearby ktchen. other than that, it was very clean, and such a great location for us. we walked over to the shopping area every night and ate all 3 of our meals at the california pizza kitchen. great salads and wine!!!we took a starline tour (started by the kodak theatre) of movie stars homes. they discounted it $7 per person, which made it $30 per person for 2 hours. if you take this tour, you must ask for lisa as your guide! she is fabulous and the tour was fabulous too! we were filmed for a movie pilot (david faustino...bud bundy from married with children) saw dr. phil on his porch (his house was my absolute favorite!!) and saw peter faulk (sp) taking a walk. i am not a 'tour' type of gal, but i would go with lisa again on the same tour in a heart beat!!! make sure you get the 'open air' van.we tried getting on the ellen show, but that is a whole different story. anyway, i hope this helps. i am a very picky person when it comes to cleanliness of hotel rooms, and while i did wear my flip flops the entire time i was in the room......it was very clean, and the beds very comfortable too!

aussies go hollywood i will start with the positives. the staff at the hotel are very helpful and courteous. the rooms are very clean and the hotel has a nice overall feel to it. there is plenty of hot water at shower time. our favourite part was the hot spa and the pool which was a great size for my two kids aged 11 and 8. there is also a complimentary shuttle bus to universal studios which was a bonus too.what i didn't like was the size of the two double beds. they were thesmallest double beds i've ever seen and pretty impossible to sleep two adults in the bed, so my husband and i each slept with one of ourchildren for more room, but not much sleep was had. i mentioned to the hotel staff that the beds were too small and to their credit theysupplied me with a rollaway bed so i could get some sleep the next night.i thought the location of the hotel was a bit far away from hollywoodboulevard when walking back and forth with the children. there are homeless people on the corner that we had to walk past constantly and although they didn't ask us for money, i certainly didn't feel safe at night. there is a lot of construction going on right near the hotel and the footpaths are all unlevel (you really have to watch your step and it could be dangerous for children and older tourists at night time) and there are roadworks on the corner which are in the way too. there is also no laundry to do any washing although they do offer a laundry service which is out of most people's budget. refrigerators can be hired for a fee but availability is not guaranteed. i got ripped off when buying a carton of milk from a mini mart on hollywood boulevard. he charged me $5.50 and when i complained that it was too expensive, he told me that, it's hollywood boulevard, m'am. on our last day we saw there was a mini mart right across the road from the holiday inn, so buy your milk from there instead.i wouldn't recommend staying at this hotel if you are travelling withchildren or elderly people mainly because of the location and the construction mess that is going on at the moment.

an excellent start to our america trip! we stayed at the holiday inn walk of fame for 4 nights in july 2007. we were travelling around america for 3 weeks on an average budget and this was the perfect start to our trip.the location was faultless - only a 5 minute, safe walk to the walk of fame and chinese mann theatre. the staff were amazing - really helpful and helped us to feel at home. they organised trips for us and advised us on where to go.the room was big and clean - couldn't fault it and the hotel has internet access. the pool area was a standard size but to be honest we didn't expect to get a pool in the centre of hollywood and the jacuzzi and gym were nice extras.we were actually sad to leave - as we felt so comfortable and safe here. a great hotel for young travellers and families alike. we would stay again.

hollywood accommodation stayed recently for 4 nights with 2 kidsvery nice hotel.very close to hollywood - 5min walk.had no problems with security at night in the area.hotel was very clean and there were no bedbugs.would recommend and would stay again.we used vip american tours for our transfers. booked over the internet prior to leaving. excellent company and very well priced.hope this helps someone, feel free to email with questionsjohn

great - just 1 irritation (ok 2) this hotel is less than a 5min stroll to the walk of fame. our room was enormous, clean, and newly renovated. front desk staff and concierge all very friendly and polite. recommended a private tour that we thoroughly enjoyed - (even though quite pricey). $20 per day to park, but priority members get a slight discount. they have a free shuttle to universal studios, that even took us to our restaurant for dinner on the friday evening.something that really annoys me about holiday inn's is that even though you pay extra to have bed breakfast, they then whack you with extra taxes (you pay tax on the entire price of your stay - so why do they tax you again on the price of the breakfast???). i was also not impressed that they automatically add 20% to any check/bill as a gratuity, and then have the cheek to leave additional space for another tip - we were caught out the first time because we didnt check properly !
great location view from the sixth floor overlooking the freeway

good location, very attentive staff. we arrived in this hotel after a 20 hour trip from ireland plus 1 hour in a cab from lax with a driver that hardly spoke english. it was therefore with relief that the service at the front desk was exemplary to say the least. throughout our three day stay the staff of this place went beyond the call of duty on several occasions. from recommending the tours that were suited to us rather than the ones that were the most expensive, to remembering what we ordered the night before in the bar and restaurant to even offering to order tickets for a local baseball game after merely offering an interest in the sport.on top of this are a private swimming pool and jacuzzi (in the middle of busy hollywood), very nice food in the restaurant and attentive staff. yes, i would stay there again if i were to go to hollywood again. the only thing i was a bit surprised about was the overpricing of the breakfast +$30 for two.

great for us got a great deal on hotwire not knowing which hotel we were booking. my wife is from the area and we expceted to see a lot of old friends, but being so close to the tourist thing we got a differect experience than what we have in the past. blocks from hollywood blvd and the subway, we walked down the road to restarurants during the day and bars/night clubs at night. the rooms were clean and ours had a great view. cleaning people are in the halls all day, but are quiet and polite. got to know one of the front desk workers who was very nice.

very good location this hotel is in a great location. i found it to be clean and the staff friendly. they are under some construction right now, but they are trying not to be too intrusive. under other recommendations i did get a room on the pool side and even though i was next to the elevator, it was pretty quiet. just be careful of hidden charges. everytime i asked the concierge a tourist question, although minimal, there was a room charge for it.

great location, ok hotel it would be hard to beat the location of this hotel. it is a few blocks (and a few homeless campsites) from the walk of fame, and easy walking to the hollywood bowl. but, this can be a problem since traffic outside the hotel is horrible. we stayed when there were concerts at the hollywood bowl, so trying to get up the street to turn into the hotel was not easy. then you get the loud throngs of people walking and driving from the bowl in the early morning hours. request a room on the pool side!! parking is limited and expensive, and on busy nights, your car may be buried two or three cars deep, so allow extra time in the morning for the staff to unbury your car. the room was holiday inn average. small, but clean. asked the desk staff for a recommendation for a mexican restaurant nearby, and he sent me to a place that looked like it closed a few years ago. stay here for the location, and just put up with the rest!

good location and friendly (restaurant) staff stayed here in late june, 2007. standard but very comfortable/well presented holiday inn rooms. i asked for a room overlooking the rear of the hotel/pool area/hillside (to avoid facing the busy highway outside) and received this. but my room number x13, backed on to the elevator shafts and vending area, which did lead to some irritating background noise at times, including in the quiet hours. i could have asked to move, but didn't, but i'd avoid these rooms in the future.lovely very clean pool area to the rear of the hotel. lots of places to sit and relax and pools looked good.ate breakfast and evening meals at the hotel's own restaurant, for convenience's sake and was pleased i did. very friendly staff who worked well together and for whom nothing was too much trouble. they made you feel very welcome and were very personable. food was good, quite a good choice, buffet some evenings and very well priced. proved very popular on the friday evening and had to wait about 15 minutes for a table.the hotel is well maintained and is well located just a short (5 minute) stroll up from the hollywood/highland metro station on the red line. at the moment, they are digging the road/pavements/sidewalks up between the metro and the hotel, but apart from some minor detours and a lot of dust, this didn't prove too problematic. they are also building a new hotel or apartment complex next door, but that really didn't cause any distruption whatsoever. sticking with the external factors, there were 2 or 3 people sleeping rough down from the hotel, outside the hollywood church, but they remained covered up all the time (fast asleep) and were not a problem, so no need to worry.

great place. we stayed at the holiday inn in june (for 7 days). we found it to be a great location. we could walk to the walk of fame, grauman's theatre, kodak theatre, and the hollywood and highland center (which was a great place to eat, shop, grab a cup of coffee in the morning). driving to places like warner brothers in burbank and the getty museum were very easy. we were about an hour's drive from the airport and the beach in santa monica (both with traffic factored in). the hotel was clean, we always had plenty of hot water, and we loved it that whenever we came back from sight seeing the staff always greeted us with, welcome back.

a nice hotel i stayed at the holiday inn walk of fame from may 28th to june 6th/07. it is a very nice hotel, my room was clean and with a nice view to the hills. the free high speed internet is great! the location is perfect because walking for a few minutes you are in the middle of the hollywood boulevard, close to the kodak and the grauman's theaters. the hollywood and highland mall is very close to the hotel and is pretty good. however, the breakfast buffet is very expensive and the parking rate is an absurd.

great !! i usually get a 4* priceline hotel in bev hills...but they were tough to come by so this three star in hollywood was awarded. oh no !! i thought.. a holiday inn.. i have passed this hotel hundreds of times heading to bh and always vowed i would never stay there.. but... surprise.. it's a great property.. cheap parking(only $20) a decent restaurant, and a very..very...very friendly and hospitable staff.. congrats to the owner of this property.. it's great. the day after i checked out they were going to put new, upscale, mattresses in all the rooms so you will be pampered.. if you don't want the noise, ask for a room in the back, over the pool.. one thing.. they are building something in the hollywood hills behind the hotel so the contruction begins at 7 am...even saturday but the hammering isn't too intrusive... besides, you in la, how long are you going to spend in your room.. get out there and have fun !! you'll like the holiday inn on highland..

undesirable! if you stay at this hotel you will pay to park on the hotels property. this is an extra 20 dollars per day on top of the room fee and taxes. the hotel will not tell you this until you check out. my wife and i stayed on the fourth floor facing the street. the traffic below was really loud, even after a couple drinks. the bed was hard, so we did not get a good nights sleep. there are nicer hotels closer to the action. i would not stay there again

perfect location, excellent staff after reading previous reviews, i must admit i was extremely worried. i was travelling on my own and as a young woman, obviously i needed to research area and hotel properly. on my arrival after a long flight from london, staff were excellent. friendly and very helpful. i had pre booked a tour for following day, which they called and confirmed for me. they also advised best company for my trip to magic mountain, which was organised for me with no fuss. they asssited with mail to be sent, safety deposit boxes and always said hi when i passed through reception.rooms were clean, and a fair size, coming from england, i think the beds are huge! and i can verify there was no signs of bugs or any other scary things!! they were cleaned daily and housekeeping staff were as friendly as their colleagues on reception.the corridors of hotel could do with updating - there is nothing that a coat of paint and new accessories wouldnt fix. the restaurant was good too - once again staff couldnt have been nicer - the breakfast was lovely. there is a bit of a food smell where the elevators are next to restaurant, but not too bad that its puts you off!!finally, i just want to say that this is the first review i have ever written but i was determined to let people know that previous reviews are no longer valid for this hotel. combined with great location, walking distance to hollywood blvd and all attractions, this was a great place to stay!!

good location we've just returned from our two week holiday and we stayed at the holiday inn hollywood - walk of fame for the first two nights. the location was good, only about 5 minute walk from the walk of fame etc. there is a subway and small grocery store accross the road which was quite handy. the rooms were clean, although i spotted couple of stains on the mattresses, also there was no fridge. our room was facing the main road and there seemed to be a gap between the window and the wall, which meant that we could hear the passing traffic all the time. hotel breakfast was very good and reasonably priced $12.95 for the full breakfast buffet. this hotel is also very close to the universal studios and the hotel provides free shuttle service to and from the studios. the hotel staff were very friendly and helpfull. the only thing which bothered me about this hotel was that our clothes started to smell of cooking/food as soon as we stepped outside our room - but i would definetely recommend this hotel if you are looking for something clean and in good location.

our home away from home just to let you know, i always read the reviews, but have never written one, i was so happy with our stay here i actually wrote to the chain as well. oh and i travel alot . after doing lots of searching online i booked 2 rooms at this hotel for our stay feb. 21-26, 2007. we were so happy with our stay i can't tell you enough. the location is excellent, walking distance to the kodak theatre, walk of fame and shopping. burger king, starbucks, subway, and great pizza across the street. my room faced the nice pool area, and my cousins room faced the street and the hills, great views. the rooms were average size and very well kept daily, good tv's, no fridge. the restaurant was excellent, food and service and fair pricing. we also had room service. there is also a small lounge. the front desk and concierge staff were extremely friendly and helpful and always welcomed us back upon our return. they booked a taxi for us caesar to attend the laker's and the king's games at the staples center. he dropped us off and picked us up after the games. we made this trip last march, 2006, and learned that it is very difficult to get a taxi after the games. he also took us back to lax. i was travelling with my cousin who has special needs, and he was extremely good with him, as were all of the staff at the hotel. it is the people who make the place, and kudos to all of the staff and management. we asked to speak with the management upon checkout and learned that there are upgrades planned for the next year, which is great. we look forward to our return to the holiday inn walk of fame.

great location and free internet i got the hotel for $95 a night on priceline. i think i could have beat this for the hotel. the hotel is in a great location. a 5 minute walk to hollywood, wax museum, metro, and many other things. there is also a functional market, subway, starbucks, and burger king across the street. the room was okay. there was free internet which you can't beat. we also got free bottle water each day. overall i would stay here again due to not having a car so the location was perfect. also universal studios was one stop away on the metro. room 721 was clean with no bugs in the bed. the staff was extremely friendly. they also allowed early checkin and knew the area really well.

all we could ask for a short stay i'm a little surprised that this hotel doesn't have a higher ranking (63rd at the time of writing this review), as it was just perfect for us in what we required for a 1 night stay - central location, clean and modern room, friendly and efficient service, great value for money. we couldn't fault it. we didn't get a chance to try the pool/jacuzzi, but it looked very nice from our bedroom window, and same with the gym.

great location - no complaints after planning several trips with the aid of tripadvisor i thought it only fair that i contribute some feedback.i always find it interesting when reading reviews that what seems to bother one person will not bother another. human nature i guess. i have no complaints about this hotel at all. none. the staff were friendly and helpful, check-in check-out were quick and easy, clean tidy, safe and location is the real winner.my buddy and i stayed here from 2 - 5 november 2006. we were not looking for a huge party type holiday so this hotel gave us exactly what we needed. perhaps a 5 minute walk to hollywood blvd. restaurants, pig and whistle pub, burger king, subway, liquor store, convenience store and hollywood highland shopping centre all within a 5 minute walk. very central for everything in hollywood. hertz rental car outlet about a 3 minute walk away also.the only negative was the construction going on around the area, but that is hardly the hotels fault. i'll definately be back to los angeles and this hotel. thumbs up.

best service ever! we've just spent two nights at the holiday inn - hollywood walk of fame and i can't say enough about the outstanding service.the hotel itself is typical... slightly outdated but fully functioning, clean, a good location for universal studios (5 min drive -- though it has a shuttle), 2 blocks to a nice shopping center with plenty of restaurants, and the pool area looked nice as well, though it was too cold for us to enjoy this time.there is a restaurant onsite with a great breakfast buffet. $12/adults, $7 for kids with a wonderful selection of truly delicious food drinks. we thought it was very good value and again, exceptional service. they also have complimentary internet access in the rooms, which is a rare bonus, we have found.i booked this hotel through priceline at $70/night (i believe), and was very pleased.my thanks to every staff person... from the parking attendant to the waiter to the front desk and the housekeepers! you should be proud of the impression you've left on your guests!

no problems my boyfriend and i stayed at this hotel for five nights in january, and we had a really good time there.it is a holiday inn, and therefore pretty basic, but we had absolutely no problems. our room was clean, decent-sized and nicely decorated, and this was ultimately the case with the rest of the hotel; it was a very pleasant place to spend a few days. our room was on the sixth floor, at the front of the hotel, and we had a huge window with a really pretty view, which was always nice to wake up to! if i was to complain about one aspect of the room, it would be the bathroom, which was quite dated and bland, but as it was clean, we really didn't mind this.we thought the location of the hotel was fantastic; some of the reviews on this site had led me to believe that we were facing a long, terrifying walk down a deserted backstreet to hollywood boulevard, but it was absolutely fine! the walk to hollywood/highland takes ten minutes at most, the road is very well-lit and there was busy traffic at every time of day, so we never felt in any danger. there were a couple of homeless people, but they never bothered us-and to be honest, i'd be shocked to go to a big city like la and not find homeless people. across the road from the hotel is a small complex, with a starbucks, subway, convenience store, sushi restaurant and others, which was really handy if we found ourselves suddenly hungry. we didn't have a car, but hollywood is great for public transport, with plenty of buses, and the subway, to get us where we needed to go. on top of that, hollywood/highland has plenty of shops and restaurants to keep you occupied. obviously, hollywood isn't as nice an area as somewhere like beverly hills, but we kept to the busy areas and always felt completely safe.we booked tours to disneyland/california adventure with the tour desk, and had no problems with these; however, we would not recommend taking the tours of la offered. we took the early evening tour, which was basically just four hours of driving around in silence! it helped us get a good orientation of the city, but really wasn't worth the price; however, i won't blame the hotel for that, because it was our choice to take it, and they never pushed us into booking anything. we ate at the hotel restaurant for breakfast, and had the continental buffet, which was about $9, and totally worth it. i would definately recommend starting the day off there.if i was to complain about anything, it would be that some of the staff weren't quite as friendly as they perhaps could have been. they were perfectly nice and helpful whenever we spoke to them, but rarely came forward with a smile or a 'hello' when we passed by; it's not a huge problem, but it's things like that which can really improve a hotel experience.i'm sure we will return to la, and if we were to return on a similar budget, then i'm also sure we will strongly consider staying in this hotel again. we loved the city, and the hotel played a big part in us enjoying our time there so much-it wasn't the most fancy of places, but it was comfortable, clean and welcoming and we were more than happy with that!

perfectably acceptable hotel stayed at this hotel for two nights stop before travelling to hawaii. did check the bed for bed bugs and not a sign! we were in room 404 which was to the front of the property but used to living in a busy city so noise was not a problem. room and bathroom large and good shower pressure. could do with an update but my main concern is that a room is clean, which it was. staff at the front desk were very helpful. we wanted to buy a digital camera and they pointed us in the right direction (bestbuys) and we got a great bargain compared to uk prices. didn't eat in the hotel at all but did have a drink in the bar (also very friendly staff). had breakfast in bob's, just down from the church which was used to film sister act. great when you are awake at 0530! the next morning we had breakfast in mel's drive in which was like something out of grease and excellent. only 15 mins walk from hollywood highland which has a few restaurants. would recommend the pig and whistle pub which do great food as well - also not far from the hotel. tip for uk travellers - didn't realise you need to show id in most shops if using a visa card. even for a meal they sometimes asked. ended up having to carry the passports about with us, just in case. dot iain, edinburgh, scotland
the best suprise is no suprise! pool

don't let the bed bugs bite! even though the location was good (two blocks from hollywood boulevard), the discovery of bed bugs and the lack of concern from staff was not.after waking one morning to find my sister and i with bed bug bites we advised reception. we received promises of a room change and were told the manager would contact us upon our return that afternoon.after arriving back at the hotel no one was aware of our problem and we had to again ask for another room and move our own luggage.the bites lasted for three weeks and were red and very very itchy.unfortunately we had booked and paid for our accommodation prior to travelling. our travel agent is now attempting to recover some costs.

nice hotel my finance and i stayed at the holiday inn hollywood recently and overall had a very pleasant stay. the hotel is quite well located, although not as close to hollywood attractions as say the renaissance or roosevelt hotels, which i have stayed at previously.the service was friendly and efficient, and our room was clean and quite spacious, although some of the fittings (especially the lighting) were dated and probably could be replaced. our room did not have a fridge, and although an ice bucket was supplied and complimentary ice was provided on each floor, having a small fridge would have been convenient.this hotel is about a 5 minute walk to hollywood boulevard and there is a great market and a starbucks right across the street and an internet cafe is very close by.we had an excellent stay here and we would certainly recommend this hotel, but next time we will probably try and stay somewhere right on hollywood boulevard again.

great location i am quite surprised by some of the reviews that i have read about this place as we thought it was great. it is so close to hollywood blvd etc. we didn't find it very safe in the nights but that is the general area. the hotel itself was very pleasant as were the staff. we had food there too - quite overpriced, but nice if you are really hungry and don't want to go far. we had no trouble with bugs or anything really. we found this place a pleasant stay close to all the tourist attractions.give it a go!

stay away! arriving at reception the first thing that hit us as we walked through the door was the smell of old burnt fat. the restaurant was open plan into the lobby and either the extractors in the kitchen were non existant or not being used. the lifts then smelt of the fat taking you up to the rooms. the corridors in the hotel were tatty and in need of redecoration. the toilet was blocked in our room. i called down to reception and it was fixed within 10 mins. our first evening we went to the bar, which was empty - not surprising as it was besides the restaurant - that awful smell was lingering - we had one drink and left to visit the hotel next door (which was our first choice and was unfortunately full) it was beautiful beyond compare. unless they do something about the kitchens don't bother going, drive right past!

the people are great, the bedbugs are not. i travel frequently for the goverment and i have stayed stayed at this hotel before with no problems. i stayed in room 609 on monday night, november 27th, 2006 and woke up tuesday with about 25 unwanted guests in bed with me! i am very aware of what budbugs are and how to spot them.housekeeping appeared immediatly after i called them and told me they were ants! make no mistake, they were small, red, and matched every picture of a bedbug i've ever seen. the one on my neck was engorged with blood. as i write this review today, my neck and ankles have multible bites and they itch. as i checked out the desk clerk still wanted to charge me for the room! i replied, that won't be happening. after a short conversation with her manager, she indicated to me that the room, parking and bar tab from the night before have been taken care of.if you check in to this hotel, please inspect your sheets and pillows as soon as you enter the room.i like this hotel and the location, but i will never stay there again.
lots to like about this hotel more photos

great location, friendly hotel great location. arrived at 11.30 am and were able to check straight (bonus after 18 hours of flying). staff very friendly and helpful. breakfast in restaurant excellent. asked for room away from street as recommended in trip advisor. walk to hollywood boulevard, walk of fame, graumann's etc. short distance to universal studios and hotel has small shuttle bus (book early though, only holds about 9 people). would definitely stay here again.

hotel ok but location not for us we arrived around 11am from anaheim and front desk staff were able to get us our room of choice, notwithstanding the early check in. this may have been a result of being a priority club member but was appreciated regardless. nothing wrong with our room and hotel was convenient to hollywood blvd, which is a bit overated.conciege recommended a particular 'movie stars homes' tour which was sub-standard and begs the question as to what 'incentive' he might have been receiving.overall, the hotel was fine but in hindsight we would have been better off staying down at santa monica where the general location would have been nicer, or not bothering to stay in la at all, instead completing our tours from anaheim.

dingy rooms/barely ada compliant?? i booked this hotel on priceline.com. i called in advance for a non-smoking room and was told there were none available, even though their own website showed that they were available. it wasn't until i told them that i was a priority club member that i got a non-smoking room.the non-smoking room smelled of cigarettes and grease (can't imagine what the smoking rooms smelled like). the bed was hard. i had a handicapped accessible room (the only non-smoking room available). their wasn't a place to place my toiletry bag in the bathroom. i shower head did not detach. the bench for the shower was on the other end of the bathtub from shower head. with the low water pressure, i don't know how anyone immobile would be able to use the shower. other than size and space, i wouldn't recommend this room to someone handicapped.i was not pleased with this hotel. with so many other places to stay in hollywood (near hollywood and highland), i would not recommend this hotel at this time.

not really recommended we stayed here for three nights while on a three centre holiday. on the day we arrived we were told that the hotel was full and that we had to go and stay at another hotel (days inn) for the night, we were too tired to argue, this other hotel was a disgrace, it was disgusting, do not agree to be moved here!!!.the next day we went back to the holiday inn and we got a room, this room was fine, it was clean. the next day we went off on another part of our holiday but we were returning here for one last night before we returned home, when we checked in on the final night we got put in a smoking room when we had asked for non smoking. this room was not so good, it was cleaned in a rush so it was not cleaned properly. i would not recommend staying here as it is too much of a hit or a miss.

great location - they need a generator we stayed here in july this year for 4 nights, 2 adults and one 4 year old. handy location to walk to the tourist traps, but the hotel kept losing power - this happened 3 nights in a row, meaning no dinner in the restaurant, no power in the room, no elevators etc. there wasn't much they could do about it, but they made no effort to apologise, etc. the room itself was pretty basic, and it had no fridge, which could be rented for 10 dollars a night, and no laundry, which, when travelling with a child are pretty useful. i would stay there again for a night if i wanted to be close to the attractions, but not for any longer

liked the holiday inn before i start my review i like to tell people my expectations! i like a clean, cheap hotel that is near all the sites in a city. i believe you get what you pay for!! in the hollywood holiday inn this is certainly true. the hotel has a great location for exploring hollywood. it is on a busy road less than 5 minutes walk to hollywood boulevard. we felt very safe at all times of the day walking to and from it. our room was very clean and spacious and a nice size. we never ate in the hotel but the menu seemed good. the pool is average sized and the gym is tiny but we were too busy sightseeing to use these. we didnt have a car and managed just fine with the buses and metro that are located on hollywood boulevard. the hotel also run a free shuttle to universal studios which is very handy. we found all the staff to be very helpful.overall we enjoyed our stay here, it was perfect for what we wanted, a cheap cheerful clean place to lay our heads!!

disappointed, wouldn't recommend. we stayed at the holiday inn on the last leg of our honeymoon. what a let down!we arrived around 10pm after a 5 hour flight from hawaii. the restaurant and the bar were closed, so we had to go out to find food and drinks.we found the night time hollywood very intimidating. every block had a different gang on each corner, we felt we needed to keep our heads down when walking out, as drunks and homeless littered the streets.the room was very basic. it was clean but 'tired' the staff were ok, but do be aware of hidden charges on your credit card bill.our room was pre paid, and we charged nothing to our room.we were not prepared to pay $2.50 for each bottle of water in the room, as you can get it from the vending machine for $1.25!!checking my credit card bill on arrival back in the uk, we found mysterious charges from the holiday inn., and are waiting for an explanation from the hotel as to what these are for.we certainly wouldn't stay there again, as i am sure there are many other hotels within the area that are much better.

acceptable deal when they book you on the street side, you feel like living on the street, noisy. the rooms are ok and staff are quite helpful. parking charge is high but then they charge you the maximum (one day) charge only when your stay longer. there are many places for food so you don't have to eat in the restaurant which like many hotels is extremely overpriced for breakfast and lunch. diner rates are reasonable.don't expect to be close to all sites as anywhere in the us but it is very close to the walk of fame. street is dirty and but that is in many big cities. only beverly hills and bal air are clean but they have the money.the pool is good and the spa is truly hot, both a good place to relax after a full day of impressions.

good location this was my third visit to the usa.i am going to be a bit more generous than other writers. like someone else said below, it was probably the worst hotel we stayed in during our trip around the usa but i don't feel that means it was bad. we just had good places elsewhwere. it was probably a little bit on the high price side, but the location was good.no ants for us, it was clean and the room was very big! as with most hotels in this class, the water pressure sucked. the other drawback was the very slow lifts. the staff were to the point which can sometimes come across as unhelpful. but really they were nice and answered any question efficiently and without trouble. it was our first stop in the usa and the hotel had a lot of australians staying in it. that was good and bad, it depends on your view.yes, the bus to universal is good. beware there are other holiday inn branded shuttle buses also going to and from the studios so you could end up going back to the wrong hotel. honestly, i don't know how you could as the hotel name is pretty clearly displayed, but it happened to someone on our bus when they rushed on board the wrong bus by mistake and then had to get back from the wrong hotel to universal and catch the correct bus!alternatively, the hotel is so close (3 mins walk!) to the underground rail station at hollywoodhighland that goes straight to universal and it also cheap! we used that a second time to go back to universal to see a movie and check out all those shops at night. they say the distances in la are too long to walk, but with the pleasant weather it's not that bad. we walked a lot and caught a bus to venice beach and santa monica beach. never used a car. and only used a cab to get home from partying in west hollywood.some previous reviews said they were threatened by the walk to the hotel. i envisioned a dark spooky alleywal, but it's not like that at all! it's a 3 minute walk from the hollywood highland shopping centre and it's along the side of a brightly lit highway, including past a church! i wasn't afraid, but i'm also a 6'5 late twenties male. so it might be different if you're a single mum with kids or a gran, can't say.if you planned to spend a lot of time lounging around in the hotel, this may not be for you. but if you just want to crash there it's pretty good. huge bed, efficient staff, clean bathroom with big mirrors.

be prepared to share your room with tiny strangers we have recently returned from holiday inn walk of fame, on highland avenue, hollywood, la. the best feature about the hotel is the convenient location éˆ¥?only a 5 minute walk from hollywood boulevard, where youéˆ¥??’l find such attractions like the graumannéˆ¥??? chinese theatre, walk of fame, hollywood highland shopping mall, wax museum, ripleyéˆ¥??? believe it or not and guinness museums, and many souvenir shops and capitol records building to name a few. the hollywood bowl is within easy driving distance, as is the universal studios theme park (about 10 mins drive).the room was very clean and tidy with just one very tiny exception éˆ¥?ants! iéˆ¥??“ not sure if this problem is common throughout the entire hotel but we definitely had literally hundreds of these crawling all over the bedside areas (including some which managed to find their way onto the duvet) and the window area was all full of them (room 609). apart from this, the actual hotel itself was clean and tidy, and staff were also friendly. they do a free transfer to and from universal studios with the hoteléˆ¥??? own minibus, which is very handy. we found the hotel reception to be very average; iéˆ¥??“ not going to say they were rude like some other reviewers, because that was definitely not the case with us. the concierge is very friendly and approachable, heéˆ¥??? the one to call if you want to book a tour/limo, want info on attractions, etc. he was actually more helpful than the reception. the other staff are also extremely helpful; they are very quick to bring you fresh towels or razors, etc, etc. there is public internet access downstairs, but you have to use a credit card for this, otherwise there are modems in each room for laptops. there is a gym which is nothing to get too excited about (a treadmill and a weight machine to be exact). the hot tub and pool are nice although it is only 4ft deep, meaning its child friendly. there is also a restaurant located downstairs but we didnéˆ¥??› use it éˆ¥?why bother when you have so many italian pizza/pasta shops, subway, mcdonalds and burger king within 5 mins!if you are arriving at lax airport, then the best way to this hotel is by airport shuttle bus, which costs around $11 pp, you can also book this method to return to the airport via the concierge. i noticed that a lot of the previous reviews mention that the lifts were faulty, but i can report that this problem is sorted now éˆ¥?they may be slow, but definitely safe and not noisy.i would recommend the stars homes tour (beverly hills, rodeo drive and bel air), which lasts 2 hours and is definitely worth the money and of course, universal studios both of which are great fun for the full family.so, the best advice i can give if you are choosing this hotel is ask to see the room they give you before moving all your stuff in to avoid any unwelcome guests.

would stay here again! i stayed at the holiday inn on the walk on my first trip to la - and although it's obviously no 5 star hotel, i thought it was great! the rooms were in good condition, clean and of a good standard. the hotel staff were really friendly - have kept in contact with some of them. they were very helpful, and offered some great suggestions on things to do. the hotel driver was fantastic also.the rest of the hotel was in good condition, and of a good standard too. the gym was well kept, as was the pool area.we ordered room service a few times, and the food was always delivered in good time, and there was nothing to complain about. the restaurant was also nice - if you go over thanksgiving like we did you get a great feast!!the hotel is on a main road, but apart from the occasional big truck going past at night it wasn't a huge problem!it's a really short walk to the walk of fame and hollywood and highland (like 5 mins), and almost directly opposite the hotel there are a few shops including starbucks, subway and a mini mart (with the best pizza i have ever had - no lie!)it is also worth noting that the hotel offers free transportation to universal studios - huge selling point!!!!all in all it was a great hotel - would definately stay here again!

worst hotel of holiday without doubt, the worst hotel that we stayed in during our 3 week holiday in the states. it is situated alongside a very noisy seven lane motorway, and the only way to drown the noise was to turn the air-con up to very high so that there was an acceptable level of noise inside the room. the furnishing of the room was very delapidated and none too clean.immediately adjacent to the hotel, they were demolishing some old buildings, so there was airborne dust and debris falling onto guests who were using the swimming pool, plus the associated noise of this work, something that we had not been advised of when booking.the road between the hotel and the famous walk of fame is badly in need of repair on the broken and debris littered pavements. plus, it is a fairly intimidating walk when you are continually confronted by people begging for money, and the obvious drunks and druggies in that area.after breakfast, you can not get a snack or a drink at either the hotel or the swimming pool until the evening, unless you use the very limited vending machines.the staff are very ignorant, and are more concerned with talking to one another, than with the needs of the guests. and all seem only tip orientated. very definitely the hotel is not up to the standards of u.k. holiday inns, and certainly could not meet up with brit. requirements as a holiday hotel.the drinks at the bar, and the meals at the dining room, are very much overpriced, and there is no entertainment available. and other people that we met there, who were also most dissatisfied with every thing, and duly complained, were told, well what do you expect it is only a 3 star hotel!!. plus others who had, like us stayed in vegas prior to coming to this establishment, had pointed out that it cost exactly double the price for the room at this hotel, with none of the facilities that they had in vegas.the food at the hotel is very limited as well as being way overpriced, and once ordered, they bring your first course, along with your bill, which includes a 15 percent service charge. now i have no objection to paying a service charge if i am given service, but surely that decision must be at my discretion, not on the whim of some surly waiter or the hotel to decide for non existent service.all in all, a very poor hotel, and one that should be removed from brit. holiday brochures as being totally unsuitable for purpose.the concierges at the hotel are continually pushing the various trips that are available to the guests, and i would suggest that you give the tour of the stars homes a miss, as all you see are hedgerows, gates rooftops, a total and again overpriced joke.one saving grace of our stay there,was the trip to universal studios which must be recommended, absolutely superb. but under no circumstances must you book it through the concierge, as it is much, much cheaper if you get your own ticket at the gate when you get there. also, request the free shuttle bus to the studios from the hotel, as the concierge will not tell you about this, as he wants to push for the package deals on offer, so will not tell you about this aspect. i wonder why?all
