in all, this hotel should be designated as a motel just for transient clients rather than as a venue for a foreign holiday tourist, and we certainly would not stay there again, so be warned.

okay hotel - but watch for the credit card account. like other writers we too arrived home to find that we had been charged for our room even though it had been prepaid. i sent three emails ranging from polite to terse and also made two telephone calls - all with the same lack of response; i.e nil. so i complained through my bank and disputed the charge. we did get refunded, but the exchange rate had changed and we are still out of pocket. that's the negative. the positive - great location - but isn't hollywood a small place? three/four blocks and it is all over - not like we thought it would be. the guy at the travel desk was a gem - of the old school, knowledgeable and curteous - a rare find! the room was showing wear and tear but it was comfortable and not pokey. i do think that there might be better properties in the area.

can't fault this hotel i stayed with family ( 2 rooms) for 4 nights at holiday inn, and while there was nothing to rave about, we found the rooms clean and well maintained and the staff very friendly and helpful. the pool area was also well maintained with plenty of fresh towels and the spa great after walking all day. the position, especially for tourists without a car is the main reason i would recommend the hotel, as it is a 5 minute easy walk to the corner of hollywood and highland and the metro station as well as the hollywood tourist strip.we didn't eat at the hotel, but i can recommend the japanese restaurant which is right across the street where there is also a convenience store for snacks etc. a starbucks and a pizza place.

average hotel i stayed at this hotel for 3 nights during february. we arrived at around 8pm having driven down from san francisco. i have phoned the hotel to say that we would be arriving later (the room had been pre-paid in the uk). we had booked a non-smoking family room. we excitedly got our keys (we had a wonderful room at the hilton, san francisco and this one was more expensive so we had high expectations)....how disappointed were we!!! the decor was bland and worn but worse of all was the smell of smoke which hit us at the door!!! i immediately went back to reception and complained that we had booked a non-smoking room to which i was told there were none available (this had been booked months ago!!!) there was no explanation and no apology for not supplying the room we had booked. they moved us to a room which had been modified for 'disabled' use. the room was spacious but my daughters aged 16 and 12 would have to share the tiniest fold up bed. it just wasn't good enough. the following morning we returned to reception where the lady moved us to a 'family' room without any problems. we didn't eat at the restaurant as there are so many nearby. there is a subway directly across from the hotel. it is also within walking distance to the boulevard where there is a wide selection of places to eat. we particulary liked mel's diner.they are very keen to get you signed up for any tours at the conceirge desk.....and can be quite pushy. we did a tour of stars homes. also there is a charge for car parking (per night) which they are keen to enforce!!!the best aspect about this hotel is its location.....but it fails when it comes to customer service and the decor could do with a re-vamp. if i return to hollywood i would look at other options.

location, location, vacation we spent 6 nights at the holiday inn at the start of our holiday - it wasn't a great start. after a long flight, we wanted to check in straight away, but our rooms weren't ready - this was 4pm. we had to sit and wait in reception for about 1/2 hr, before they got us some rooms. the girl on reception was trying hard, and when they were ready she gave us a morning's complimentary breakfast. valet parking was $17 per day - the men were efficient and friendly.the rooms were clean and tidy - we had a fault on the second day with one of the toilets - this was repaired within minutes of us reporting it.we had breakfast every morning in the hotel - the choice was good (continental or full) and the staff were friendly and efficient.the location is really good - within easy walking distance of the walk of fame, kodak theatre, manns chinese theatre and shops. good access to interstate 5 and the 101 - these are the roads you need for disney, universal or six flags theme parks. the driving's not as bad as it looks in the movies!if we went back to this area we would stay here again.

horrible i wish i could give this hotel zero stars. i have spent the past month and a half in hotels around los angeles whilst waiting for my apartment to be ready. i am a very easy-going person and am not even remotely overly critical - which is why you should take what i say to heart. this has been by far and away the worst hotel experience i've ever had. the women who work at the front desk (ie - ignore you while they chat and then treat you rudely) are horrific. i repeatedly asked for a non-smoking room (i have a 3 year old with asthma) and twice was given a disgusting, smokey room. these rooms are as bad as any motel 6 (actually, worse) i was afraid to let my son walk around barefoot or touch the sticky, dirty furniture. beyond disgusting. and i have pretty low standards! one evening i realized that i needed a couple of towels. i phoned down to the front desk (the woman acted as if i was annoying her just by calling) and the woman told me if i wanted them i'd have to come and get them. it was 10pm and i was in my pajamas and my son was asleep so i couldn't leave him alone. even after explaining this the woman rudely said well, you can come and get them or not. to top it off i was charged by the hotel for my stay even though i had already paid through priceline. after reading some reviews on here, i can see that this has happened to other people. i also had a mysterious $75 charge which no one at the hotel can seem to explain to me. i have been given a serious run-around - but trust me, i will be getting my money refunded. don't let them take you for a ride too!! the location isn't worth all of this horror. there are many other better hotels in the area. try any of them before this one.

great hotel, great location my daughter and i stayed at this hotel during april 2006. as we were travelling alone, safety was important to us and this hotel was situated in a busy area so we had no problems there. we found all the staff to be very friendly and helpful and we were able to check into our room slightly early. we had a 2 double bed room and were very pleased with the size and cleanliness of the room. it was overlooking the street so a little bit of noise from there but nothing to worry about. with regard to location, couldn't get any better as it is only about a 5 minute walk to the hollywood walk of fame. we took advantage of the free hotel shuttle bus to universal studios on the saturday and on sunday did the movie stars home tour which is definitely worth doing just to appreciate the other world that they live in!!!! we didn't see as much as we were hoping to as the tube system is not very good and the buses not particularly direct so a car would have been handy (but then again, wouldn't have wanted to drive there!!) overall, very pleased with the hotel and would definitely stay there again.
great location - shame about the service hotel

good location, reasonable value we stayed here for 2 nights and found the hotel comfortable and not overly noisy (apart from the air conditioning). the staff were polite. the breakfast was good but pricey. the location was fine and not too far from holliwood boulevard or the holliwood bowl. one annoyance was that we picked up from other reviews that the free shuttle to universal studios gets booked up quickly. when i phoned prior to leaving the uk i was told that it would be ok to book on arrival. needless to say the shuttle was booked up when we arrived!howvere there is a tram stop on the corner of holliwood boulevard which is only one stop away from universal.

fantastic location we stayed at this hotel in september last year. this was our first visit to la and we had a fantastic time. this hotel was in a great location for visiting all the hollywood sites - just a five minute walk downhill to the hollywood-highland centre and the walk of fame. some reviews have commented on the walk back to the hotel at night but we felt perfectly safe and not at all worried at any time. the rooms were large in size even by american standards but why would you spending much time in there anyway. the concierge offered to order a taxi for us for $40 to take us to the airport. this turned out to be a lovely leather seated lincoln with a driver in a suit - well worth it and only a few dollars more than a shared van which we normally use. try looking at the intercontinental hotels group website for a good deal and while you are there sign up for the free priority club - doesn't cost anything but you get different offers at the hotels such as free drinks. there is a handy subway sandwich shop and grocery store across the road from the hotel which is handy for stocking up on juice etc. for eating there are plenty of choices on hollywood boulevard and we can highly recommend the hamburger hamlet. if you are planning to visit all the main sights then think about purchasing a city pass. you can buy this online before travelling or at the tour booth in the hollywood-highland centre. this covers your entry to the hollywood entertainment museum, the kodak theatre tour, the max factor museum (much more than makeup!) and a movie stars homes tour amongst other things. we also did the warner bros studio tour (you can get there easily by bus from hollywood boulevard) which was well worth it. we also did the nbc studio tour when we were there but i wouldn't rush back. so can't recommend this hotel enough and will definitely stay there again.

disappointing stayed here four 4 nights in mar 06. great location near sights but there is road noise and the walk to the main sights was a bit dodgy. i was disappointed with this hotel after staying at two much nicer holiday inns on my trip (heathrow and san francisco). the bell boy was annoyingly pushy, breakfast staff rude and the hotel in need of a bit of modernisation (leaky taps, noisy air-conditioning even when off, dated decor). also, the breakfast itself was not very good. it was the only place on our two week holiday that we tipped the minimum 15% and that was because it was automatically added to the bill. there were also groups of teenagers staying when we were there, who ran through the corridors and slammed doors noisily late at night. didn't have any of the perks of the san francisco hotel - no breakfast included, expensive water in the rooms (although it was available for half the price in the vending machines), no free internet access, local calls charged. small things and worth putting up with if you get a really cheap deal but it all added up to a feeling that staff looked on guests as more of a nuisance and money-grabbing opportunity than a customer. then came home to find i'd been charged for the rooms on my credit card despite having already paid through thomas cook. two weeks later i'm still waiting for the promised refund to show on my credit card. my compliments go to the reception staff and evening restaurant food and staff. however, overall, i would not recommend this hotel.

very average stayed here for two nights two weeks ago for $350. for my money was very average and a bit disappointing. for a start is not on walk of fame at all is about 10 min walk down poorly lit road - there is a very busy intersection at which the lights didnt work sometimes as well. as a solo female traveller i felt a bit vulnerable. also very easy to accidentally end up paying $12 for pay per view and even when you want to watch it you cant pause or rewind. kettle non existent instead some form of filter machine that didnt work at all and made a mess everywhere - also restaurant didnt work 24 hours so couldnt get snack when was v hungry to combat my jet lag. staff friendly enough but reception staff seemed to be serving about 3 people at once so you never knew where you were at with what you wanted done. bonus though was phone for international calls that cost 10 cents per minute to uk however you can get phone cards that work out even cheaper than this from many stores.

fantastic location, great room my daughter and i stayed for two nights at this hotel in march. although i had read some bad reviews, i have to say that we were delighted with our room. it was on an upper floor and we were at the back section of the hotel, away from the road. our room was peaceful and roomy, and overlooked the pool area. it was cleaned and made up promptly each day and well supplied with toiletries etc. the location was so convenient; only a five minute walk to hollywood boulevard. the concierge was most welcoming and very helpful. the desk staff when we checked in were friendly, but one of the girls who was on the front desk on our last day was a bit offhand with us. still, on the whole, a great hotel and i am glad we found it.

enjoyable stay the hotel was in a great location, with hollywood boulevard an easy walk away.the hotel is easy to find from the 101, just down the road from the hollywood bowl.the rooms are clean and comfortable. i would recommend the hotel for anyone wanting to stay in la. i wouldn't stay here again, and certainly not with a car. it was a nightmare to get back into the hotel unless you approach it from the right hand side. we found to our peril, after going to see a british band on the day we arrived. we came home as the hollywood bowl was kicking out, there were hundreds of people walking on the pavements and the police wouldn't let us drive the way we were familiar with. after a scary half an hour of driving around in unfamiliar territory, we finally found the hotel again, but were on the wrong side to enter the car park. we just took a chance and had to manouvre across 3 lanes of fast traffic and pavements full of people, with horns being blasted behind us! never again!this year we will visit la from santa barbara or long beach and then get the hell out of the city!

so so hotel we were in town for the academy awards. this hotel is a good location and within a couple blocks of the kodak theatre - but the area is a little questionable and i wouldn't walk in the area at night (homeless people sleeping at bus stops and wandering the area). the restaurant food has something to be desired - very little variety and seems like everything is microwaved and very overpriced. restaurant is only open from 6:30 am to 10:30 am and then again from 5 pm to 10 pm. room was ok - had some kind of odor and you heard traffic noice all night long. walls are not very soundproof and you can hear the people in the next room clear as a bell just like they were in your room. given the price, i would stay at the renaissance which is just down the street and not much more in price.
good touristic hotel this is a good touristic hotel in which you just sleep and visit places during the day.very helpful staff.

great value for money we stayed at this hotel for a week in total. the rooms were very clean and serviced everyday. it was a great location as you were only a 5 minute walk to the walk of fame. the staff were great and friendly and helpful. the only downside was the food. we preferred to eat out for breakfast as it just wasn't great. there was mel's diner just down the road, plus they also deliver free of charge and the food there was excellent. the rooms were spacious, clean and even had free wifi access. i would definately stay there again if i was going back to hollywood as it was good value for money.

good location, great value we stayed at the holiday inn in august for four nights. on arrival the only downside was the fact that there was a daily rate for parking. the room was clean and well serviced. the pool area was great and well maintained. we experienced problems with a pre-arranged tour which we did not organise through the tour desk, but the manager was more than happy to assist and went out of his way to help with the problem. supermarket just across the road which had everything we needed. very quick walk to hollywood bvd. will definitely be staying here again on my next trip.

good hotel - good location stayed for 2 nights in this hotel and thought the reception staff were fantastic. after our luggage was lost by the airline they offered us complimentary toiletries and directions to get to the shops to buy a change of clothes. hotel is very close to the walk of fame and the kodak theatre. a great japanese restaurant is 1 minute down the road. hotel rooms were very big and spotlessly cleaned. pool was great with a very hot jacuzzi. would stay here again if returning to hollywood.
good location i can only agree with keith from london, my problem was with the food and the restaurant, avoid it.i think that this hotel needs to have a good manager and than it will be even better.

loved the location, hated the service it was my husband and my first trip to southern california, and we were excited to enjoy all that hollywood has to offer. we've stayed in a few hotels in our lives, and trust holiday inn for quality and service. hollywood certainly didn't disappoint us, but our service at this hotel absolutely did. we made a reservation for two nights online through the official holiday inn website, but when we arrived (despite the fact that we had a confirmation number, a receipt from the site and various other documents) the receptionist insisted we were booked for only one night's stay. when we checked in we were informed of the glitch in the reservation system, and were assured that the next day everything would be worked out. the next morning, we spent more than an hour at the front desk as the receptionists (there were two for the morning shift) tried to tell us that we would have to change rooms but that there was a possibility that none were available. they had booked the room we were in for a party that night. for being just a glitch in the system it seemed to put quite a damper on our stay in the hotel. no effort was made by the hotel or hotel staff to accomodate us,and we left the hotel extremely disappointed by the courtesy of the staff and the attitudes of those responsible for customer relations. one of the receptionists couldn't even take the time to get off the phone with someone who was obviously not a client or employee of the hotel to devote her full attention to us and the matter at hand.after a frustrating hour of wasted time and rude comments from the receptionists (both of them) the seemingly minor problem was worked out and we were allowed to stay in the room we had booked. however, we received no consideration or apology from the front desk staff for the inconvenience and headache the glitch caused. we have lost our faith in the holiday inn reputation, and will never again book a room in a holiday inn hotel.the best thing about this hotel is its location. but you're looking for service as well, we suggest you look elsewhere. for the price, excellent service should have been included.

fantastic location having read other reviews of this hotel, my family and i, (six adults and two young children), decided to book it for the apparent value and location, even though it had been suggested that there was a 'fair walk' to the attractions. nonsense!having flown direct to la from the uk, rented two cars and driven to the hotel, (we had no idea where we were going), we were tired, hungry and ready for a quick bite and bed. as such, when we were warmly greeted by reception staff and immediately provided with three rooms, (as requested, adjacent to each other), with no fuss, or delay, we were delighted.our rooms were spacious, spotlessly clean and equipped with comfortable beds, tea/coffee making facilities, cooling/heating systems which worked very well, good lighting and bathrooms that were, again, spotless and had full-sized baths with powerful showers above. towels are small, (more like flannels, even for bathing purposes), but these were changed daily and the standard of the maid service was beyond reproach.as for the walk to 'the attractions', we were half expecting to be mugged every time we trecked to town, but to our pleasant surprise, not once were we approached on highland avenue. in fact (and believe you me, i believe in calling a spade a shovel!), the four/five minute walk to hollywood sunset was along a major road, which was extremely well lit and in fact, just past the church used for filming the two 'sister act' movies and the rennaisance hotel, one of the most expensive in la, so the location couldn't have been that bad! there were never any signs of any untoward persons and on visiting starbucks at 05:30 on two separate mornings, (jetlag can play havoc on the body clock and coffee is a must!), again, warm greetings were provided and no strange folk were noted.as for the staff at the hotel, i must offer them all our thanks and a 5* rating. they were ever helpful, informative, attentive and willing and eager to do anything to assist, at any time of the day, or night, without forever holding ut their hands for dollars in tips). unlike hotel staff in a major league resort, (say, vegas, where we moved to afterwards and where you're just 'a customer reference number'), the holiday inn's staff treated guests like guests and could do nothing more for us from our viewpoint.the hotel's facilities were exellent for the money; there's a heated outdoor pool and jacuzzi, high-speed internet access, (expensive, but fast) and as stated, the location was unsurpassed. parking is $17 per day with unlimited in-out privelages and 24hr desk and valet staff to attend to one's needs. safety deposit boxes are free, the usual ice and vending machines are located on each floor and whilst the restaurant doesn't open before 06:30, (see my early morning need for coffee as above), they were as terrific. all in all, we found there to be no failings with this holiday inn and our stay afforded us superb value and an unrivalled location, just minutes from the i101 n s, (which is fantastic for disney, lax, or universal studios.i guess the question that should be best asked to judge our true opinion of the hotel is whether we would stay there again in the future? if the truth be known and money wasn't an issue, sure we'd stay at the rennaisance eighty yards down the road. however, for the same money, we wouldn't stay anywhere else but the holiday inn!

mediocre stay my daughter and i were booked into this hotel after reading reviews. what a mistake.it was a lot further from the sights than we thought and in not a very nice area at all.you have to walk along a main road to get to any attractions,it was very scary.the hotel itself seemed nice when you first walk in and check in was fine,but noone helped us with our bags,we had to lug them to the fifth floor by ourselves.the elevators were very slow but worked fine.upon reaching our room it seemed ok if dated,but closer inspection revealed what looked like a bloodstain on the carpet,we had to leave our shoes on until we were in bed.there was a huge cockroach in the bathroom,my daughter refused to go in there and went down to the lobby to use the toilet there.when my son rang from australia late at night the man on reception hung up on him.we were booked for three nights but after some quick shopping we checked out after just one.the receptionist got hostile when i said we were leaving early,but got friendlier when i said we didnt want our money back and arranged for a shuttle to the airport for us.i would not reccomend this hotel to anyone and would not stay there again if i ever visited this country again,which is very unlikely.

nice place to stay stayed here in mid november for a couple of nights on the way back from hawaii. we were happy with this accommodation and enjoyed our stay here.we travelled on the airport shuttle bus from lax international airport which did take some time but isnéˆ¥??› a bad service. it cost us 15 dollars one way.check in staff were nice enough. we had a room on the 7th floor which gave us a view of the pool. the room was not a bad size, bathroom was slightly small but both were clean and well kept. the restaurant was a bit overpriced but the food isnéˆ¥??› bad. however there are cheaper places to eat within easy walking distance. there is a nice place to get doughnuts and breakfast just a couple of blocks to the right on the opposite side of the street. the hotel does have a complementary bus to universal but there are only about 9 seats. it was booked up till 11:15 which is too late to arrive at universal if you want to enjoy everything there. we caught a cab which cost 13 dollars. you can use the metro system too.the walk of fame is about a 5-7 minute walk away and there is always lots going on there. i recommend meléˆ¥??? diner, it just like stepping back in to the fifties. just be sensible and aware of everything around if you are walking back to the hotel very late at night. nice place to stay but for us weéˆ¥??‡ only stay in the area a few nights and move on if we went back.

enjoyed our stay! we spent three nights at holiday inn hollywood - walk of fame. our room was spacious and very clean. we were extremely happy with our stay. the room was nothing fancy, but we were very comfortable there. the walk was short to attractions and the service was wonderful at the hotel. we would recommend to anyone!

wonderful staff would recommend this hotel to anyone. the staff were so helpful nothing was a problem. we arrived from australia at 10 in the morning and thought we would have to wait a few hours before we could settle in but they had us in our room in 20 mins. only a 5 minute walk to the chinese mann theatre. food in the restaurant was great. so if you are looking for a hotel keep this one in mind.

liked the hiw-wof based on a reviews at trip advisor, a friend and i travelled to la and stayed at the hih-wof. we're in our 30s and in decent shape (he is anyway) and can walk at a fair clip. we shared a room facing the back of the hotel, overlooking the pool. it was a little cool and there was a lot of rain during our few days (remember seeing houses sliding off hills on the news?) but in february that's what you get.the room we were in had two double beds and although it didn't appear to be as new as the lobby, the room was clean and quiet and there was enough room for us to move around. clean and safe were major for us. tv, pool, etc. weren't high priorities. the staff were good too.breakfast was cheaper at mel's down the street than at the hotel.we walked, took the subway and rented a car. we walked a lot- we walked from the market near cbs studios back to the hotel (2h+). the walk from the hotel to the kodak theatre took about 10 minutes and the nearby renaissance hollywood hotel had a car rental place (can't remember the name) where we picked up a car (too chilly for convertible) to go to santa monica and disneyland (we dropped off at lax a couple days later - no drop off fee from what i remember).there were a lot of people around and hollywood was safer than i thought it would be. that said, two guys walking together may prevent some situations.the hotel is near, by car, the wb and universal studios. i can't remember if we paid for a shuttle from the hotel or they provided free. both worth checking out if you're into tv and/or movies. saw wisteria lane and gilmore girls and er locations.took the subway saturday morning to take a tour of downtown. my friend appreciates architecture. we don't have a subway at home so i recommend it for others who don't. it was safe, fast and cheap. we took it back to the hotel from oliveri(?) street late one night and it was still ok. note: we took cabs but they cost a lot to me (seemed like us$30+ per ride) because the city is so huge and we wanted to get to every corner.the walking tour of downtown la was done by red line tours ----- bradbury building304 s. broadway. i think we took the historic downtown los angeles tour. contact them the day before to let them know you're coming for sure. the guide was very informative and the headsets worked really well on the busy streets. we had great weather for this saturday morning tour.

parking hassle we stayed at the holiday inn in hollywood,ca. at 10:30 pm we went out to our car to get some luggage. the parking attendant wanted us to move our car to a space that was too small because he wanted our space for an suvand a tip from that driver. we moved our car to the tiny space to be nice but our car got scratch. it ruined our night.the next morning we went to the front desk and complained. we filled out an incident report but we do not think we will be compensated for the scratch. i did make a point of asking the front desk to refund the parking which was $17. they refunded it immediately.otherwise hotel was clean, and quiet. staff was very polite and courteous the airconditioning was nice but hard to sleep because it was a little loud.

geat location for hollywood walk of fame we stayed at the hotel for six nights in august, as part of a family holiday to la from the uk.biggest plus for the hotel is it's location if you want to be close to the centre of hollywood boulevard, a five minute walk downhill brings you to hollywood and highland, kodak theatre, etc. or walk the other way, and the road takes you straight to hollywood bowl. but the walk up from hollywood boulevard is uphill, and could be quite tiring in the heat of the day, (for those of us who aren't as fit as we could be!). this is a main road and always very busy. we didn't feel theatened walking into town day or evening. the area is also used as overflow carparking for the hollywood bowl, so most evenings there are hoards of people making there way up hill to the concerts. once dark, the road was well lit by floodlights on a nearby building, and we felt perfectly at ease, although late at night this may be different. once you've done all the touristy things in hollywood boulevard, the rest is a bit rundown and trashy. you'll probably want to explore further afield. a few more family-friendly restaurants would have been useful. staff at reception were all very helpful, and the concierge had discounted day tickets to universal studies. the hotel runs a shuttle there three times daily, but we found the times very limiting, (last one out 11:30am, last one back 6:30pm) and seats had to be booked well in advance (2 days for a family of 4). we opted to drive ourselves. parking at universal is very straightforward, and i think costs $10. the reception and dining room areas are bright and well decorated, but some modernisation, with brighter paint and different carpet in the corridors would work wonders. rooms are clean, spacious, and very well sound proofed. decor again is uninspired, but perfectly ok. only let down was the beds; extremely firm, and took some getting used to!our rooms overlooked the main road at the front of the hotel. this is extremely busy throughout the day, and so there was considerable traffic noise until well into the evening. but we did get a great view over the hollywood rooftops, and also up to the hills. (not the hollywood sign, but this is right in front of you as you walk up from hollywood boulevard). the hotel provide a buffet breakfast, full american (hot) or continental, which are good value, and very convenient. otherwise it's a short drive or walk if you fancy something different - mel's diner off hollywood boulevard is good. for snacks, there's a subway in the plaza just across the way, and several other fast-food outlets within a few minutes walk. the hotel also has a small bar area if you feel like a drink or coffee in the evening. the hotel has a medium sized pool at the back, with a hot-tub, sunbeds, tables and chairs. we found that to use the pool we had to plan our day to be by the pool in the morning, as it's in shade from mid-afternoon. this may not fit in the la weather - whilst we were there it was overcast most morning, with the sun breaking through around midday. hot all afternoon, then cooled off more than we expected in the evening. good idea to bring a sweater.parking space at the hotel is at a premium - there is stack parking, where you hand over your keys to the valet and they do the rest, but it worked fine. we thought the hotel offered good value for money for such a prime location in central hollywood. if we were heading back to this part of hollywood, we'd probably stay there again.

not bad we came to hollywood from london for 7 nights and didn't go anywhere else, we purely came for the walk of fame and this hotel couldn't have been better for that.it was a spit from the boulavard and the kodak theatre. you could walk to sunset strip, graumans, and rodeo drive and beverley hills was a bus ride away.the hotel was a little dated inside but the rooms were biggish and had everything expected. the reception people were really helpful and kind. on the last night some rowdy teenagers moved in next door and the receptionist phoned their room and threatened them with paying our bill if we were not happy! that soon shut them up!i found the area slightly intimadating after dark but had my 6 tall b'friend with me so had no problems at all. there are quite a few wacky looking people and homeless around who give the wrong impression. we went for a long bus ride during the day and had absolutley no problems at all.the hotel restaurant was ok, nothing too exciting but not too expensive either, so hey?the tours advertised in the hotel seem pretty organised, we did a couple. the star's homes tour is best right outside graumans - starline tours. we went twice and both times the different drivers showed us different homes. watch out for a celeb star being put down too. we saw keanu reeves doing his and you can get up really close, much closer than celebs in the u.k.universal studios is cool and the hotel run a shuttle. we picked up gold passes at the gate for half the price of pre-booked gold passes and you get a guide, queue hopping and an extended back lot tour. well worth the money (about $99 pp if you get a spot on the day or $199 if you pre-book!)overall, the hotel was fine. you must try the hot tub - looks out over the road and down onto the boulavard. kinda wierd for us from blighty!

fine rooms were a good size if a little dated, you are very close to hollywood boulevard and all it's tourist attractions like the kodak theatre and graumans chinese theatre. the only thing i was not so sure about was walking back to the hotel at night, it's a very short walk from hollywood and highland but can seem a little daunting because of a couple of shady characters. nothing to worry about if you have a car which we used most of the time.

holiday inn - hollywood walk of fame the room was large and spacious, think it had been designed to accomodate guests with disabilities. however beyong the reception the hotel is quite dated looking.for what we wanted (a bed to sleep at night) it was reasonable although it was not as good as the other 3 star hotels we stayed in on the same trip. we did eat in the hotel one night although this was not very good as they did not have one of the items on the menu and we generally felt a bit rushed and did not get very good value in comparison to places outside the hotel.the location is ideal for the walk of fame and the red line metro to universal. however we found longer journeys (santa monica and long beach) took at least 90 minutes each way using public transport. this is obvioulsy not a criticism of the hotel but reflects the huge size of la. perhaps next time i would base myself in a couple of places, maybe staying in santa monica for a couple of days and hollywood for a couple in order to reduce daily travel

fabulous hotel-would definately stay again we stayed at this hotel from 7th may to the 16th. great location, short walk to the walk of fame, close to metro and bus stops. a starbucks, subway and small grocer are across the road which was great for late night dinners. the rooms were large and very clean. everyone was very helpful, we had pre-booked tours before we left australia which were cancelled. the concierge was great and assisted us with booking other tours. after reading other reviews, was a bit cautious about leaving the hotel at night, but as two females we felt quite safe, walking around at night. would definately stay here again.!!

nice clean friendly hotel i stayed at this hotel with my friend for a week from 12th to 19th april 05. we had no problems at all. the staff were all very friendly and helpful, the rooms were really big and were cleaned every day. i can't understand why negative reviews have been written !. the pool / spa area was always being cleaned by staff and clean towels are left for you on the sun loungers and a maid comes round doing regular spot checks. we had breakfast in the restaurant a few times and also ordered room service in the evening, the food was great and piping hot even though it had come up 6 floors !the concierge were falling over themselves to help you with tours, taxis etc. they gave us advice on what we should expect to pay in taxis and info on tours etc. they have a hotel bus and they were happy to drop us off on sunset strip rather than us pay for a taxi which i thought was nice of them.the location is great, a 5 min walk to the walk of fame, kodak theatre, manns, etc. i agree with the previous advisor comments regarding the stretch of road from the hotel to walk of fame, we did feel a bit vulnerable at times as we saw a couple of dodgy characters walking along this road but i think they were probably harmless, i think we were a bit paranoid after reading other reviews ! i wouldn't advise to walk this stretch alone in the evening, in the daytime it was fine but we got taxis at night to be on the safe side.this was a really enjoyable holiday and i would definately stay here again. we booked out hotel through trailfinders for a cheap price and we definately got value for money so don't take others negative comments to heart !

not as bad as i thought!!! after reading some reviews on this hotel was a bit worried we visited on 13 to 17.4.05.rooms were large however hotel had a paper thin walls so could here in next room lifts were working reception and all staff extremely helpful location was close to the metro and walk of fame however there is about a 5 min walk from these along a stretch of road that i felt was dodgy in the evening. not sure whether it was just me being paranoid however if i had been on my own i would have not walked along it. overall the hotel was clean and reasonable for the amount we paid however the location made me feel unsafe.

nothing great about this hotel... i was paraniod about the lifts not working and werid smells in the hotel after reading the other reviews on this website, but thankfully both lifts were functioning during my 4 night stay at the hotel from 19 - 22 march 2005, and i was given a decent room on one of the higher floors. but in general, this hotel sucks and is not worth the full price that i paid for it. the bellhops were manipulative and rude, frontdesk staff were unfriendly and it's not really as conveniently located as i had imagined. true, it is a 5-8 minute walk to the walk of fame, mann's chinese theatre and other attractions, but nobody ever mentioned the unsightly and dingy path along the highway that you have to walk past to get to the 'nice bits'. and yes, they do provide free shuttle service to and from universal studios, but so do most of the other hotels around that area. i wouldn't stay at this hotel again... when i checked out of the hotel, they overcharged me for my room rate, and weren't apologetic about their mistake! for us$129 per night, breakfast is not provided and you have to put up with annoying bellhops that loiter around the front entrance waiting to make a quick buck.

great hotel - great location why all the negative reviews? i got this hotel from priceline for a recent trip to la, and it was great! the staff was friendly and accomodating. the room was a good size and clean. my only complaint - the parking is valet only and is not included in the price of the room, even when booked on priceline. the hotel's manager (who was working at the front desk when we checked out - i was impressed!) mentioned that the hotel will be undergoing a major renovation soon, so it will be even nicer in the future!if you are a priority club member, you even get a few perks here (free drink ticket for the bar, bathrobes, discounted parking)overall, a great experience. this was the cheapest place we stayed (of three different hotels in la), and definitely the best deal for the money.

average hotel in good location spent last friday here for $60 through priceline. not the greatest hotel, but not the worst, and pretty good for the price/location. the lobby was small and the hotel felt a little worn but passable. the room was clean, and despite the fact it was right next to the elevators, was not noisy (unless you were in the bathroom strangely enough). walking distance to the metro. my wife and i walked back from hollywood/highlands around 1am and did not feel unsafe. certainly felt a lot safer than we would have doing the same downtown. anyways, if you're just looking for a bed to sleep in and the price is right, this hotel does the trick.

don't get near the lift well after booking months in advance we got stuck with the room located directly behind the lift. the lift was like a jack hammer going off each time it went up. we got moved the next day to an end room, otherwise this hotel was a good hotel with a great location to the walk of fame, metro and the hollywood bowl.

really not that bad and the location is amazing! i was quite nervous about staying here after reading all the negative reviews. since i ended up getting this hotel as a result of a priceline bid, i could not cancel it.my girlfriend and i stayed here from november 14 - 19. we arrived fairly late at night, so check-in was a breeze. no problems at all. i had called in advance to request a non-smoking room with a king bed, and upon check-in found they had me in a room with a non-smoking double-bed. they quickly changed it no problems asked.one word of caution - if you are cabbing from the hotel be ready for about a $50 usd cab ride. it's not $35 as the hotel web site says!!the front desk staff and consierge are all very helpful. we had missed a tour we booked and the consierge did everything he could so that we could catch up with the tour. also, katherine at the front desk was a big help answering any questions we had.i likely would only have given this hotel two stars, but for the price i paid ($64 usd) i felt i got a good deal relative to what i paid. if i had paid full price my feelings would likely be different.the location is the best thing going for this hotel. we wanted to minimize the days we needed a rental car for (especially given the outrageous parking fee charged by this hotel) and the location was key to us being able to acheive that.our room was secure and standard - felt a bit rundown and old, but we didn't mind since the only time we were in our room was to sleep. the free shuttle to universal studios was a huge bonus, although the driver must have left early so we missed the last pickup of the night --8:30 (which we had pre-booked for). i called the hotel and they came and got us. the consierge was a bit pissed off, but whatever!as other reviewers have noted, only 1 elevator is working and it is possibly the slowest elevator in the world! it got very annoying, but we were on vacation so we weren't in too much of a rush anyhow. also, the stairs lead right outside to the back parking lot so stairs weren't really an option a lot of the time.the only other real negative aspect of this hotel was the pool area. the hot tub was very nasty, had all sorts of gross things floating in it and was in need of a good cleaning. there are also tonnes of biting ants around the hot tub area so be careful. i would avoid this area all together.two other notes on the hollywood area:1. by our third night, we felt comfortable walking around at night right in front of the chinese theatre and the kodak theatre, etc. we ventured a bit away from these places at night and it got a bit seedy. we only went a couple blocks in either direction before feeling unsafe. we felt very safe in the hotel and directly outside it.2. be careful if you are relying on cabs a great deal. they can easily tell if you are a tourist and will rip you off by taking a longer route. also, one day we waited 45 minutes for a cab and it still didn't show up. leave lots of time if using this as your main method of travel. all in all my girlfriend and i had a fantastic time in the hollywood area and would definately go there again. we might try to get a different hotel, but again for the price i won't complain.

crap hotel this is thre worst 3 star hotel i have ever stayed in.it had a very noisy lift that sounded like thunder travelling through the whole hotel, no room was excempt from the noise. we were continually told by the management that it would be fixed tomorow, however tomorow never came. the easy chair in our room was more suited for the dump as the arms well worn and greasy and looked dirty.this was such a pity as the hotel was in an excellent location. never the less the staff were very helpful and understanding

good hotel - excellent location this is your standard holiday inn hotel. nothing fancy, nothing to complain about. rooms are a decent size. there is a pool and hot tub available. i was there early nov and the elevators were (still!) not working fully.breakfast at the hotel is fine. the best part is the location for the hollywood attractions. leave the hotel and turn left and within a couple of hundred meters you have the hollywood bowl (look up for hollywood sign). turn right and within 5 mins walk you have the walk of fame, kodak theatre and grauman's chinese theatre.

close to everything hollywood stayed in mid october, place was clean and tidy. 1 lift was being fixed so you would have to wait a few minutes but who cares you are on holidays just relax. this place is so close to hollywood bolavard it takes no more tha 5 minutes to walk there and see all the sights. the free shuttle to universal studios is fantastic an again only takes a few minutes. they even pick you up to come back to the hotel. staff were ok had no problems really. make sure if you go to take a day out to go to universal studios its great. would stay again if in hollywood

expect problems unless you book directly w/holiday inn we had gone through priceline to book the room. when the desk clerk asked what type of room we wanted i requested a non-smoking double room. she then rudely told me she could only offer us a smoking king room. when i asked her why since i had called reservations and was told there were 9 standard double rooms available for the entire week she asked how we booked the room and i told her through priceline. she then stated they hate priceline and don't want to use it but keep getting overridden. after a 10 min discussion and questioning the holiday inn hospitality guarantee we were given a smoking double room. only one of the two elevators worked and there was sometimes up to a 15 minute wait since the housekeeping and maintenace staff also used the same elevator. the stairs access is located outside behind the parking lot attendants stand - no lobby access. the room itself was clean and the housekeeping staff were friendly and helpful. overnight parking is $14/day or $10/day if you are a priority club member (which we were). however, we wouldn't have known that if the parking lot attendant hadn't told us - the info was not volunteered by the desk clerk.all in all - unless you book directly through holiday inn don't expect the same type of hospitality you would otherwise.

not the worst hotel i've stayed in we had booked three non smoking rooms at this hotel. when we checked in late on our first night there, we were told that we had been given the last three rooms available as all the other rooms were fully booked.my wife, daughter and i were given a room in the smoking level of the hotel which was very run down and reeked of foul smelling tobacco smoke including the beds and bedding. we used the room that night due to the fact we were exhausted and didn't feel like an argument with the hotel staff, but the following morning i asked to be moved to a non smoking room and was pleasantly surprised when the man on duty in reception said he would organise it for me, and, would organise for our luggage to be moved for us when we returned to the hotel after 1:00pm, as we were going out sightseeing.on our return we were given a key to our new room which was 400% better than our previous room, though we did have to move our luggage ourselves.apart from that, we found the staff friendly and helpful, and honest, (my wife lost a purse with over $100.00 in it). one of the ladies who worked in reception found it and kept it in safe keeping and returned it to us when we enquired if someone had handed it in not expecting to see it again.the hotel is very close to universal studios and offers a free shuttle bus to and from there. and is a short walk from hollywood boulevard.in general we found the hotel pretty reasonable though it could probably do with a revamp of the decor.

don't bother give it a miss, a reflection of hollywood itself, felt unsafe and unclean. by far the worst hotel i've experienced in the us, the door didn't even lock (only found out as we left, fortunately only stayed one night). if you have to visit hollywood, park your car, see the chinese theatre handprints and then get right on out of there!

hooray for hollywood this was an ok hotel - we had a great view of the hollywood sign, and it's situated just a block away from the kodak theatre!free shuttle to universal studios was a great bonus!all in all a good stay, for a good rate!

response to writer from brighton we stayed at holiday inn,hollywood in july for 7 nights and was sorry to leave. we found the staff really friendly,the rooms basic but very clean the location couldn't have been better. we would definitely recommend it.

try somewhere else we stayed at the holiday inn for 2 nights at the end of july 2004. the location was good, close to sights and bus routes. staff were polite. we had breakfast at the hotel and it was fine. however the room was looking tired and the a/c was very noisy. the carpets and decoration in the corridors were grubby and certainly needed replacing. the one lift which worked was very slow, noisy and extremely smelly. there is a pool but we didn't use it. if i was staying in hollywood again i would look for another hotel. (the renaissance looked good and the lobby area of the roosevelt was impressive.)

worst hotel i have ever stayed in! oh dear oh dear oh dear. i wouldn't want to stay in this dump of a hotel again if you paid me. i've been to plenty of hotels in plenty of places, and this one has the dubious honour of being easily the worst place i have ever stayed in.we booked it as usually, holiday inns are good, and this one was right by hollywood boulevard. with one exception, the staff were all downright rude and miserable, and made you feel like you were wrong for daring to bother them. the concierge guy was forever trying to sell you trips instead of giving you help. the food for the breakfast buffet was stale and horrible. and best of all, on two occasions, when we asked to change up a traveller's cheque, one of the most basic services of any hotel, they could not, as they said they didn't have any cash with them! they told us to try again later, and we got the same answer then!the lifts were extremely slow and made this horrendous vibrating, grinding noise that made us feel like the thing was going to break down at any time. on one morning, we were awoken by a workman drilling in the room directly above us.......at 7:30am! it took two angry calls to reception to get it to stop.i wouldn't recommend this hotel to my worst enemy - avoid at all costs!

pleasantly surprised on my first trip to la i felt totally at home in the city and at the hotel. the staff treated me as a familiar friend and went out of their way to help me and make my stay incredible. the hotel was clean and had nice ammenities. the location is also perfect considering that i didn't have a car. all the major bus routes and the metro are just a block away at hollywood blvd. and from there i could get just about everywhere. the neighbourhood is safe and there are always people (or cars!) around. it's a fun area with the hollywood/highland complex just down the street. i would definitely recommend this hotel to a friend.

living in hollywood with an affordable cost it is my first time to write a review for a hotel accomodation. we have been searching for a hotel accomodation in la for almost a month. most of them is either too expensive or too far from any attractions. orchid suites is located just behind kodak theatre and several minutes walking distance from metro in hollywood highland. i can plan to have a couple of days without renting a car (visiting hollywood areas and universal studios).the room condition is clean but the furnitures are old (don't expect it is a luxry hotel). i am satisfied with it because it comes with fully-equipped kitchen (with microwave and oven). however, i found that the kitchen is a bit smelly but you can close the kitchen door to prevent the smell goes into the room.in la, you cannot go further without a car. we rented a car for a longer distance travelled and the hotel provides free underground parking which is another advantage over some other hotel in hollywood.other merit points including free in-room wifi access, in-room safe and washing machine. for the room rate at around $110 plus tax, i need not ask for more during my stay in the hotel.finally, one tip for other travellers is to bring your own shower gel as they only provide soap.

very disappointing we stayed here for four days from thanksgiving. we selected it based on the reviews on this site but were very disappointed. the price is ok but the rooms were not what we thought we were getting. we had booked a suite as we were travelling with our two teenage sons. the suite is actually only one bedroom with the second bed in the lounge/kitchen area. we asked for a rollaway bed (as the boys are unwilling to share a bed) and were assured that it wouldn't be too cramped. we found that it was very cramped. the kitchen was very small and did not have a dishwasher and there were no tea towels to dry things. the oven seals kept falling off the moment the oven was heated and the oven door did not fully close. there were no dishes in which you could put leftover food.we were given one room but the moment we walked in we could smell urine so asked to be moved to another room, which the staff did. the carpet on the floor was dirty (as mentioned in another review). staff did not come in to clean the rooms until around 5pm which meant that we had already arrived back from being out all day and were getting ready for the night's activities. getting luggage to the room was difficult. one alternative is to carry them up to the third floor or use the lift. the lift is only accessible from the road via the garage. the garage is locked and had to be opened for us and the lift is extremely small so only 1 large suitcase (we had 4 in total and carry ons as we had been travelling round the world for the previous 6 weeks) would fit in, meaning a number of trips had to be taken to bring all of the luggage up.the staff were courteous and the location is good.

great location and service husband and i (mid 30s) stayed here for 2 nights sat dec 6 and sun dec 7 to be close to universal studios (1 metro stop away, though we didn't feel safe in the metro subway at 8.30am on a sunday morning - very quite and isolated and shady in-your-face characters try to get money from you for 'helping' you to use the automated ticket machines and 'kings of the metro' who harrass single and groups of women ... take a cab instead) and the warner bros studio tour (completely brilliant - just do it!). hotel staff were extremely helpful and accommodated our request for a quiet room away from the pool area. unfortunately on morning one, our shower didn't work properly and water just spurted everywhere all over the bathroom floor. the conceirge came up and said there was a knob missing. he gave us a key to shower in a room on the next floor up. this was inconvenient, but our shower was fixed by the time we returned from universal studios later that day. the room upstairs was much nicer and better updated than our room, and while he offered us an exchange of rooms, we prefer not to move once we've settled as we're already staying in 5 hotels during a 3 week stay. providing we can get some sleep, we can cope with any other little inconveniences. no breakfast was provided, but go to the fresh and easy supermarket a few blocks up the road for supplies to make your own breakfast / other meals (the frozen vegetarian selection is outstanding!) the best thing we did in hollywood was take the kodak theatre tour which is right next door. when you are standing on the front steps of the orchid suites, look up on your immediate right and see a long glass corridor with yellow paint underneath. that's where the oscar winners walk past the photos of previous winners after coming off stage to do their press interviews. this tour was the entertainment highlight of our whole 3 week trip to the us (especially walking out onto the stage itself, then taking johnny depp's front row centre seat while learning more about the theatre and oscars ceremonies).this hotel is definitely not the ritz, but you coudn't get any closer grauman's chinese theatre (we missed the tour there but bought tickets to see a film inside), the sidewalk stars (not the dodgy fakes dressed up as stars who charge you to take their photos!) and the celebrity hand and footprints. the uwink restaurant in the hollywood and highlands centre is a bit of fun for a meal (except when 40 drunk male and female 'santas' arrive right after you've placed your order on the computer screen on your table and get even more drunk while you wait for your meal!) the orchid suites staff were happy to mind our luggage after check-out until our luxbus came to take us to anaheim. we can't imagine staying anywhere else during a short, low budget stay in hollywood.

great stay our family of 4 stayed for 7 nights in nov and found staff and rooms met our needs. location was greatm good to have kitchen which we used for breakfasts. no problems with noise. gennerally accessible to everthing we wanted to do.

wonderful location, wonderful staff! we stayed at the orchid suites for 4 nights in december 2008..the location is amazing! you can't get much closer to the centre of things, and for us this was perfect. you literally walk round the corner to the metro, restaurants, the chinese theatre, etc etc. the rooms are not the most modern, and probably a bit old-fashioned, but extremely clean. our room was fortunately at the back, as i think the front rooms can be noisy.the staff on reception are fantastic - friendly, helpful, and efficient as well. they got tickets for us, booked a transfer, told us the way to places . . . what more do you want?
travelers rest this apartment style is extremly good value helpful staff good rooms and fresh air this unit very clean and tidy great location with train on backdoorstepbarney cahillnew zealand

great location if you want to see hollywood we stayed three nights at hollywood orchid suites. the location is great: one block off hollywood blvd and right behind the mann chinese theater. so if you are into the walk of fame and the mann celebrity imprints, its for you. when we went to universal we took the metro where there is also a station also right around the corner. (by the way, universal is nothing special). you can also get the metro from/to airport. people at the front desk were very nice. they put us in room 201 the first night and even though the hotel is on a dead end street, the room is right over the garage and you could here the entry gate go up and down for every car that came/left. and the room is right in the elevator corridor so you can hear every conversation going in and out of the elevator. adam (i think was his name) at the front desk was very gracious and changed our room to one in the back.

clean and private me and a girl friend stayed at the hollywood orchid suites for 3 nights, december 1- december 4. booked the stay based on the reviews on trip advisor. we wanted somewhere that was close to the main tourist-style attractions, and with easy access to universal studios. our room was a king executive suite, which had it's own bathroom, kitchen and dining area. the most important thing was that the room was clean. the sheets and towels were fresh. our room was not facing the pool, or on the balcony, but around the corner, facing a car park behind the hotel. this felt far more private, as no one would be walking past us to access their rooms. the safe was a helpful addition to the room, but quite small, which was a downside as we were traveling with a laptop computer. the hotel is located conveniently just behind hollywood boulevard and the kodak theatre. tucked away in a private street along with other hotels like the liberty and hollywood celebrity, it is just on the end right behind the hollywood and highland shopping mall. there was easy and convenient access to the centre at a 1 minute walk. the mall backed right on to hollywood boulevard and the walk of fame. the mall was useful for places to eat, but we found it tiresome and limited in terms of options. we could not find anywhere that served breakfast, which was very disappointing. we often skipped breakfast altogether because of this. universal studios was easily accessed through the metro station which is underneath the mall, and people looking to visit the main tourist attractions will be pleased with the location. it's also close the the hollywood museum, and the hollywood wax museum. the one problem we found with this hotel was that the day we arrived, there were some major construction works going on next door, on the mall. massive drilling noises were very intrusive and trying to sleep after a long international flight was near impossible. we weren't warned about this in advance, or when we checked in. the construction was still in process when we checked out. this didn't go on during the evening or early morning, but if you wish to sleep in or have a sleep during the day, you might find it annoying. overall, though, we found our stay a pleasant experience with no problems. the staff were helpful, by arranging us a cab and letting us know where the major attractions were, and how to access them. highly recommended if you are on a budget and need somewhere to stay in the heart of hollywood.

great value great location this place is a bit worn around the edges, but has great amenities and the value cannot be beat! we paid $119 for a one bedroom suite with a kitchen...the oven didn't work, but everything else did. free parking, walk 30 seconds to the hollywood/highlands center and about 5 minutes walk to several family friendly options on hollywood blvd which is less scary than it's been in years.if you decide to leave the car in the garage, you can take the metro to downtown, and other locations.my only small complaint was that the pool wasn't heated, but it was november...so maybe it's only heated seasonally. that didn't keep my daugther from swimming!it's not the ritz, but a very family friendly affordable accomodation.
nice hotel and great location outside of hotel

great location, excellent staff just got back from a trip to la that included 3 nights at the orchid suites. i couldn't be happier with the room, rate, location and staff. everything in the room - one br plus kitchen and living room - was clean and comfortable and the location can't be beat. i highly recommend this hotel to anyone travelling on business as well as families looking for a convenient base while seeing the sights of hollywood and west la.

great location, but......... we picked this hotel due to it's proximity to hollywood blvd. however, after our first night there, we realised there wasn't much going on and we would have been better staying in west hollywood, downtown la or santa monica.the hotel itself is perfect for people on a budget and the rooms are clean and tidy.having the hollywood highland centre a minute's walk away is perfect for dining, shopping, etc. also, the club at the top is pretty cool.metro line is 3 minutes walk. easy to use as well.

a gem in hollywood we stayed here with our 3 children ages 10-16 and the location and price cannot be beaten. the rooms are not the most up-to-date but our room was quiet, the staff were extremely helpful and courteous and the free parking a bonus. if you are looking for great value in a great location this is the place. if you want 5 stars you may be disappointed but if, like us, you need a place to stop after a busy day this is great value for money and my husband is already planning his trip back.
decent, clean and good location junior room- 2 beds
great location great location for hollywood boulevard and shopping. universal studios a short drive away. large, clean rooms.helpful reception.perfect location for exploring hollywood. free car park.

great price for the location! we stayed here recently after reviewing all the reviews of this hotel posted here on tripadvisor. we were not disappointed. the room was large, clean, had free coffee, mini fridge. the hotel also had free internet access on their computer located on the second floor. laundry facilities are also available at this hotel and we also liked the fact that the hotel had a security system in place and the parking garage was locked and only hotel patrons had access to it and the parking was free. it is literally two minute walk from the chinese theatre and walk of fame. in fact i am considering going there again to take my elderly mother there as she will be able to get around and not have to walk far. it is in a superb location. also we found the staff to be very friendly. the hotel is smaller and has a very cozy warm feeling. we plan to stay there again on our next trip to la!

perfect for hollywood excellent location, just a couple of minutes walk from hollywood boulevard and within easy reach of other great attractions. short drive to universal studios.accommodation was very good. we didn't cater for ourselves as good restaurants and coffee shops close by. but the facilities were good enough had we have wanted to.

great base to explore hollywood and beyond this hotel is ideally located just a short walk from hollywood boulevard and places of interest such as the kodak theatre, hollywood roosevelt hotel, and hollywood walk of fame. you can catch a tour bus from the kodak theatre which takes you along rodeo drive, sunset boulevard, through beverley hills and up to universal studios. the hotel staff are friendly, we purchased tickets to universal studios through the hotel and got money off. the rooms are clean and well maintained.

good location, older hotel the hollywood orchid suites has a perfect location behind the walk of fame in hollywood, near a lot of restaurants. the room was very old but had a living room a equipped kitchen, a bedroom and a small bathroom. we used our room only to sleep, but the hotel has a swimming pool (we donéˆ¥??› used it) and a free pc which you can use for free and even a free printer you could print your flight schedule on it.we donéˆ¥??› liked la very much so we only slept here 1 night. i think the price was too high for what you get! at the end of the street you have more budget hotels like motel 6, rodeway inn and dayéˆ¥??? inn, i would definitely choose that hotels the next time because we donéˆ¥??› used anything but our beds!

great base for la we stayed at the hollywood orchid suites with another couple. shared a 1br suite with 2 king beds. one bed was in separate bedroom and another in the lounge. all in all very very comfortable. rooms are basic and decor is dated, however it was spotlessly clean and the amenity of the kitchen was handy. free internet also a plus, as many places in the usa seem to charge a great deal for internet usage. there was also free parking. the location is handy, right behind the hollywood highland mall. there's a pool, although we didnt use it. la is a city you really need a car to get around as it's vast and there's no centre to speak of. overall, and particularly for the price, i thought this was an excellent hotel.

great place great place.great location.courteous staff.exellent value for money!me and my wife stayd there for two weeks in executive suite and liked it a lot.it was great to have full kitchen to use.dont have to eat out all the time.we have only good things to say about it and recommend it to everybody that likes good clean reasonable priced room.

perfect position as all the reviews state, this hotel is in a perfect position to be able to walk to the main strip.the fact that it had a kitchen was perfect for the family as we were all sick of eating out after spending a week in disneyland. there was a big supermarket ( fresh and easy i think it was called) on the main drag where fresh meat, vegetables and fruit could be purchased.the room itself was quite spacious - it also had a safe which was handy. the pool was well maintained and perfect for a dip after a day out and about.they also provided free internet access on a computer located on the 2nd floor which was great for checking e-mails, getting directions, booking tours etc.the free parking was also a bonus, as was the laundry that was resonably priced.all the staff were pleasant and the service people did a great job cleaning the rooms every day.just a tip - do not get sucked into doing a tour of the homes of the stars. they are overpriced and you really don't see anything!!i would recommend this hotel to anyone.

homely well located hotel the hollywood orchid suites are very well located behind the hollywood and highland centre, just a few minutes walk to many of the sights of hollywwod, restaurants and shopping. there is free car parking underneath if you have a car. the reception staff were all very cheerful and helpful. despite it being so close to the action we didn't find the noise an issue.we had a one bedroom suite for our family of five. the queen bed with a rollaway in the bedroom was tight but adequate and we also had the king size bed in the living area. we found the kitchen and table handy for basic meal prepartion - (gets expensive to eat out all the time) there is a longs drugstore and fresh and easy market in hollywoord blvd to get all your basic needs. the room itself was clean but the furniture etc was quite dated but adequate. used the guest laundry - convenient for families.the kids swam in the pool which was refreshing after a hot summers day. this hotel is not plush 5 star luxury, but offers a clean comfortable stay in a great location at a good price. i would stay here again and recommend it to others.

good choice this hotel is just steps from hollywood boulevard, but amazingly quiet. my room overlooked an apartment block, which meant the view was not great, but there was no noise from the shopping centre.as previous reviews state, the place is a little tired, but that can so easily be overlooked with all the advantages.the place is beautifully clean with a pleasant pool and roof terrace.the rooms are very well equipped. there are two double beds, iron/board, hotplate, fridge, coffeemaker, cutlery/crockery, roomsafe, tv, clock/radio and hairdryer. there were always loads of coffee, sugar creamer. buying a few basic supplies made it very easy to prepare breakfast in the room there is a huge double mirrored wardrobe and very clean bathroom with bath shower.i had a small problem with the bath plug maintenace came to repair it within minutes of reporting it to reception.very slight negative were the very thin dividing walls meaning next door conversations could be overheard.the hotel is a few yards from the subway the hollywood highland shopping centre. also many tours leave from the front of grauman's chinese theatre, making very convenient.this is a well located, reasonably priced hotel i would recommend it for a visit to hollywood

great staff, great location stayyed at the hollywood orchid suites for a couple of nights.from the outside it just looks like a normal building once you got in it was nice.the room was huge with a seperate kitchen and dining area didnt really use the kitchen much apart from putting some beer in the fridge but it looked like it all worked ok.the pool looked nice but again i didnt use it as was a short stay.bit of noise acouple of nights as the walls seem thick but the noise ssems to travel through the doors but it soon went away.the best thing about this plae is the location right at the side of the hollywood and highland centre which leads on the walk of fame where there is plenty to see and and places to eat.the staff were helpful when had a couple of questions and handed out leaflets with nearst places to eat, cinema times ect. when i had quesions of how to get to universal studios the guy worked there told me how to get there and back. noc harge for leaving luggage eithier.all in all good place to stay

right in the heart of hollywood this place is all about location - if you want to stay somewhere totally central within minutes of the walk of fame, kodak theatre etc. then this is the place. yes, it's a bit dated, and maybe a bit noisy but it's in the centre of hollywood, it's clean, spacious, with a pool, secure parking and free wifi. we had a suite with 2 king beds - one in an 'almost' separate bedroom - with kitchen area. we loved that as it meant we didn't have to go out to find breakfast - by this time we were a bit fed up of pancakes maple syrup!eat at trastevere in hollywood highland, just round the corner - a fantastic italian!

fantastic location and good secure hotel we have just completed a 4 night stay here and were quite impressed with the hotel. as most of the reviews state the location is perfect right behind kodak theatre, mannéˆ¥??? chinese theatre hollywood highland mall.whilst the hotel is not brand new, of course if you do your research you already know that before you book, the price is reasonable and it is in this brilliant location.we had arrived into la early that morning and after picking up our rental car and doing some sightseeing we arrived at the hotel a couple of hours before check in. they allowed us to park in the carpark and we had a look through the mall until our room was ready.our room was very large with 2 armchairs, a separate hallway lead to a large wardrobe and down to the bathroom and there was a separate kitchen with dining table so we were able to have breakfast in the morning before going out. the room was also very clean and there was a courtyard off the main area if you wanted to sit outside or you can also sit at tables near the pool area. there is also free wi-fi internet as well.my partner and i would certainly recommend this hotel and should we return to la in the future we would definitely stay here.

location, location, location stayed for 4 nights late in july with partner and 2 kids (18y/o and 15 y/o). booked after reading reviews here on ta and everything was just as expected.if you want 5* luxury then look elswhere. if you want decent accomodation in the heart of la at a reasonable price then look no further. sure, the place is a little dated and the rooms could all do with some attention but at the end of the day it's a hotel and is to be used as a base and somewhere to sleep.we booked a one bed suite so the kids could have a seperate sleeping area and we found the room to be large enough to accomodate us all easily. there was a kitchen area but we never used if for more than boiling a kettle.this place is all about location - within 2 minutes you can be right on hollywood boulevard in the middle of the action. there are lots of places to eat in and around the hollywood and highlands centre and even a great view of the hollywood sign.access is easy and the underground parking and free (although intermmitent) wi-fi came in handy for keeping in touch. front desk more than helpful when required and we did hear the traffic making deliveries to the hh centre but it never disturbed us. kids loved the pool after a hot steamy day in la.overall we were very glad we booked this hotel and would have no hesitation in recommending to others who are looking for reasonably priced accomodation in the heart of los angeles.

just ok. the hotel is a nice bargain for the location and room amenities. located in the middle of hollywood, is a 3 start property with a 4 start service. front desk is extremely helpful, and provide you with many attractions information as soon as you check in. room is what you expect in a studio apartment. however, donéˆ¥??› expect a fancy room. just a nice place to relax. pool is small, but great. many dinner options within walking distance. metro is just 3 minute walk. my only complaint is the noise during the morning due to the trucks loading/unloading process at the mall. ask for an inside room, not one that face the street.if you are looking for great location and a nice place to relax after a long day, this hotel is a strong option.

not for me stayed at this hotel for one night in july. one night was plenty. we got there early and was told that we couldn't check in because the room wasn't ready. we could park there though which was good for us. the parking is under the hotel and is accessed only by a locked gate. the whole place has locks everywhere. locks to the garage, locks to the front desk, locks to the stairwells. i wonder how bad it is that they have to lock everything? we walked over to hollywood and highland which looks like a new outdoor mall. very nice place. within minutes of the hotel. we then walked hollywood blvd. went back to the hotel and was told we could check in. went to our room only to find cleaning ladies still there. they rushed out of there. they only left two towels for four people. i had to go find them to get more towels. room was just okay. it was really big but very outdated. it had a weird smell. the bed was extremely uncomfortable. very lumpy, terrible. room was as clean as it could be for a very old place. the pool was very clean although we didn't use it.the worst part about the whole thing is at 5:30 am you feel like you're at a freight terminal. you're right behind the mall so you hear trucks backing up making deliveries. unloading of the trucks and trucks ideling while waiting to unload. the whole hotel was up by then or so it seemed. this place is alright for one night but imo i wouldn't stay here again.
