great location! we stayed at hollywood orchid suites for 7 nights during the first week of december. we arrived at 8am after traveling from australia for over 16 hours. thankfully, the staff were great and very friendly and our room was ready for us to check into. although the room wasn't the most beautiful place we've seen, it was clean and well presented. we stayed in a king executive room, which was huge. there was a separate kitchen with full size fridge and microwave, as well as a good sized table which could seat four. the location of this place is fantastic, only a few seconds' walk from the hollywood highland center and hollywood blvd, with all of the touristy sights such as graumann's chinese theater and the walk of fame. another huge bonus of the orchid suites is the free internet access offered. although there is only one computer, we never had a problem with waiting to use it.there was a strange smell in the room when we arrived, but it turned out to be the cleaning products and didn't really bother us too long.the only criticism we have is that the room was a little old and worn out, but that seemed to be la in general. for the light sleepers, remember to pack earplugs - we could hear the person in the room next door snoring every night, so loudly it was as though we were in the same room.if you choose to stay at the orchid suites, just remember you're not paying the high prices of other hotels in the area, so don't compare it to those. the location couldn't be beaten, the staff were very friendly and helpful, and the room was clean and well maintained, which is what we were looking for.

excellent find! my husband and i stayed here for 3 nights in april, and it was fantastic! the location is unbeatable (we were worried it might have been over exaggerated on the website!) the room we had was massive, with a great bathroom, and the pool was lovely! the laundry facilities also came in useful! i'd recommend this to everyone, and can't wait to stay here again!

new year at the orchid our party of four adults spent new year's at the hollywood orchid. having stayed at a few other hotels in west hollywood , noho and downtown i would place the orchid in the same category. it's not a palace but if that's what you want then fork over $300 a night and stay at the renaissance or roosevelt. see what $150 a night buys you in other notorious tourist traps like london, toronto, new york, etc.the orchid has nice large rooms with two completely separate sleeping areas. we stayed in room 106 beside the pool and found the place quite adequate for our needs. access to the hollywood/highland mall is only steps away, half the room price could account just for the convenient location alone. the parking is quite good, the staff friendly and helpful. we felt that it was good value for the money and would have no problem staying there on our next visit to la.

you get what you pay for, but great location! we stayed at the hollywood orchid suites for 4 nights in november 2006. you couldnt ask for a better location, so close to hollywood boulevard. at night, there was little noise, so was easy to sleep.the rooms were big, and the bed was extremely comfortable, and overall it was pretty clean. the only bad thing about this place is the terrible smell!! we could't even walk into our kitchen it smelt so bad. we had to sleep with the doors open, and when we did this everything was fine.the internet there was free which was good. the hotel staff were quite helpful also.

wow! what a great find!! the suite was clean, large, and everything worked. because the hotel is a converted apartment building, it had a lot of great things that you don't get in regular hotels, such four options of switches in the bathroom, fairly sound proof rooms, and windows that actually open. the bathtubs were equipped with those handy bars, for those of us getting older than we'd like. the beds were very comfortable (with new matresses!). the staff was really helpful. the maintenance man even gave my family a tour of the suite and made doubly sure everything worked when we checked in.the best thing was that the price was what was quoted, i.e. no add ons such as parking fees, spa fees, internet access, entertainment package fees...only the required bed tax (now 14%).it was very quiet, and unbelieveably close to all the main hollywood attractions. my kids begged me to stay here everytime we come to los angeles. i am only too happy to grant their request. what a great value for my money!

cheap...you get what you pay for we decided to stay at the hollywood orchid suites, due to the wonderful reviews we read here on trip advisor. it was as the reviewer below me explained, a converted apartment building. the beds, as stated were awful, one of them even had ripped up sheets on the bed! the tubs...same as the other person said...dirty and the skid strips looked nasty..i am wondering if we had the same room, or if they are all like this! there is a kitchen, dont look around too much..you might see the roach motel that is in the bottom cupboard! i hated it here, i hated hollywood period, but this hotel sure didnt help!they said that there is a roof top garden..there is...but nothing to write home about. i think the cleanest thing here was all the clothes in my bags, that never went into any of those drawers!this place, is convenient, cheap and very accesible to all the hollywood things, but if you can pick somewhere clean, and with more comfortable beds and sans the roach motel...i would do that instead.

what a dump! yes it is cheap. yes it is in a good location.but i wish i had paid more at a clean hotel and not felt like i had to wear shoes in the room because i did not want to step on the carpet with my bare feet. the widow in the bathroom was caked in dirt and what appeared to be mold.the bed was like laying on concrete. absolutely horible sleeping conditions. i put a towel down in the tub when i took a shower because i didn't want to step on the non skid strips in the tub because they had filth on the side of them. yuk.fortunately i was only there two nights and could not wait to get out of there. my advise.... save up your money to stay at a real hotel not some converted apartment building. it was a miserable stay.
a superb value in hollywood!! room :: bathroom :: kitchenette

the orchid can't be beat i have to concur with all the other reviews on here. this is the best hotel to stay in in hollywood, bar none. the price is great, the rooms are clean and amazingly big, and the location is better than anything hollywood has to offer. one block to hollywood boulevard and all the attractions there - a locked underground parking lot with pass-key and you can access the garage without leaving the hotel. my wife and i are going on vacation in two weeks and this will be our second stay here and after trying several different hotels, we plan on using the orchid exclusively from now on.

location and value, plus spacious! my husband and i stayed in one of the king deluxe suites here on a wednesday night, it was only $99! there was enough room for 4 to stay comfortably. the kitchen was totally stocked with whatever you wanted for cooking, and we couldnt believe the extra bedroom. it was like staying in an apartment. you walk right through this corrider and just like that your in hollywood and highland mall. you are literally on the same block as all the happenings in hollywood, there was a robin williams premier that night, and we just walked in the door of the jimmy kimmel live show and got seats. we had a blast with so much to do, and the location and price of this hotel was key. the staff was very friendly, and though the rooms were older, it was also clean.we will definately be back!!

unbelieveably great value the hollywood orchid is literally a 4 minute walk to grauman's chinese, hollywood walk of fame, and where the tours of hollywood originate, and a 2 minute walk to kodak theater center (plenty of restaurants, shops, etc ). you could not ask for a better location for first-time hollywood visitors.but, what makes the orchid such a value is that despite it's location, it offers spacious suites (and, i do mean spacious) right in the heart of hollywood with extremely affordable prices. highly recommended!ohhhh, and thanks trip advisor reveiwers for turning me onto this place! i'll be back!!!!!!

great value ,great location the location is brilliant litererally 2 minute walk from the walk of fame,very reasonable rate i think only paid 80 dollars a night , it was clean and comfortable and so spacious ,the bed was the biggest bed i have ever slept in! it wasnt really warm enough to use the pool but it looked nice, the lift was a bit small but still ok.

great place! thanks to the reviews on this site, we tried it out last week. it was perfect for us and wish we had been able to take advantage of the full kitchen. we had one small problem but customer service was excellent. front desk was friendly and we were close to the walk of fame, grauman's and kodak. i would stay here again. i am a bargain shopper and need a clean, safe room without paying for all the frills.

an island of calm in a sea of madness imagine the madness of hollywood highland, the mall, the kodak theatre, the chinese theatre, the throngs of tourists and crazy characters...then imagine walking through the mall, out the back exit and into a quiet leafy street, where your hotel is 20 yards away. that hotel is the hollywood orchid suites - an island of calm in a sea of madness. you don't just get a room, you get a complete kitchen, and i mean complete...fridge, cooker, microwave, toaster oven, sink, all the cutlery, crockery and pots and pans you will need. thus you can make your own meals if you don't like the stodgy fare of mel's, denny's etc. you get a pool that seems barely used, so you can probably have it to yourself if you want it. all this for only $99 + tax per night. of course there are catches - the peaceful calm of orchid avenue is broken in the early hours by the delivery trucks to the mall, if you're on that side of the hotel. the rooms are clean and fully functional, but not modern. there aren't many channels on the tv. between the tall buildings, the pool gets about 2 hours of sunshine a day. but these are minor niggles. if you have a car, there is free secure underground parking, if you don't, you have easy access to the metro red line and a host of bus routes. either way you have the world's greatest city on your doorstep. i recently spent 11 nights here and didn't want to go home. however, if sparkling luxury is what you're after, the renaissance is across the road for three times the price.

great value in hollywood my husband and i just returned from a one week stay at the hollywood orchid suites and i have nothing but good things to say about the experience. we had an executive suite for $99--a large bedroom with a sofa and seating area, a full kitchen and bathroom. i requested and received a non-smoking room. the room was old but it was spacious and clean. we were at the front of the building so there was noise from service vehicles at the renaissance hotel across the way but we had our a/c on most of the time so it didn't bother us at all. la is a noisy city and on our first visit we stayed at the holiday inn express on labrea--a much noisier location and a much smaller room. the use of the complimentary computer was great for checking bus schedules and e-mail. our room also had a safe which i appreciate so i can put my passport away and not worry about it. the young man at the front desk was pleasant and helpful--something that's not always true in budget hotels in la. and, of course, as everyone says, the location can't be beat. we relied on public transit the whole week. this hotel is not for everyone because it is a little tired around the edges but i loved it and will definitely stay there again.

no better location!!! from start to finish we had a great stay at this hotel! even before we arrived, having emailed the hotel directly with questions - the staff responded straight away were very helpful. arriving from australia being too early to check in (but we could have if the room hadn't have had someone else staying in it the previous night), the staff were happy to hold our suitcases in a secure room while we went out started exploring the walk of fame. the location is fantastic - perfect for weary travellers who have spent their days out about. so close to the subway (jump on it travel 3 mins to universal studios), or straight through the mall across the road you're at the historic very fabulous el capitan theatre. ask at reception about their discounted tickets for universal studios - they saved us $13 per entry. while the suite is a little old - it was clean very large it's nice to have room to spread out. having the free internet access was also a bonus. i would highly recommend this hotel - it's great value for money you'll love the location. thanks again to the fabulous staff for being so helpful friendly during our stay!!

great and close to everything!! we stayed here from august 8th-august 13th. the stay was great. we didn't love the room, but the location of the hotel and the free parking made it that much better. the rooms are older, yet are clean and spacious. we stayed in an executive suite, which was great as it had a full kitchen, which is great if you like to make your own meals. we didn't, but atleast we had the option. the hotel is literally a two minute walk to a shopping mall (hollywood and highland complex) which has everything, including dining. and it is another two minutes from there down to hollywood boulevard. very good value. i would recommend this hotel.

good experience i picked the hotel because of the reviews here. i like its location, its price and the fact the parking and wireless is free.things went largely according to my expectations.the wireless internet wasn't good in our room. it's totally unusable on one laptop. it was usable sometimes on the other laptop if i sit on the sofa next to the window. it's ok outside near the swimming pool. i didn't know this and wasted quite some time the first night trying to set the wireless internet up. our suite was at the opposite end from the office. it would probably be better in roooms closer to the office.the noise some people complained here was not an issue for us. because of the time lag, we got up always early. besides, we always had the a/c on which is so loud that it drowns out any other sound. couple of times i was bothered by talking outside and i just turned on the a/c to solve the issue.the only complaint i have is that the carpet is rather old and dirty. didn't feel too good as i didn't bring sandals and wasn't able to find a place to buy a pair. also my little one liked to crawl on the carpet. another issue with our suite is that it's rather dark, even during the day. you might want to think about if you like the suite before you unpack. i didn't bother to switch becaue i like the suite number.it's an old building, but everything is well maintained. it's run just like any other professionally managed hotel. there's a coin laundry priced just like one you find in any street. we washed our clothes for less than $3.the charge for phone is also reasonable. it's just a quarter for 800 calls. free for local. i made a call to area code 310 which they said would incur a charge. turned out it's also just a quarter.the swimming pool is small but very cozy. our kids really enjoyed it the first couple of days when we stayed near the hotel. not that many people use it so it feels like a private pool.

fantastic value this place was fantastic...great value for money, and so close to hollywood boulevard..the staff were great....it is a little older, but clean and spacious and it was fantastic to have a kitchen..l would recommend this to anyone and personally are glad to have stayed there...aaaaaa++++

okay, great location after a bad experience with best western we chose this hotel because our tourist guide recommended it. the hotel is located in downtown hollywood, right behind the kodak theatre. they have their own parking garage, which you can open with your room key. they have a laundry service too, and an elevator.we had a junior suite (smallest room) on the third floor. the room was very spacious, because it used to be an appartment building. we had a kitchenette too.wireless internet didné?“t work properly, we had to sit on the floor right next to the door to have access (but that didné?“t work all the time). staff was okay, but not very friendly. the worst thing was the connecting door, our neighbours had some kind of party the whole night, they had loud music first and then talked so loud and screamed and did some other things i woné?“t mention here.best thing about the hotel is the location. walking distance to hollywood boulevard is about 2 minutes, there is a shopping centre nearby which has restaurants too and live music.

great value hotel stayed here in may.location could not be better! generally friendly service, clean rooms, free internet and value for money.highly recommended if you're looking for a midrange hotel.
just the best orchid suites view

fine for a stop in hollywood the hotel is in a great location.....behind the kodak theatre and a 2 minute walk to hollywood blvd. the rooms (suites) are very big, as they used to be apartments. the place is very dated and our room had a bit of a musty smell, not too bad. the parking garage under the complex is nice if you have a car. the place is good for a stop in hollywood, or for a big family or group.....as i said, the place is dated, but very clean. we stayed there one night (don't need more than that in hollywood) and paid $99.

next time i will not look anywhere else i chaperoned a small group of high school students visiting colleges in the la area. the main reason we stayed at the orchid suites was because of the price, but now i cannot imagine having been happier anywhere else. while the facility is not top of the line, the rooms in our block were all clean, spacious and met our needs. one of the best experiences our group had was visiting the nearby grocery store to gather items to stock in our kitchens for the week we were there. the location was very nice - right in the heart of hollywood. although we used the nearby subway a time or two, we had rental cars which were very secure in the free parking garage under the hotel. while one should be cautious in any major metropolitan area, we felt safe walking through the area.i recommend the orchid suites to anyone looking for a great location and a good deal. what you get for your money here is one of the best values in the country.

good sized rooms located behind the kodak theatre in hollywood, this is a charming little hotel.it is nothing flash, hard beds, uncomfortable pillows, but you get what you paid for.i wouldn't have a problem staying here again if i wanted to stay in hollywood (but after seeing hollywood i didn't like the area).staff were friendly and the free undercover parking only sweetens the deal.this is a great value hotel.

amazing value, excellent location we stayed in a deluxe suite from 11th to 14th april 2006. it's an amazing find. the rates are great. the location is unbelievable. it's located in a cul de sac behind highland and hollywood shopping centre (there's a back door so it only takes a minute to get there) with a good range of shops and restaurants and also contains the kodak theatre where the oscars are held and the subway is very near by, (which was very easy to use and one stop to universal studios). it's on the same block as the chinese theatre with the walk of fame running along it. it's also quite close the freeway which made it easy to find and despite the traffic straight forward to get to disney to in just over an hour. the area felt very safe and the accomodation had a good level of security. there was free, underground, locked parking and always free spaces. the staff were extreamley helpful and let us keep are car there after check out. the property is very well maintained and very clean. our apartment was very spacious and clean. the furniture is very comfortable and well maintained although it might be a bit dated for some peoples' tastes . we had a large open plan lounge with sofa bed, armchairs, dinning table and four chairs, kitchen including microwave and a breakfast bar area. we had a seperate bedroom with king bed and there was three large wardrobes. the bathroom had a shower. there were two televisions and a safe in the room. there's a laundrette and an outdoor swimming pool. we would not hesitate to recommend this to others and certainly would be willing to return ourselves as we were very impressed.

great value what a lucky find! an incredible location (right behind graumann's chinese theatre but on a quiet cul-de-sac), only a block from the red line subway. i had what can best be described as an apartment-type unit for only $89 a night.the staff was friendly and helpful. will definitely stay there again if i ever go back to la.

suite location although the room is a little dated, having the kitchenette was nice for our family of 4, and the hotel location couldn't be better. the parking and internet access are included which is a plus. the hotel also has a pool and laundry room. we only stayed 2 nites ($79/nite for jr. suite), but if were staying longer would get a full suite (with full kitchen and microwave). we missed not having a microwave in the kitchenette. it is a good value for a suite in a sweet location and would not hesitate to stay here again.

it was fine i thought the hotel met our needs perfectly. i was traveling with my husband and two adult daughters. we have them the bedroom and we had the bed in the front room. even though our room was on the first floor, right by the pool there was never any noise. also it's on a safe street and seconds away from the hollywood tourist scene, which thought was a benefit. free parking and i always felt very safe there. my only complaint is that the room reeked of cigarette smoke. other than that it was clean and you could not find a better price for a two bedroom room. i would definitely stay there again.

very disappointed- did we stay at the same place????????? after reading all of the reviews i expcated a lot more from this place. i actually wondered if we were staying in the same place. i agee with eveyone the location is wonderful- could't ask for a better location. in addition it also offered free parking and internet access. the room was dated, carpet was worn and it smelled of stale smoke. i did not feel it was clean. as a matter of fact, the shower curtain had black mildew all over the back, the windowsill in the bathroom was just filled with dirt and the placemat on the kitchen table had dried ketchup stuck on it. we had a double queen suite. on the back bed the, there was a hole in the bottom sheet large enough my husbands foot kept getting stuck in it. finally the pillows were just awful. i was very disappointed and will never stay here again.

great value! we stayed 2 nights at the orchid suites and were pleased. the staff was very friendly. my husband got the flu the day we checked in and the woman at the front desk was so concerned and helpful. she also made sure we know about special happenings around town. the place is not beautiful but very clean and spacious.
better than expected and wonderful location king size bed

fabulous budget hotel my husband and i are in our 30éˆ¥??? and were looking for a budget hotel to spend a couple days before a cruise. after reading various reviews, we decided to stay at this hotel based on price and location. the location was phenomenal, within walking distance to most attractions and a couple blocks away from the metro and bus lines (which we used with ease). the service was top notch. upon our arrival (via taxi) on a friday night, the front desk attendant buzzed us in and even assisted us with our luggage. he was very friendly and welcoming. our king suite was located on the first floor in the back of the hotel. our room was spacious and adequately equipped with a full kitchen. the coffee maker with coffee, tea, sugar and cream packets was a welcome touch. we had a large patio with 2 chairs a table and a couple lounge chairs, which we used to start our morning sipping coffee and planning out our day. down side was the noise. the maid station was right next to our room. we tried taking an afternoon nap, only to hear them talking very loudly, vacuuming, etc. the entire time. the pool looked nice, but we did not have enough time to use it. highly recommend if you want something simple at a great value!

great location well equiped suites right in the middle of hollywood. steps to graumanns and kodak theater. we had lots of room, comfortable unit but showing its age. great price (about $70/night) would stay there again.

love it, so comfy and roomy i had mixed feelings going into this hotel with the reviews i had read on here, but i was very happily surprised. i have junior room, $69/night and it is huge. there are two double beds, two huge closets, a big bathroom (that you can heat up!!) and a small kitchen. the kitchen has 1 burner, a coffee maker, a teapot, a sink and small fridge. cooking utensiles, dishes, cups, silverware...everything you need is included. including the kitchen table!! the beds are comfortable and while it is not 2006-modern it is still pretty up-to-date. the tv is a little old but it still works fine. i would definately reccommend this hotel to anyone and everyone. it is very close to everything and it is very, very safe. everything has a lock, or 3 (which the doors in the actual rooms have) the parking lot, the front door, it was all locked.i will be here for the next week and i am completely confident that i will be fully satisfied.
noisy but nice view from level 3

great value since reading the reveiws here prompted me to stay at the hotel, i feel i should contribute!i will just be repeating what many others have said:- price is great - location behind the kodak theatre close to everything you need- room was very big and very clean- staff was really very, very friendly and helpful - property is very secure- parking is free - free wireless access to the internet use of a pc in the lobby if you don't have a laptopthis hotel is a great value!

great value and location! my wife and i attended a seminar in west hollywood. their suggested hotels were over $150.00 per night. being on a limited budget, we searched elsewhere. we saw hollywood orchid suites on tripadvisor and decided to try it for about $71.00 per night. we were pleasantly surprised. the hollywood orchid suites was an old apartment building, so each suite has a bedroom, which is similar to a normal hotel room, and a separate full kitchen. the closets were generous and the bathroom was average. they had heat in the bathroom and the exhaust fan actually was effective. my wife loves that! the balcony was nice touch with a table and chairs. the hotel was old and dated, but very neat and clean. the pool was spotless. the desk help had no personality, but was very helpful and knowledgable of the area and the best route back to the airport. i loved the free, secure, underground parking. rain is no problem. the location is great if you want to visit the chinese theater. you can walk. their is no breakfast, but pick up some groceries on the way and put them in the full size refrigerator. overall, it is an excellent value and we would stay their again.

this is the place i'd stay for the price we paid ($89 /day), what we got was way aboove expectation. people are friendly. lady at reception spent almost 30 minutes, giving us various options where we can go (as we had one spare day). and spent 20-25 minutes, trying to arrange some tourist bus to go around places.this is the hotel i'd stay if i go to hollywood again!

much better than expected for that price.beautiful. we did not expect to find such a wonderful hotel for the price of 89$ per night just right in the heart of hollywood: behind the kodak theatre, close to everything you need. the room was excellent - very big and clean, with a nice kitchen. the staff was really very, very friendly and helpful in providing us with information of any kind. the hotel is very secure: though there is a safe in the room, you don't really need it since getting into the hotel is quite impossible without the key. parking is for free - which saved us a lot of money. and you have a free wireless access to the internet. all in all, we highly recommend this hotel for everybody, since it was really great! we would stay there again any time!

bargain in hollywood yes the orchid suites is a bargain in hollywood! our family of 6 stayed in a 2 bedroom unit for 2 nites. the location is ideal for visiting hollywood and universal studios. keep in mind the hotel is old and we did not like the smell-- kind of old cigarette smell. the swimming pool is tiny and not heated while we were there. the pool was too cold to swim in. we had to wait 20 minutes for our room to be ready at check-in even though i called two hours before arrival and we arrived in the early evening. the staff are for the most part very helpful. parking was in the underground garage was great with easy access to 101.

this is the place to stay. my family and i stayed in this hotel for a night in dec. 2005. what a gem it is! we stayed in many different places in and around hollywood area before, but none was this good. as other reviewers mentioned, it is at walking distance to hollywood walk of fame. the area felt very safe. the parking was free and secured in an underground facility.the hotel looks more like an old apartment. we stayed in their 2 bedroom suite, which was very spacious. the kitchen was very spacious and functional. everything was clean and just perfect. the staff was very friendly. they even let us keep our car parked there for a few hours after the check-out, so we could take a walk to the hollywood walf of fame.the facility has one swimming pool, but since it was dec. we didn't use it. the carpet in the room is ready for a replacement, i guess. while it is clean, you could feel the old carpet and its smell.this is exactly where i stay in my next visit to hollywood.

very happy we stayed at the hollywood orchid suites for four nights in december 2005 after much searching on the internet and in guidebooks. there was a manager's special on the website so the rate for a room with a full kitchen and king sized bed was excellent. the location couldn't be better as others have noted. just a few steps to shopping, restaurants and the metro which will take you all over la. the hotel is older but the room was spotless, and at this time of year, it was very quiet. the staff at the front desk were very friendly and helpful. i spoke to the owner one evening and told him we were very pleased with the hotel, since there are many other hotels that look good on the internet but turn out to be dodgy or in a seedy area. i told him that i look for reviews on this site and he indicated that he had read that some guests were not happy and that he wished they would tell the staff rather than leaving and writing bad reviews. i agree; it's only fair to give the staff the opportunity to rectify the situation. i have nothing negative to say about this hotel and i would not hesitate to stay here again.

great place to stay, amazing location/ price honestly this place is great. the price is amazing compared to many other places in l.a and the location is great as well. this was the only part of hollywood that i felt comfortable in. plus the free parking made it easier to have a car - because you need a car if you want to see everything in l.a. its much faster, easier, cheaper, and safer if you just rent a car.- even though the rooms are outdated style wise, they are still clean and large. the staff was helpful and friendly. one thing you have to remember is that this is a budget hotel, probably like a 2 star. so there are no extras and nothing is fancy. but it is still great value and i would definetly recommend it everyone.

good value but service could be better we booked a suite months in advance for a family of five. despite this, the sofa bed did not have any sheets provided - when these were requested from reception,i was almost called a liar. other bedding provided was inadequate as it was cold the heater did not work. in general the person on reception was rude throughout our stay. apart from its cental location with free parking the room being clean, i would be reluctant to stay here again purely because of the poor service.

great location and free parking stayed for 1 night in september and 2 nights in octobergood points:around 15 metres from the back entrance to the hollywood and highland centre which the chinese theatre is part of. this also connects to hollywood boulevard. the area around this complex is the only part of la i felt safe walking around until the early eveningfree underground secure parking with plenty of spacesrooms were very spacious, secure and clean and had safe.very reasonably priced. only $79 a night plus tax in october, plus the parking was safe and free.bad pointsrooms slightly outdated - but they were clean and excellent value for the priceslightly noisy. this was nothing that a pair of earplugs did not fix!

perfect location! the hotel is clean and parking is free and location is perfect, right behind the kodak theatre takes 2 min. to get there! pls. be aware that it's old and not fancy. staff was friendly and helpfull.

great hotel, huge rooms well, must admit, i got kinda worried after reading some of the reviews. but this hotel is great! we stayed 2 nights. location is great: walking distance (1 block) to mann's chinese and hollywood highland.free parking in a locked garage. rooms are very big and have a full kitchen: great.

great location, nice room, but early morning noise we stayed at the hollywood orchid suites for five nights on our vacation in august, 2005. we paid about $112/night, including tax. we couldn't have asked for a much better location. the hotel is located behind the kodak theater and grauman's chinese theater and a short walk to restaurants, shops, a metro stop and other popular attractions. the hotel itself is small and old, but our room was large, newly-remodeled, clean and comfortable. it included two large closets, one of which had shelves, and a full kitchen (which we didn't use). underground parking was free. our biggest (and only) complaint was noise. the suite above us apparently didn't have carpet, and we were awakened in the middle of the night with what sounded like a wrestling match. we complained to the front desk and the problem was immediately taken care of. however, there was another noise problem which the front desk had no control over. the hotel is kitty-corner from a large, busy loading dock. we were awakened every morning by the sound of trucks accessing the loading dock. the noise started about 6:30am and included the beeping of the trucks when they backed up. since our room was in the very front of the hotel, we got the worst of the noise, but i suspect that most of the rooms got some as well. in summary, i would definitely recommend this hotel, but suggest that the front rooms be avoided, unless you are a very heavy sleeper.
great location and staff...horrible guests! view from 2nd floor

big but not beautiful the hotel rooms were large but very dated and worn. the beds were extremely hard and the kitchen looked clean but looking closely you wouldn't want to eat much there. the air conditioners and plumbing were both very noisy. it was very easy to hear adjoining neighbors and we could even see one man showering from the hallway!!! (head up of course) on the plus side, the pool was nice (no spa) and the location is good. it is behind the kodak theatre so you have zero view but walking distance to all of the hollywood blvd. sites. staff was courteous and helpful.

another great stay orchid suites continues to be a great bargain in a prime hollywood location. i've stayed here with family members two years in a row and would certainly return. rooms are large with (in many cases) a well-equipped full kitchen. underground parking is safe, secure, and convenient. pool is a pleasant diversion and well-maintained. i noticed a problem with a loose spotlight in the pool this year, reported it to the front desk and was impressed to see it fixed in a matter of hours. at some hotels, that type of problem means closing the pool for days at a stretch. the rooftop garden/sunning spot is a great place to relax and watch the activity below.the only minor problem this year was with a noisy neighbor above us. when i mentioned it to the front desk, they asked the family to take another room on the first floor: problem solved.staffers are friendly, helpful and well-informed. we left a video cord behind this year, and they tracked it down and mailed it to us at no charge. overall, a great stay and a great bargain. i highly recommend it.

great on the wallet this is not a fancy hotel, they do not have a large amount of amenities, but if this is the area of los angeles you want to stay in, it can't be beat for value. i stayed here in the past and have reservations to stay again. the rooms are outdated, but clean and they full kitchen with everything you need is excellent if you can't afford to eat out every meal. the location is fantastic and, unless you are out at the wee hours of the morning, the neighborhood is quite safe. i look forward to my next stay.

exceded expectations when planning our southern ca vacation, i bought several tour books because i tend to over-research everything. this hotel was mentioned in at least one of them. i compared it to some others (like magic castle), and this one was more within my budget and sounded ideal. i found it a little confusing to get to (hollywood traffic is laughable), but accidentally ended up in the correct lane, and made the correct turn at the intersection of a thousand arrows (those who have been there will know what i'm talking about). when we entered the room, i was absolutely shocked at the size. it was huge. as others have intimated, it's not plush, but unless you plan on spending a lot of time in your room, it's more than adequate. and as others have also said, the location couldn't be much better. the only negative i can recall is that the suite had two rooms, and their was no way to shut off the one room, so the girls didn't have as much privacy as they probably would have liked. i've only been to h-wood once, so have nothing to compare this place to, but i wouldn't hesitate to recommend it.

cant beat it!! i stayed here at the orchids last year, my first time to holywood,,you just cant beat it,,the price is very inexpensive and the location is unreal,,literally 100 or so feet to the mall where the kodak theatre is and holywood blvd,,security is great, door is always locked, you must get buzzed in, or use your key!!,,the rooms are not a 4or 5 star hotel room, but they are very very large, it is like you are in a condo or an apartment,,mine had a sliding door that led out to a very large patio!! and a full kitchen with a door on it, thats right in the kitchen,,the furnsihing are old, but who cares,,if you take in consideration the location, price and largeness of the room, itworks great and also the staff was fine,,,have fun!!

fantastic hotel stayed here for a week december 2004, including christmas day, and couldn't have been more impressed. rooms are large (ours had a kitchen, which has a door you can close so you can make a cup of coffee and not disturb anyone sleeping or watching tv), beds are good. older style furnishings but everything is clean. staff are very nice and helpful, and the location is fantastic. just a very short walk out the front door into the back of hollywood highland centre, and a bus stop and train/subway station is right out the front of hollywood highland centre - there is aslo a tourist information desk there too. i found the rate on expedia the same as booking directly with them so i did that. they were very prompt with their confirmation and with any questions i had. if you check out the hotel's website they have a very clear description and layout of what the rooms are like which i found very helpful. couldn't recommend it enough, for sheer space in the rooms, location, cleanliness, and helpfulness of staff it can't be beaten on price.

hotel not so good, location great i chose hollywood orchid hotel for the location. i thought it was going to be alot better, by reading other peoples reviews online. not so in my case. i was told i would get a room with a view, and i got a view of a wall. the shower's drain wouldn't stay up, so i had to turn off the water to soap up. my handicap mother who was with me for mother's day, couldn't even use the shower because of this. parking underground great, but if you leave in the evening, you won't be parking in the underground garage when you come back. (parking very limited) i had a coupon for $65 for 2 beds/kitchette. they said they couldn't honor the price due to weekend. so i had to pay $79 ($90 total), and still had to give them the coupon for that price. the place was old, and run down. i brought my own sheets, and blanket which really helped me deal with this place. the only thing good about this place is the location. you walk underneath the renaissance hotel, and your right at the hollywood blvd. outside mall, kodak theatre, and manns chinese theatre. if you don't care where you sleep, then here's your place. personally i would spend a extra few bucks a get a better hotel. the roosevelt is just is close, and you can get good deals online. stay away from room #302 bad.... the indians/indonesians that run the hotel are nice, but don't give a ---- if something goes wrong in your room. sorry is all you'll get.

excellent, except for... the room was fantastic. great views, great location, spacious, and clean...only problem was that there was a colony of ants in the bathroom around the bottom of the sink. out of the three rooms we had mine was the only one with ants so it looks like it's probably just the one room and after the maid cleaned the next morning they were all gone.the staff is excellent and the location can't be beat if you're looking to experience hollywood.

overall a fun stay if you'd like to be right in the action in tourist central i was in town for business. this was a good place to stay if you want to be right in the middle of the action on hollywood boulevard, and by action i mean being able to step outside your hotel and be accosted by daffy duck or spiderman or pocahontas etc. and have shops right at your door. the hotel is opposite the chinese theatre so also puts you somewhere easily reminiscable when watching films as you'll frequently see both the hotel and vicinity on tv and in films.there are a lot of bands and celebrities who stay here so this is another level of action that you may seek out.after getting the chance to drive around lots and see different areas i reckon next time i'll probably rent an apartment by the beach, i tend to prefer more low key quiet chilled places with walking potential, and if this strikes a similar chord this hotel may not be for you.anyway, the hotel itself was made up of a gorgeous exterior and the same if somewhat dark interior, something i've noticed popular in celebrity haunts, 'all the better not to see you with my dear'.the pool is legendary, the rooms okay. clean a modern take on the 70's but as they are somewhat small and as the mattress sat in the middle of a larger wooden platform i kept bashing my shins on the corners every time i would walk around it- i still have the scars, so this was somewhat annoying.good desk, smallish window, dark bathroom with not much light, but all in all it was okay.meals there very pricey, breakfast, oatmeal fruit and tea plus tip set me back over $45. i couldn't relax very well in the rooms though, and i still don't really know why, there was nothing really wrong with it, and a great walk in closet if you're staying there for a while as i was.some say the hotel is haunted. who knows.

???? travelodge arrived here on a saturday afternoon firstly if you have a car you have to pay $23 per night tp park plus any tips this is not clear anywhere beforereceptionist didn't look too welcoming we asked for a room with a boulevard view we were given a car park viewrooms are painted chocolate brown and white furniture is choclate brown rooms are very unwelcoming fairly big but hardly any furniture too fill it dont expect any soft furnishingsi thought it looked very much like a travelodge/premier inn these are cosierin my opnion toooo expensive you are payng for location not roomyou'd be better off staying somewhere else and walking through hotel

not a bad stay i stayed at the roosevelt last week for a couple nights on a business trip. the hotel was in a terrific location and had tons of character. the rooms were small, but very warm and well appointed.my only caution on this hotel (especially if you get a good online rate) is all the add-on costs. parking is vallet only at $28 and all the resturants are pretty pricy. even packets of coffee in the room come at a cost. i ate most of my meals at nearby establishments; many just steps outside the hotel.

disappointed w/ the roosevelt i was looking forward to my stay at the roosevelt for a business conference i was attending. the location on hollywood blvd., is ideal, with plenty going on around the hotel.the room they initially gave me had an interesting style -- an urban, efficiency apartment feel to it, as i walked through (intentionally) dimly lit hallways with carpeting that mimmicked a brick road. the room had a brick wall interior (still dimly lit-- by design), hardwood floors, and a pavement like (concrete?) floor in the bathroom. the problem was---------- the noise. there wasn't necessarily that much noise, but, because of the (extremely) poor soundproofing of the rooms, ... you could hear very clearly every detail of the conversations in the rooms next to you. it was as if you were sharing a cabin with people you didn't know. when i called the front desk, to ask to have my room changed... they 'played' naive about it, but, i sensed this was a common complaint with guests, in that they quickly ended the charade, and gave me a more conventional room in a different section of the building.that room was indeed quieter, but very, very small. personally, i'm alright with that.when i opened the door, and walked into the new room, there were two staff members (not housecleaning) that had shocked looks on their faces (guilty looks). they immediately hung up the room phone, and bolted out of my room. i was kind of ticked, and called to make sure there were no charges against my room bill.because there was limited shelf space and closet space, the housekeeping crew accidently knocked my shaving kit into the toilet when they were cleaning. rather than fess up to it, they quietyly put it back in it's original location. that evening, when i got back to the room, i reached in, and noticed the thing was saturated with all of my toiletries wet., and items saturated.there was construction going on on the (street) lobby level, so guests needed to take the (only one operating) elevator down to the ground level, and hike back up a set steps to get outside.i know each of these issues sound minor and random, but, my general feeling is that for the price they charge per room, you should expect good customer service and attention to details. at a minimum, a reasonably quiet room would seem like a fair expectation.i wouldn't recommend the roosevelt... not for the prices they charge. i'm probably going to try the renaissance the next time i'm in the area. i don't expect everything to be perfect.. i just want a clean and quiet room to stay in, with minimal interruptions. i did not get that.

the roosevelt has it all covered i had the pleasure staying at the hollywood roosevelt last month for a long weekend. i found that the hotel had all aspects of a hip and fun, yet luxurious hotel covered. having an aversion to anything pretentious, being a fan of historic buildings and given the amentities within the hotel.... i was tempted to never leave. from the super comfortable bed and linens, kiehls bath products - to the pool, restaurants and bars. not to mention the helpful, attentive staff. the allure and ambiance of the lobby alone makes you want to stay!when i did leave, the location is unbeatable. right on hollywood blvd with so much within walking distance or a short drive / taxi ride away. kudos to staff and management for dialing it all in and creating a wonderful experience. i will definitely be returning to the hollywood roosevelt when i am in l.a.

good location and staff, comfortable rooms fantastic location -- right on walk of fame, catty-corner from the chinese theatre, lots of shopping. rooms are small but comfortable and well furnished. staff very friendly and helpful (it is california afterall). great burger bar on site -- lots of cool combos so you can still clog your atteries with even if you go with the turkey or veggie options. the atmosphere of the roosevelt is a bit dark -- qualifies as cool in the evenings, but in the morning dim lighting and techno music is a bit out of place/jarring -- but that's only a minor issue. one random extra i loved -- instead of the usual usa today outside your door in the morning, you get a ny times. just the thing for the coffee shop across the street from the hotel.

location, atmosphere, service its all here stayed 4 nights from oct 4th. with 3 adult children and 1 teenager. bathroom small and with no exhaust system became quite steamy but loved the keihl products, water pressure great. soft luxurious towels. room had two amazingly comfortable queen beds with enough room for 3 of us ( other 2 had own room). 4th floor room 414, i think not much of a view, looked over rooftop, if we hadn't been quite so tired( had just flown in from australia) we may have asked for better view but once we settled couldn't be bothered, although i'm sure they would have accommodated us. not dark and dingy as made out in some reviews. contemporary in design.have read reviews of snooty staff this was not what we found at all. check in was smooth, initially given room with only one bed but was rectified immediately. my children went to the bars in hotel, we brought various food and drink back and had no problem with security at any stage during our stay as other reviewers have complained about. a movie was being filmed one day of our stay with an enormous amount of equipment but this did not affect us at all. concierge (lauren i think) was helpful in organising limo and with any questions we had.lobby near main entrance is really old world hollywood and just beautiful, yes it is dark but that is part of its charm.location can't be beat right on hollywood blvd across from graumans . felt safe in this area at night as long as you don't go more than about 5 blocks down. although my children didn't worry at all and even walked to sunset at night.probably not for young children or budget conscious but we loved it!

great location we chose the roosevelt for its location...directly opposite manns chinese theatre and a stone's throw from the metro. this was a great decision as we only had two days in la the hotel was well placed for all the local attractions.we booked directly with the hotel but on arrival ended up with one of the smallest rooms next to the elevators. after 4 hours we decided to ask for another room as the noise was unbearable. this posed no problems and we were promptly moved (luckily to a bigger room, away from the elevators).despite this mishap the hotel had a lot of character...it was very dark but this only added to it's appeal. we ate in 25 degrees...and had a tasty burger lunch (good value service). room service was pricey - for breakfast we a ate at mels diner round the corner opposite the metro (fab, retro place open 24 hrs). the hotel had some nice touches e.g. the kiehls products in the bathroom, a turn down service at night and little bottles of mms left on your pillow.the only other down side was the bathroom - small but perfectly formed. i'd stay here again - but only for a couple of nights

loved the roosevelt i loved staying at the roosevelt! i loved the mediterranean tiles the hotel was decorated in. i really loved the old feel of this hotel.you cannot beat the location! its on hollywood blvd right across from the kodak chinese theatres.room was comfortable i slept very well. the staff was very accomodating and pleasant.a lot of celebrities were walking around the hotel, and i thought that was very cool. no one was paying them any attention, as if it was very normal, which was very cool.

good hotel, great location we are a couple in our twenties and were pleased with our choice of the hollywood roosevelt for a two-night visit. the location is perfect for exploring hollywood as it's right opposite the chinese theatre.the rooms are very small, but nicely done. for a two night visit the room size wasn't a problem, but it might be an issue if you're planning a longer visit. the bathroom was lovely too with a good supply of products by 'fresh'.the hotel itself is very dark, but that's part of its ambience. the reception was lovely and the concierge very helpful. we asked the concierge to book us tickets to the police who were playing at the bowl that evening - she sorted it all out for us while we went out sightseeing and our booking confirmation was under our door when we got in (although she did spend slighty more than we'd agreed).on our first evening at the hotel there was a pool party which looked fun, but a bit overwhelming after a long day travelling - it was packed full of local rich kids, with music from a live dj. the pool area is lovely during the day, unfortunately we didn't have enough time to make the most of it.we ate in the restaurant once and found the service very impressive. the food was lovely although there was not a great choice for my boyfriend who is vegetarian. the breakfast place within the hotel is very good too. during our stay there was a limited lift service which was annoying as it meant a long wait each time, but i'm sure that was just temporary.despite the hotel being rather pricey, its a great place to stay to be in the heart of things.
amazing hotel, want to go again! view from our room

this is la! just what i thought la would be like. this is a great looking hotel in a great location. extremely friendly staff. the concierge was a bit too cool for school but helpful to an extent.hire car was dealt with very well by reception, and free internet in the foyer made getting local info very easy.the room was nice. not as big as a lot of american hotels but comfy. we only stayed for two nights and as our room was on the third floor on the same level as the flat roof, we were disturbed on both nights by people drinking on the roof until early in the morning. on the second night, a lady actually managed to enter our room! as easy going young guys this was not a major problem, but i can imagine other people having a big problem with this! ask not to stay near the flat roof!the pool bar area was absolutely great though, and i think my favourite bar in hollywood. full of great looking people, great music, all set against a lit pool beneath the hotel sign. looked very nice. just sad i didn't drink there every night.overall, a very nice hotel exlcuding the disturbances, very friendly beautiful smiley faces everywhere and a great spot to explore hollywood and beverly hills.

big let down we arrived at the hollywood roosevelt as a newley wed couple after a four and a half hour journey from the beautiful friendly ritz carlton hotel at lake las vegas. we walked into the hotel reception feeling like the beverly hillbillies, the staff at reception were cold and unfriendly although the receptionist did give us and upgrade to a cabana (which he said was overlooking the gardens! and was really overlooking a multistorey carpark with a vine growing up the side of it) the guy who took our bags to the room was friendly he gave us the ins and outs of the place. the hallways were dark, very dark, the cabana room was dark, not as chic as it looks on the website, even with the lights on you need a torch to see in your suitcase. the bathroom was about the same size as the wardrobe and the floor of the room wasnt very clean. all the furniture just looked cheap and tacky not great for the price! we ventured off for a drink (out of the hotel) and luckily we met a nice couple who was also staying in the roosevelt, after a few drinks we all decided to head back to the roosevelt and keep on drinking at the tropicana bar which is at the poolside at the roosevelt, i had this idea that it would be full of hollywood glamour and lots of beautiful people but it wasn't. everyone was dressed casually, very arrogant, rude and pretentious. the hotel was overrun with teenaged kids spending daddy's money. we were made to feel like intruders everytime we wanted to go to our room as the tropicana security staff would stop us and ask us where we were going and check us off their list, even if you had a bottle of water you were asked to get rid of it (but im just going to my room for gods sake!) don't even bother to ask any of the staff about the history of the hotel, because they don't know. just read it up before you go and educate them while your there. also don't bother saying hello or smiling at the staff because they just look at you like your off your trolley.the room was noisey all night long, the walls must be paper thin. loud music, car alarms, talking from the rooms nearby, dont even get me started on the airconditioning unit! honestly i thought this hotel was going to be chic, sexy elegent, classy, brimming with hollywood history and glamour and it was totally the opposite, which is a big shame. the owners of the hotel seriously need to reconsider who they are contracting the leases of the bars to as they are making this hotel a very uncomfortable place to stay. this hotel could be a magic piece of old hollywood if it was just managed properly. we left after two nights and i couldnt believe that while we were waiting for the car to be brought round for us to leave, the car valet guy told us which room marilyn monroe had lived in for two years and it was the room right across from ours. i'd asked the staff several times and no-one knew. i couldnt believe it i had walked past the room several times and the door had been open and i didnt get a proper look. :( over all a complete let down.

noisy roosevelt the hotel is very nice albeit very dark. the room we were given was very small and as the furniture is all brown it looked even smaller. after a couple of hours in the room i felt myself gettin agitated and couldnt stand being there anymore. the hotel staff were very good and changed our room to a larger one. i was very happy until the pool bar started playing their music and then sleep was out of the question until 2am when it ended. on the 3rd night we decided to go to the pool bar and have a drink and see what it was all about, my husband was then told that he had to change his clothes, he was dressed very smarlty in shorts and shirt but as it was yet another private party it wasn't good enough for them. looking around we noticed that most men were dressed in scruffy jeans and t-shirts but that was ok. again the noice went on until 2am and then drunken shouts and cars honking for another hour. on our 4th and last night all was quiet and we thought, great we can get to sleep at a reasonable time until, that is, 12.20am when pass the duchy on the left hand side blasted from the pool bar, out came the sleeping pills again. and we were on the 7th floor. if thats what you want on your holiday then its a great place, but then who can afford to drink all night at the hotel pool bar, $24 for 2 drinks. its no use complaining because it goes on deaf ears.

classic experience! the roosevelt hollywood is a beautiful place to stay, especially if you want to experience the history of it. marilyn monroe used to live there in one of the suites above the pool, and she also had her first modeling job at the pool. many of the old moviestars used to hang out at the hotel for drinks, and it still has that classy feel. the first academy awards was also held in one of the meeting rooms there.rooms: the first night we stayed in the cabana suite, which was amazing inside. it overlooks the pool, which as other reviews mentioned, does turn into a hotspot at night with fun music and a young crowd. the other nights we stayed in a standard room. it was very nice as well. soft feather comforter! the only downside is that only the suite had bathroom counter space, so as a girl, it was hard to get ready with just a sink.pool: the pool is one of the most popular, if not the most popular, hotel pool in hollywood. it's surrounded by 50s style suites, pretty palm trees, has wonderful soft lounge chairs/beds, as well as wait staff for food and drinks. the only reason i did not give this hotel a 5 star is because of some rude staff (not all of them, just some).there is a club called teddy's that very popular, but it turns into a guest list only after 10 or 10:30. it is not owned by the hotel, so that's why people can't just get in even if they're staying at the hotel. most bars/clubs at night are guest list only so you have to call during the day to get on the list or go early unless you're with all girls.overall, this hotel is worth the stay just to experience both old and new hollywood, and it's so close to everything else in la. 15 min. from the beach, beverly hills, etc. the kodak theater with all of the famous gold stars and handprints is across the street. you can also see the hollywood white letters too. the valet service is very friendly and helpful!

pretty good - but pool turns into club scene at night i just returned from a 10 day stay at the roosevelt. i'd heard good reviews from friends but was a little disappointed. i stayed in a regular room with 2 beds overlooking the roof (had a lovely view of the air conditioners). pros:bed was very nice -- soft white down comforter and pillows.front desk and valet staff were very friendly and helpful.location is great. restaurants, food and walk of fame etc very close. there is a longs a block away where you can buy anything you could ever possibly need.cons:there is a coffee machine in the room but you have to pay 3.50 for the coffee in the mini bar. i've traveled all over the world and don't recall ever seeing that before, is it just me or is that a little ridiculous?closet was dark due to the dark paint and lack of lighting. water leaks out the side of the shower so you're guaranteed a pool of water under the sink after every shower.overall it was a good experience but there is one thing i do want to mention. the pool turns into a club at night and can be a rather nice place to hang out - if you can get past the bouncers. i had no trouble getting in but some of my co-workers did. despite being guests they were told they needed to be with girls and on another occasion they were told they needed to go change their clothes. being a hotel guest doesn't guarantee entry or that they'll treat you with respect. so, if you're not in the mood for a club scene, as soon as they put up the velvet ropes avoid the pool.

for somebodies a beautiful hotel in a great spot in hollywood (albeit very dark). the bell staff and housekeeping were very helpful and courteous. the reception staff were only interested in you if you were somebody (we weren't). room small but well fitted out. beware of the air-conditioning that sounds like a jet taking off and shares the scents of nearby rooms.

all around nice hotel. my boyfriend and i recently stayed at this hotel for our first trip to l.a. the hotel itself is very nice but dark everywhere. it's in a great location on hollywood blvd, within walking distance to many exciting attractions. we paid extra for a larger room and were disappointed to see how tiny it was. the shampoo and conditioner in the bathroom were really nice but they really need to figure something else out for the shower door, every time we took a shower the entire bathroom floor was covered in water. the lighting in the bathroom was horrible, the lights are red....no good for putting on makeup! every night there seemed to be a private event at the pool that we were not allowed to go to. i would expect them to at least let paying guests attend!! don't know what they do about guests in cabanas that have balconys that overlook the pool during these exclusive events. all in all it was nice and clean, i would stay here if the price was right but def. try to get a cabana! oh and parking is $28 a day a little pricey and it always took them forever to bring me my car...i guess it wasn't nice enough to be in the front!

would not stay here again we stayed here from july 25th - july 29th 2008. it was the end of our honeymoon after going to vegas and hawaii.arrived late on a friday night, valet staff very kind and helpful. checked in at reception, brief description given to us of where we had to go and where everything wasetc..i think we were in room 503. overlooking the back of the hotel roosevelt sign - neither of us were too worried about the view s didn't mind. our room was vey modern and decorated nice however the rooms are very very small!! bathrooms are tiny!!!!!! we found the bed too small and uncomfortable, very loud airconditioning fan that you can not turn off, i am not a light sleeper but it kept me awake - on the second night at around 3am i asked at the check in desk if they could get someone to come and turn it off. very surprised that by the time i had returned to the room this had been done and an engineer had come to turn it off. however on return to the room the next day it had been turned back on again!!! rooms werent overly clean and hotel in general very dark dingy and noisy. we didnt get to the pool or the restaurants.valet staff helpfull pleasant and overall appeared to be nice people. shame about the rest of the staff.also be aware that when you check in they charge your credit card $150 for every night you will be there as incidentals then refund it on check out. we were not informed of this on check in and had tried to use our card whilst we were out and had it declined - took about 3 dys after checkout to have the money returned to our card.

hollywood roosevelt my friend and i stayed at the hollywood roosevelt for 3 nights from 4 aug 08. the location was really good for tourists without a car. across the road was the hollywood highland center which had numerous shops and eateries. there was also a pharmacy and supermarket nearby.the hotel looks very luxurious inside as you would expect for the price (about $279/night + tax). we didn't get to the pool or tropicana bar. there is a restaurant within the hotel for those wanting more than fast food.the room was fine, but wouldn't want to be any smaller. it had a fridge and well stocked mini bar, which we didn't take advantage of.the bathroom was a bit of a disappointment. it was small, but doable in terms of space, except for the toilet being too close to the wall. this is one of my pet hates along with a passive air vent rather than an electric exhaust fan, so the bathroom fogged up quickly and took a while to de-fog. they provided nice toiletries.our room looked out over.. a rooftop. our room also backed on to the elevators and so there was some noise at night when they were used. other rooms shouldn't have had this issue.if you need a taxi, the valet parking guys have taxis on standby that they call over immediately.i believe they had two standing only internet terminals for guests.overall, the hotel was fine, but bathroom let it down. location was good.

lost soul my family and i visisted this hotel six years ago and we were disappointed with the changes when we re-visited in june.the historical lobby is no longer the main entrance and is very dingy and dark. all the historical material and the piano has been removed so it feels soulless.when private parties are held at the hotel, residents are not allowed to use the hollywood boulevard entrance, the lobby, the pool or the gym.when we arrived after being up for nearly 24 hours, we had to prove we had a reservation before we were allowed on to the premises. they seemed to be more interested in the celebrities than their hotel guests.non residents are allowed to use the pool which regularly means there is no where to sit. also, you are not allowed to eat your own food there as they have a small restaurant which serves food and drink.the gift shop appears to be stocked with fashionable items which are very expensive and are not for the regular tourist.the hotel prides itself on the fact that the oscars were held there but you would be hard pressed to see any evidence.the air conditioning was very loud and would keep light sleepers awake.on a positive note, the room we stayed in was very clean and the position of the hotel is excellent for visiting the area.

the roosevelt hotel-spa had one main issue- the spa. the massages were a total rip-off!!!! three one hour sessions totaled to $600!!! what they call the spa garden is located right next to the busy streets. how is one suppose to relax when you can hear the traffic as clear as if you were on the sidewalk. i do not recommend it!!! save your money and go to a real spa... the rest was great!!!

awful hotel ....worst ever and i`ve seen bad shocked the rooms have a door connecting to the room next door with no sound proofing and believe me you can even hear a whisper. the first night was respectable guests next to us trying their best to whisper the second night was a couple having sex. the manager can close the pool and parts of the hotel for private functions so tough if your stay falls then but you do get a photocopied letter. as a guest you are a number not a guest, you will not be back but the room will be filled tomorrow attitude . two nights with constant sleep disturbance ruined our time in the day to see sights as we didn`t have the energy. at todays standards it would be a uk three star rating...just half the price and it still wouldn`t be worth the stay it survives by name and location which incidently we thought has seen its day and now the area is run down and seedy. never again. horrible.

what the ???? upon arrival on tuesday july 22 we were greeted by a very gracious and professional valet service. check in was freindly and pleasant. i was in room 132 explained by the front desk as an exceptional poolside room. once in our room pleasantly surprised very nice modern room. upon our return from hollywood blvd with a few bags we were stopped and elegantly questioned and finally asked for our names to verify that we were staying at the hotel. ok everyone has a job to to. when i questioned her why, she thought the bags of snacks were unusual at the hotel. ok whatever. went to dinner and then to the laugh factory and returned at approx. 1am. wow the pool was area was alive even a dj. now my exceptional room was right at the very very busy bar and i could not turn up my tv loud enough to drown out the dj. through out the night my exceptional room was at the bar back entrance that seemed to be very busy with bottles, glasses and who knows what delivery cleaning ect...i was awoken by a car alarm that would not stop. now i learn that my exceptional room was across and below a parking garage. leave my room for breakfast and a nice nytimes was at my door. upon my return at approx. 11pm here we go again party at the pool, dj, glasses, bottles etc...no morning paper the nextday.upon our return late thursday night the pool was somewhat quiet. go to take a shower and no towels. ok no big deal just went to bed. then at aprrox. 1am the pool area came to life again.on friday morning my exceptional room now was next to an electrical closet that was being worked on at 707am. stuck my head out the door about the noise and the guy said ok and continued to drill and hammer. once again this morning no paper. attempted to return to sleep and just turned the tv on to help kill the noise, at 830 housekeeping knocks on the door this is the first time we have encounter her an i have no clue in what she was asking so i just said no thanks come back later we are checking out.what more can i say than just wow ! think twice and question when they tell you that you have an exceptional room.

great hotel, great service stayed at hotel november 2007 and june 2008. great location, but attitude staff below average my first trip. because of location i chose to stay when i was back in la in june. the personal service has really picked up. i think they hired new personable agents or they were not working when i was there in nov.. they were very helpful. they took care of a room change with speed and care. they made me feel like a million bucks.they are good looking too!

loud and obnoxious stayed here while on a business trip. it has a great poolside bar for cocktails, two great restaurant options and the cabana rooms were super cool (although a bit dark). everything seemed to be great and, with all the high security, we were convinced there must be a celebrity staying there. in the early evening, the cabana bar started playing music that was really loud but really good. fine, i thought, by the time i get back from a late dinner i'm sure they will turn it off - there's no way they'd expect guests staying in the cabana rooms to sleep with that music blaring. when i returned at 11pm the music was still going strong. i thought about switching rooms to the main tower where it might be quieter but, again, thought management couldn't possibly keep the music going all night. i was wrong. after a bleary-eyed investigation at 1 am i realized there were literally speakers right outside my room! at 2 a.m. they finally turned off the music. i was exhausted and had a full day of work ahead of me and had just paid a small fortune for the room.i'm only in my early thirties and usually not bothered by good music. but how do they expect anyone except twenty-something party-goers to stay here?

first time visitor in l.a we had a great time, living on the ninth floor. perfect location for a first time visitor in l.a. it's near to all cool classical places if you wanna tick off the the hollowood to do list! the pool area is really nice, and during night it turns in to an outdoor club/bar.we had a lot of help from the concierge, tao, who made a great effort to make our stay and experiences in california great.we stayed five nights at the hotel.complains could be that the breakfast place in the hotel, 24 degrees, wasn't that great. boring menu and the last day we unfortunately had a very rud woman serving us...

exactly as expected a group of 3 of us (21 - 22 yrs) stayed here from the 23rd -27th and were very impressed.the decor was very sleek indeed although the bathroom could be mordenised slightly. i am an extreme clean freak this hotel lived up to my desires.the after party for the bet awards were being held there, so alot of celebs were there and young people in general, which is the kind/type of people that this hotel is perfect for.other reviewers pics are exacltly how the rooms look, a little better though and the ground floor decor is absolutley gorgeous.definatly contact me for more infop.s. also visited orlando new york if you need help

great location, but hotel very pretentious positives first, a great location for experiencing hollywood. first impressions of hotel were good, lovely decor in lobby. pool is lovely if you can get a sunlounger, waited over an hour for one on our first day there. room was quite small and carpet was very shabby. housekeeping services was the main reason we were disappointed with hotel as twice in the week our room was not serviced. on returning from a day out after 5pm we found that our room had not been done. we rang the front desk and told them that room would be empty at 6pm as we were going out to eat. we returned after 9pm to find that maid was only just doing our room. we then had to wait in hall for her to finish. air conditioning is also very noisy but not as noisy as the having window open as pool area empties between 12 and 2am. right hotel for someone wanting lively atmosphere and late nights but not for someone wanting relaxing time.

great location!! loved the pool! def. stay here again! my mother and i stayed at the roosevelt for 4 nights and i couldn't get enough!! the hotel is in a great location right on the walk of stars in hollywood! the hotel was right across from the chinese theater where there was a red carpet event during the time we stayed there. we also went to the jimmy kimmel show right down the street from the hotel. the hotel is clean and the rooms are hip with a contemporary feel to them. i would definitely reccomend this hotel for any age. the pool was great, but the prices of drinks are ridiculous! the hotel staff was nice, but come to hollywood with a plan of what you want to see and do, don't count on them to help with planning. i loved this hotel and area, and can't wait to go back!! also, there is a restaurant called 25degrees and they have the best burgers!!

yobs 1 families 0 ! stayed at the hotel a total of 4 nights in blocks of 1 and 3 nights over 2 week period as part of a major birthday treat.was put in a large twin double bed room the first night due to mix up with our booking. the room was extremeley nice except for a rather noisey fan which are in most of the rooms. ordered room service which was quick and very high standard. we left the next day looking forward to our return trip.on our return trip put in a more smaller standard room, which was fine because that it what we expected to be in. it had adjoining doors and that is when our problem started. at 3am we were woken by the most astounding noise also consider we had a young child with us. a group of youths were using the adjoining wall as a soccer net. there were shouts,screams and bangs which sounded like it was coming from inside the room. after 15 minutes of this we rang the front desk who said they would sort it out. a further 30 minutes later still no end to this noise, our child was quite scared by then. we rang again and explained we had a young family and by now glass's could be heard smashing and foul language clearly heard. their response was casual but they would sort it. a further 15minutes later and by now they were up and down the corridors with a video recorder which was the final straw.. i made my way to the front desk and spoke to a very sleepy hint hint looking night manager whose only solution was for us at 4am to move to another room which i suggested because the noise had not stopped and we had to be up early the next morning.on telling my wife this she rang the front desk a threatned to call the police to sort it [ which is amazing when you see how much security is on in the daytime] and surprise suprise within
