yes i loved this hotel. it was very hip and cool and made me really feel like i was in la, in a good way.

no complaints great location if you're visiting ucla, you can walk to everything in westwood.the backyard is very nice for unwinding outside with a cocktail after a busy day.the guest rooms are comfortable.the hotel staff can be aloof at times but that is w. the whole w concept can be a bit over the top at times, and keep in mind, it is l.a. which to some people from nyc (myself included) is already a little over the top to begin with.overall the hotel is comfortable and conveniently located, a bit expensive for what you get but it serves its purpose.

fun the w westwood is a great place, wonderfull rooms with nice view. good service and with a special swing. we enjoyed it. the location is great!.the bar staff are a bit less on a friday or saturday evening when the seem to be catering a a specila (plastic and shallow) lala-land crowd and forget about the hotel guests. only after ordering 3 drinks they seem to except you and become friendly and start to give the service one may expect. still a place to return to, nicely modern with a fresh style. the area alos offers nice bars, restaurants and shops.

disgusting food we went to the restaurant, nine thirty which was empty, (should've seen the signs) on a tuesday night. the mixed green salad was made with old lettuce leaves, and tiny, so we sent it back. the snapper wasn't even cooked through (it was not meant to be seared) and was very tough so we had to send it back for them to actually cook it. it came back 20 minutes later, spongey and tasteless. so our dinner ended up being greasy brussell sprouts and broccoli. our waiter left half way through dinner, then a new one came to introduce himself, then the old one came back! they didn't offer to comp our over-priced meal ($34.00 for the snapper that we did not eat!!) and we tried to complain on the way out, but the hostess was nowhere to be found. to top things off, i waited forever for my car at valet. it was the most horrible dining experience i have had in los angeles.

horrible restaurant service and management i celebrated my birthday in the hotel's restaurant. i called them to confirm if there is any charge for serving the cake i bring in. they said i shouldn't worry, the cutting is complimentary. at the end of the nigth they charged me $5/person for the cake. when i mentioned this to the manager he had an attitude and i ended up paying $50 extra. also, there are 2 restaurants in the hotel, which i didn't know in the beginning. 1st i made a reservation for 6 people, and when i called them to increase the reservation to 10 people and the girl on the phone took my credit card # because it is necessary for reservation over 8 people. i know that it is normal. but when i went to the restaurant, there was a reservation for 6 people, and they didn't know who took my card #. also they checked the other restaurant too, but there was no reservation over there, too. what a serious management. we spent $700 in the restaurant and it was a horrible and slow service. i guess too many people are trying to get in the restaurant, that's why they don't care to please you. they just want to take your money. i am not going back there again.
average used to stay here since it was the only hotel in westwood. they let you know they were the only choice. not so great service. employees have an attitude.

wonderful stay my husband, mother and i stayed at this property for my daughter's ucla law school graduation. we had requested an early check in and were given our rooms at an even earlier time than requested. the staff was friendly, attentive and helpful. as starwood members we were given an upgrade on one of our rooms to a beautilful, large suite, which was perfect for our needs as we were able to have a little pre-graduation celebration.the hotel is situated extremely close to the ucla campus, and it made it easy to get to the ceremony. my only complaint would be that their complimentary car service, which delivered us to the campus, stopped running at 5:00 and we had to call a cab to get back to the hotel, but that was a minor inconvenience. all in all the hotel was perfect for our needs and made a memorable and exciting day even better.

professional, not snotty i had been here already a few times a few years ago before the renovation of the rooms and things are going better. room was big, hip and comfortable. staff is professional, although things went a bit wrong at check in and check out, and although trying to act cool, not snotty whatsoever. the thirtynine restaurant is nice, the pool area a bit small. location is ideal if you want to be central in la, although nothing is going on in this neighbourhood. prices are reasonable if you look at the quality. in general: a good choice for travellers that feel young.

w is great let me start off by saying that things were malfunctioning in our room, i.e. cable, a/c, etc. but because of their very gracious and wonderful staff i will go back again!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! they couldn't fix the problems, but the did more than make up for all the issues. about the room: i stayed in a corner room suite. it was really roomie and nice. the temperature of the room was preset. there was mood music playing as well. the bed was super comfie! the bathroom left little to be desired but everything else was awesome! i didn't get to partake at bliss spa, but i did stop in and buy some product! the location of hotel is in the heart of westwood. the area was in a nice residential area, and you didn't get any of that ucla party stuff. overall, its your typical w starwood hotel experience. hip, awesome, blah blah blah..ps. did i mention that the staff was awesome?????? cause they were.

hip hotel with lots of funk this hotel is definately hip and not for someone who wants quiet. the rooms have been updated so the decor is a funky 70's style to it (not exactly our taste) but you can't fault it. the hotel itself has a very laid back atmosphere. the staff were all very helpful, professional and anything you want they will try to accommodate it. the backyward bar is totally hip - it is right next to the pool area which has open sunbeds that are about the size of a queen bed! the location is close to bevery hills and rodeo drive and has very easy access to the 405 so you can get anywhere you need to go. a tip - remember la traffic is a nightmare to plan an extra 20 minutes to whereever you want to do to!all in all we can't fault this hotel at all!

wonderful choice for la we are discriminating travelers and so always worry when we try a new hotel. we were on our way to the desert with our children (ages 12 and 17) and wanted to stop in la for a night. anyway, we arrived at 7:00p and were promptly greeted by the parkers. upon checking in, we asked to have both rooms nearby which was not available. so angel, at the front desk, was so kind to upgrade us, as spg clients, to a full 2-bedroom suite. that evening, we dined at the hotel's restaurant, 930, and had jeffrey, a wonderful waiter. while the food and wine was pricey, all five of us enjoyed our meal and the incredible service. the room was contemporary but comfortable with nice flat screen tv's in every room (even the bathroom) and bliss products. we only had a few complaints: the bottled water was $9 . . . how silly; the parking was $31 . . . why not include it; even though the bathroom is large, it is not well-designed as there is no area for make-up, hair brush, etc. and the make-up mirror is right next to the shower door. finally, the air conditioner knocked in the morning which needs to be addressed. the bellman are extremely kind and they got the bill exactly right. we'd stay there again.

w=wonderful i agree with the gist of most of the other reviews i have seen here: this is a very nice hotel in a convenient, cool part of la.however, i can understand why the w might not be for everyone. it is maybe just a bit pretentious and silly (e.g., the special w vocabulary where wheels equals valet parking etc.). if you don't want to fight through a bit of a line saturday evening to get back into the lobby and up to your room, you might want to consider a less trendy location. also, the parking is a bit pricey. i also don't see why they couldn't throw in free internet at this price.those are small gripes, however. the staff are as nice and helpful as anyplace i've stayed. the room was spacious and comfortable. the location is convenient: it's great for the getty, santa monica/venice, and is pretty convenient for hollywood, too. don't underestimate la traffic, however! it's unbelievable!

yuck i'll start by saying i was here for business, not pleasure. my business associate had booked us to stay here. very pretentious and the entire wing we were staying in smelled of marijuana. it fired up in the evenings. i told the front desk, but they did nothing to hunt down the culprits. this place definitely caters to the tragically hip. not my cup of tea.

wonderful w i loved my five night stay at the w. i was on a mixture of business and just fun, and it couldn't have been a better fit. l.a. can be hard to get around, but the w is in a great location in westwood village, and a pleasant walk to great restaurants, movies, theater, and other services.the hopping bar/restaurant at night was fun and hip-but-not-[--], the spectacular pool/lounge/outdoor dining patio was a delight, (and in late february, the scent of blooming jasmine and cherry blossoms was the just what this winter-weary northerner needed). and to top it off- the bliss spa on the second floor, well-- it was bliss-ful. and the bath amenities in the rooms are theirs.there is a gym- but , not being so into the iron-pumping, i put on my sneakers, walked out the door and jogged through the amazing ucla botanic gardens. room service was prompt, the staff is beyond friendly, the concierge suggested and obtained great reservations. my spectacular suite was suitably spectacular, spacious, and full of high tech goodies- there was even an ipod dock, which solved my problem of having forgotten my charger. would i stay here again? in a l.a. minute!my only complaint? $31/day for parking and $15/day for internet.

worth every cent! my husband and i had to be at ucla for his cancer treatment and wanted to be very close to the campus. we looked at several places online but decided on the w. the hotel is very modern, which is not my taste - however everything is done extremely well. the service is excellent and when i checked in tracy morgan of 30 rock was in line in front of me. the w is just a few blocks from the ucla campus and within walking distance of the westwood theater and shopping district. we are part of the starwood network and because of this we were upgraded to a suite on the 6th floor. the short version: not the cheapest hotel in the area but worth every cent if you want to be treated like a celebrity.

impressed - even considering the price i am primarily a business traveler. when my colleague wanted to stay at the w, i was afraid it might be too chic for my taste. i was wrong. each room is a mini-suite, and very comfortable, and i had a wide screen plasma in the living room. the staff was what you normally expect from a 5-star hotel. the bed and linens were exquisite - i really didn't want to get up to catch my flight. the shower was full-force, and adjusted to temperature immediately. how do they do that? it made me forget all those mornings backing up the tub with the shower, waiting for the water to warm up. quibbles: 1) my window faced a concrete wall. you would think a luxury hotel would have contemplated the arrangement of rooms architecturally;and, 2) i had to pay $14.95 for high speed internet access. you would think for $400/night, the hotel could throw in the internet hook-up. all in all, worth the extra money.

a fun stay i'm from the area, but wanted to have a sleepover to celebrate my birthday with my girlfriends. i chose the w...pros - overall, it was a good stay. we had three rooms - two spectacular suites and one fabulous suites. we found them all to be clean, comfortable, and tastefully appointed. i found the valet person, bell-hop person, security, and room service person to be very nice. we were thinking of going out to hollywood or santa monica to party, but ended at the hotel bar which was perfect. it was surprising spacious, had good music, and a dance floor. also, because i am an spg gold member i was able to check-in early and check-out early which was much appreciated. rooms service was fast and we ordered something not on the menu ant they were able to make it happen. also, the hotel knew it was my birthday and sent complimentary snacks and alcoholic beverages as well as birthday card. finally, all the rooms were on the same floor which was quite convenient. cons -not to many cons, just little things that prevented a score of excellent. first, we had some champagne we were planning to bring in and enjoy in the room. we were told that's not allowed because of city mandate and because the w is such a high profile hotel. upon leaving, i was told by another employee that it was simply because the hotel wanted the income from the minibar. i didn't appreciated the inconsistencies. second, the front desk staff/manager didn't exactly exude a warm demeanor. there is something to be said about being nice and welcoming. third, the air was not working in the main room and had to be fixed which was done promptly. also, i think that the bath tubs could have been upgraded at the suite level - they were ordinary. at the w in sd you get a soaking tub at the same room level.

very good experience i stayed here for one week and i had a wonderful experience. as a gold star member, i was upgraded and my room was huge. they have recently renovated the place, and it is tasteful and trendy. the service was friendly, the rooms were very clean. the only reason that i didn't give it a 5 is because the walls are somewhat thin..especially when you have a group of noisy women staying next door. security was prompt when getting them to turn down their music but nothing could be done about the thin wall and noisy ladies. i would recommend this hotel to anyone who can afford it.

building great! staff awful! we've stayed here probably 40 nights just this year and so we have a variety of experience here.basically, i love the location. very convient and the hotel design is lovely, as is the pool area. the rooms are fantastic!the service however is horrible. they never get your reservations right and we are platinum spg members.they also kind of don't do anything but stand around wearing black clothes. if design made a four star hotel, then this would be one, but service is important too.they never make the rooms on time and you have to beg them to come. if you call for a bellhop be prepared to wait at least an hour as we did last time. we also had issues of smoke coming through the floors from smoking rooms into our rooms in three different rooms. really an issue. and if you are facing the back of the building be prepared to hear all night frat parties from ucla.if they had a topnotch staff if would be awesome, but they don't.
surprised with a fantastic stay nice pool scene for drinks and lunging

gorgeous hotel gorgeous hotel. spacious 1 bedroom suite all to myself!!!!! was traveling for business during grammy week. so many people were in town. definately a great time to be in la. will definately go back. rooms are very clean, and house keeping is very attentive. food is a bit pricey, but decent. shopping is nearby. concierge was very helpful in providing me with a map to rodeo drive. had a great time. will definately go back and bring my husband with me this time!

great 4 night stay my wife and i stayed here for 4 nights over the new years holiday. i agree with the positive reviews below on the details. first class experience the whole way. yes, the hotel can seem almost overly stylish (typical w), but we as not overly stylish people never felt out of place. and the entire staff was friendly and helpful.the hotel is on a truly quiet residential block, but we could easily walk to the restaurants, cafes and shops of westwood village. finally, we loved the central location: easy to drive to all the l.a. sights and hotspots, then return to our hip oasis.
hip, comfortable and stylish breakfast - try the lobster omlette

fancy, great service, yet overpriced..... my stay at the w was a for one night using points. it was a standard room in the 9th floor. i have to agree with the other reviewers that the urban flare does not translate to comfort, and the room and everything else was overpriced.the parking was $31 a night for guests, which is similar to other hotels downtown la (i was paid $35 at the westin bonaventure a few days ago). the service is exeptional and you get really people cattering to your needs. the room had a great view of westwood, but the plasma was in an ackward position on the room, as you needed to turn your head to your right in order to watch the screen as it was mounted on the right wall not in front of the tv. the towels were average quality, and the decor was really nice.the bar was happening at night and had a great time.since i paid with points i dont know how much it would had cost to stay at this w, but i am assuming it would had been over $189 a night. i used 12,000 spg points for this night and i dont think it was worth it. over the last few weeks i had stayed at the 4 points culver city about 5 miles from the w, and had used 4,000 spg points and paid $10 for parking for a newly remodeled room.overall, i enjoyed my stay at the w, yet i feeel that for those paying rack rate, you are better off at a newer and less fancy hotel.

ok, style over substance stayed here for business trip, nice room , though the whole hotel has a feeling of style over substance, for example while the desk in my room looked great it was very difficult to work at, ended up using the rooms coffee table. also, the hotels business center seems to be a poor after thought, the person working it gave very good directions to a local art galleries, but was unsure of how to send a fax (had to ask someone at the front desk- who was also unsure and had to ask anther person at the front desk-fax then got sent).

wonderful w located in an assuming neighborhood, the w provides chic elegance to westwood. you walk in and are welcomed by doorman and asked if there is anything that they can assist you with. this sets the precedence for the rest of your stay. the rooms are clean and modern, but doesn't lack comfort. the beds are the starwood staple of the wonderful bed which are in fact, wonderful. the suites have two flatscreens (one in the living room, one in the bedroom) as well as a cd player with their w cd provided for your listening enjoyment. the bathrooms are extremely clean ( i notice every fleck of dirt) and the robes are very soft. i placed the breakfast card out at 1am for fresh coffee and a bagel to be delivered at 8:15. at 8:15 a smiling waiter arrived at my door and was very accomodating. this is a hotel that likes to please their guests.we had drinks at the backyard by the pool upon arrival and were served strong mai tais and a lady drink of some sort all with a smile. we also had drinks at whiskey blue after dinner and were greated again with accomodation. the bouncer went out of his way to find us a nice table so we can watch all the people go by. the w doesn't disappoint with the man candy! all these male waiters/bartenders who are very easy on the eyes...my husband said there was eye candy for him too. :) all-in-all, the w westwood does not disappoint.

chic elegance this is a nice hotel that is a bit over priced. the suite i got is very chic with an urban flare. the bed was very nice and wonderful. the entire hotel was super clean and chic. it lives up to the w hotel reputation. what i did find to be issues were the bath towels. they were too average. the lack of a coffee machine in the room was another issue because you are almost forced to buy the over priced coffee and muffins in the restaurant. the pool area is wonderful but the pool itself is too small for the resort. it's more like a pond. having to pay $31.00 for overnight valet parking was another issue. street parking is rare in this area due to westwood village and ucla being right in the vicinity. overall, i liked the westwood la hotel w. regardless of the overpriced coffee, drinks at the bar and valet parking. i would return if the price was right.

w hotel doesnt recognise loyal guests! i am one of starwood's most loyal guests, i have stayed in starwood properties with work 57 nights in the past 9 months on 27 different stays, also stayed in w sydney and w chicago and i wanted to treat myself by rewarding points while travelling to la. first, when booking they told me they didnt have any standard room so i had to pay extra points to book a higher category, when arriving at the w hotel, the tall blond guy (its a w hotel, its standard) was rude and didnt acknowledge my requests, as a platinium member i didnt have any upgrade, rather, i had one of the worst views, facind the inner courtyard. the hotel is currently being refurnished, so everywhere you go you see construction workers and when using the elevators; you take the staff one as the toehr ones are not always working.the rooms are quite big, but the one i had didnt have exterior lights so you almost had to turn on the lights 24/7. when doing the check out; the overcharged me for over 100 dollars, which they took off, but i realised afterward on my credit card statement that they still charged me for some extras ( in the mini bar i believe) that i didnt use. the property is nice; but the swimming pool is very small, the valet are rude (31 dollar per day). however the location is great, its in the middle of westwood, close to beverly hills, santa monica and westwood itself is nice, its where ucla is and as a result its lively and full of nice restaurants and cafes.the concierge was very nice, she recommended some nice restaurants.i hope this helps

urban and inviting we stayed here for one evening while laying over for our flight to hong kong for our honeymoon. our wedding reception was held at a w hotel and so it was a natural choice in terms of the places we would stay for our trip. we were way impressed with the level of service provided by the staff. we were immediately upgraded to the mega suite (ordered a regular room), and while i know this is not the norm, were impressed with their willingness to accomodate a young couple who paid for the room by starpoints!great location too. can walk to restaurants or take a cab (whatever your preference)poolside was nice too. great service their as well. read a review something to the effect of what you would expect from a w but i don't think that you always get that level of service at every w hotel unfortunately.feel free to contact: we are young (27/29), honest, pay attention to detail, but realistic on what you should expect - so ask away.

nice property my husband and i chose this location because it was the nicest hotel close to our friends that we were visiting. because my husband travels for business we stayed using points so i cannot comment on the cost value. the property was relaxing and we enjoyed our drinks and dinner in the backyard. we wished it was warm enough that weekend to go for a swim and liked the fact that it was sectioned off for guests only to keep it from getting too crowded. if you drive you will be forced to use their valet service since all their signs say not to park in the neighborhood. i think it was $30 a night for hotel guests. that's pretty standard for w hotels, i believe. i can only complain that the elevators took an awful long time. there also was a time i needed directions to a restaurant from concierge only to not find anyone in the early evening. the welcome desk agent told me to just wait instead of offering her time to help. we didn't wait and decided to eat at the backyard which was better than going out. yes, the rooms are standard w hotel rooms. simple slightly worn furniture. these rooms very roomy compared to their ny properties. we will definitely stay here again when we again visit our friends in westwood.

excellent hotel very nice hotel, in a more quiet residential neighbourhood, but within walking distance of shops, restaurants, cafes. the hotel was under construction, renovating the rooms. stayed in a newly renovated room, very nice rooms. bathroom was on the small side, but very nice. the restaurant and bar downstairs were also great, good food, excellent service. i'd absolutely stay again, one of the nicer w's i've stayed in. the pool area is nice, quiet, good service there as well. you've probably seen the pool on tv, it's used in a number of shows. they were filming a show (1 day) while we were there.

fab stay at the w my husband and i, plus teenage daughter stayed for three nights at the w and had a very enjoyable stay. we had a newly refurbished suite on the 14th floor which was extremely spacious and well designed. found the staff to be very helpful and enjoyed hanging out in the backyard. overall, experienced a very relaxing stay in a quiet and safe location of west hollywood. easy access by car to many of the touristy spots including 20 minute drive to santa monica. if you want somewhere local to eat recommend tengu the sushi restaurant which is about 5 minutes away! all in all, most enjoyable stay and would consider staying again.

modern and chic! this is the place for the young single with money! the w los angeles éˆ¥?westwoodtime of stay: december 27, 2006purpose of stay: leisure/pleasurecheck-in:- staff were pleasant, helpful, and prompt in assisting us.concierge:- staff at curbside were attentive in opening our car doors and taking our luggage. only complaint was that it took them over 30 minutes to deliver our baggage to our room. this may have been due to the fact only one elevator was working during our stay.room condition:- as expected, our room was decorated in a very modern, contemporary, and minimalist fashion.- when we entered the room, the television was on with a hip sound-track playing. the television was showing a hotel overview and also gave introductions to other w hotels in the world.- our bathroom was beautifully done. frosted glass counters gave the bathroom an elegant look. elegant wall sconces on either side of the bathroom mirror was a nice touch.- toiletries were excellent. *bliss* spa products were provided (shampoo, conditioner and shower gel). bottles were very tiny, however. only really enough for 1-2 uses.- our television was a bit dated (the crt/boxy
